File: README.md

This is a [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) project bootstrapped with [`create-next-app`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/cli/create-next-app).

## Getting Started

First, run the development server:

```bash
npm run dev
# or
yarn dev
# or
pnpm dev
# or
bun dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) with your browser to see the result.

You can start editing the page by modifying `app/page.tsx`. The page auto-updates as you edit the file.

This project uses [`next/font`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/optimizing/fonts) to automatically optimize and load [Geist](https://vercel.com/font), a new font family for Vercel.

## Learn More

To learn more about Next.js, take a look at the following resources:

- [Next.js Documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs) - learn about Next.js features and API.
- [Learn Next.js](https://nextjs.org/learn) - an interactive Next.js tutorial.

You can check out [the Next.js GitHub repository](https://github.com/vercel/next.js) - your feedback and contributions are welcome!

## Deploy on Vercel

The easiest way to deploy your Next.js app is to use the [Vercel Platform](https://vercel.com/new?utm_medium=default-template&filter=next.js&utm_source=create-next-app&utm_campaign=create-next-app-readme) from the creators of Next.js.

Check out our [Next.js deployment documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/deploying) for more details.

'use client';

import React, { Suspense, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
    Box,
    Button,
    Card,
    CardContent,
    Container,
    Typography,
    Divider,
} from '@mui/material';
import ArrowBackIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowBack';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import DashboardOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DashboardOutlined';
import { useAuth } from '@/src/context/AuthContext';
import { Navbar } from '@/src/components/layout/Navbar';
import { AppBreadcrumbs } from '@/src/components/common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { EnterpriseFooter } from '@/src/components/common/EnterpriseFooter';
import { LoadingScreen } from '@/src/components/common/LoadingScreen';
import { ErrorAlert } from '@/src/components/common/ErrorAlert';
import { ROUTES } from '@/src/config/constants';

/**
 * Dynamic Catch-All Route for future localhost/{something} pages.
 * Guarantees that permanent breadcrumbs, Navbar, and layout persist
 * across any future arbitrary route created in the CRM.
 */
function DynamicCrmPageContent() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { user, loading, error, clearError, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!loading && !isAuthenticated) {
            router.push(ROUTES.LOGIN);
        }
    }, [isAuthenticated, loading, router]);

    if (loading) return <LoadingScreen message="Loading page..." />;
    if (!user) return null;

    return (
        <Box sx={{ minHeight: '100vh', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            {/* Global Navbar */}
            <Navbar />

            <Container maxWidth="xl" sx={{ pt: 2.5, pb: 4, flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                <ErrorAlert error={error} onClose={clearError} />

                {/* ── Permanent Automatic Route-Aware Breadcrumbs ── */}
                <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    <React.Suspense fallback={null}>
                        <AppBreadcrumbs />
                    </React.Suspense>
                </Box>

                {/* ── Enterprise Module Scaffold Card ── */}
                <Card
                    elevation={0}
                    sx={{
                        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                        borderRadius: '12px',
                        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                        p: { xs: 3, md: 5 },
                        textAlign: 'center',
                        my: 'auto',
                    }}
                >
                    <CardContent sx={{ maxWidth: 560, mx: 'auto', p: 0 }}>
                        <Box
                            sx={{
                                width: 56,
                                height: 56,
                                borderRadius: '12px',
                                backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                color: '#2563eb',
                                display: 'flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                justifyContent: 'center',
                                mx: 'auto',
                                mb: 2,
                            }}
                        >
                            <DashboardOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 32 }} />
                        </Box>

                        <Typography variant="h5" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b', mb: 1 }}>
                            Module Ready for Production
                        </Typography>

                        <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: '#64748b', mb: 3, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
                            This module route has been registered with the Nandini CRM design system.
                            The permanent breadcrumbs above automatically reflect your path hierarchy and navigation history.
                        </Typography>

                        <Divider sx={{ my: 2.5 }} />

                        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', display: 'block', mb: 2, fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            QUICK CRM SHORTCUTS
                        </Typography>

                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1.5, justifyContent: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                            <Button
                                variant="outlined"
                                size="small"
                                startIcon={<ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                onClick={() => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATIONS)}
                                sx={{
                                    borderRadius: '8px',
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    fontWeight: 600,
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    borderColor: '#cbd5e1',
                                }}
                            >
                                Organizations
                            </Button>

                            <Button
                                variant="outlined"
                                size="small"
                                startIcon={<PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                onClick={() => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACTS)}
                                sx={{
                                    borderRadius: '8px',
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    fontWeight: 600,
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    borderColor: '#cbd5e1',
                                }}
                            >
                                Contacts
                            </Button>

                            <Button
                                variant="contained"
                                size="small"
                                startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                onClick={() => router.push(ROUTES.DASHBOARD)}
                                sx={{
                                    background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 100%)',
                                    borderRadius: '8px',
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    px: 2,
                                }}
                            >
                                Return to Dashboard
                            </Button>
                        </Box>
                    </CardContent>
                </Card>
            </Container>

            {/* Global Enterprise Footer */}
            <EnterpriseFooter />
        </Box>
    );
}

export default function DynamicCrmPage() {
    return (
        <Suspense fallback={<LoadingScreen message="Loading page..." />}>
            <DynamicCrmPageContent />
        </Suspense>
    );
}

File: src/app/contacts/[id]/edit/page.tsx

'use client';

import { Suspense, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter, useParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Container } from '@mui/material';
import { useAuth } from '@/src/context/AuthContext';
import { ROUTES } from '@/src/config/constants';
import { Navbar } from '@/src/components/layout/Navbar';
import { LoadingScreen } from '@/src/components/common/LoadingScreen';
import ContactForm from '@/src/components/contacts/ContactForm';

function EditContactContent() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const params = useParams();
    const id = (params?.id as string) || '';
    const { user, loading, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!loading && !isAuthenticated) {
            router.push(ROUTES.LOGIN);
        }
    }, [isAuthenticated, loading, router]);

    if (loading) return <LoadingScreen message="Loading contact..." />;
    if (!user) return null;

    return (
        <Box sx={{ minHeight: '100vh', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' }}>
            <Navbar />

            <Container maxWidth="xl" sx={{ pt: 2.5, pb: 1 }}>
                <ContactForm mode="edit" contactId={id} />
            </Container>
        </Box>
    );
}

export default function EditContactPage() {
    return (
        <Suspense fallback={<LoadingScreen message="Loading contact..." />}>
            <EditContactContent />
        </Suspense>
    );
}

'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box } from '@mui/material';
import { useAuth } from '@/src/context/AuthContext';
import { ROUTES } from '@/src/config/constants';
import { Navbar } from '@/src/components/layout/Navbar';
import { LoadingScreen } from '@/src/components/common/LoadingScreen';
import { ErrorAlert } from '@/src/components/common/ErrorAlert';
import { ContactsMasterView } from '@/src/components/contacts';

export default function ContactsPage() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { user, loading, error, clearError, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!loading && !isAuthenticated) {
            router.push(ROUTES.LOGIN);
        }
    }, [isAuthenticated, loading, router]);

    if (loading) return <LoadingScreen message="Loading contacts..." />;
    if (!user) return null;

    return (
        <Box sx={{ minHeight: '100vh', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <Navbar />
            <ErrorAlert error={error} onClose={clearError} />
            <ContactsMasterView />
        </Box>
    );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Container } from '@mui/material';
import { useAuth } from '@/src/context/AuthContext';
import { ROUTES } from '@/src/config/constants';
import { Navbar } from '@/src/components/layout/Navbar';
import { AppBreadcrumbs } from '@/src/components/common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AccountDetailsCard } from '@/src/components/dashboard/AccountDetailsCard';
import { LoadingScreen } from '@/src/components/common/LoadingScreen';
import { ErrorAlert } from '@/src/components/common/ErrorAlert';

export default function DashboardPage() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { user, loading, error, clearError, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!loading && !isAuthenticated) {
            router.push(ROUTES.LOGIN);
        }
    }, [isAuthenticated, loading, router]);

    if (loading) {
        return <LoadingScreen message="Loading dashboard..." />;
    }

    if (!user) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <Box sx={{ minHeight: '100vh', backgroundColor: 'background.default' }}>
            <Navbar />
            <Container maxWidth="lg" sx={{ mt: 3, pb: 4 }}>
                <ErrorAlert error={error} onClose={clearError} />
                <Box sx={{ mb: 2.5 }}>
                    <AppBreadcrumbs />
                </Box>
                <AccountDetailsCard user={user} />
            </Container>
        </Box>
    );
}

================
File: src/app/error.tsx
================
'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Box, Button, Container, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { Navbar } from '@/src/components/layout/Navbar';
import { ErrorAlert } from '@/src/components/common/ErrorAlert';

export default function GlobalRouteError({
    error,
    reset,
}: {
    error: Error & { digest?: string };
    reset: () => void;
}) {
    useEffect(() => {
        console.error('Route error boundary caught:', error);
    }, [error]);

    return (
        <Box sx={{ minHeight: '100vh', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <Navbar />
            <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ pt: 6, pb: 4 }}>
                <ErrorAlert
                    id="route-error-alert"
                    error={error?.message || 'An unexpected error occurred while rendering this page.'}
                />
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mt: 2 }}>
                    <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: '#64748b' }}>
                        Please try refreshing the view or return to the dashboard.
                    </Typography>
                    <Button
                        variant="contained"
                        size="small"
                        onClick={reset}
                        sx={{ textTransform: 'none', fontWeight: 600, borderRadius: '8px' }}
                    >
                        Try Again
                    </Button>
                </Box>
            </Container>
        </Box>
    );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Geist, Geist_Mono } from "next/font/google";
import "./globals.css";
import { ThemeRegistry } from "@/src/theme/ThemeRegistry";
import { AuthProvider } from "@/src/context/AuthContext";
import { APP_CONFIG } from "@/src/config/constants";

const geistSans = Geist({
  variable: "--font-geist-sans",
  subsets: ["latin"],
});

const geistMono = Geist_Mono({
  variable: "--font-geist-mono",
  subsets: ["latin"],
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: APP_CONFIG.appName,
  description: `Official CRM portal for ${APP_CONFIG.companyName}`,
};

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html
      lang="en"
      className={`${geistSans.variable} ${geistMono.variable} h-full antialiased`}
    >
      <body className="min-h-full m-0">
        <ThemeRegistry>
          <AuthProvider>{children}</AuthProvider>
        </ThemeRegistry>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Suspense, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter, useParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Container } from '@mui/material';
import { useAuth } from '@/src/context/AuthContext';
import { ROUTES } from '@/src/config/constants';
import { Navbar } from '@/src/components/layout/Navbar';
import { LoadingScreen } from '@/src/components/common/LoadingScreen';
import { ConvertLeadForm } from '@/src/components/leads/ConvertLeadForm';

function ConvertLeadContent() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const params = useParams();
    const id = (params?.id as string) || '';
    const { user, loading, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!loading && !isAuthenticated) {
            router.push(ROUTES.LOGIN);
        }
    }, [isAuthenticated, loading, router]);

    if (loading) return <LoadingScreen message="Loading lead conversion..." />;
    if (!user) return null;

    return (
        <Box sx={{ minHeight: '100vh', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' }}>
            <Navbar />

            <Container maxWidth="xl" sx={{ pt: 2.5, pb: 4 }}>
                <ConvertLeadForm leadId={id} />
            </Container>
        </Box>
    );
}

export default function ConvertLeadPage() {
    return (
        <Suspense fallback={<LoadingScreen message="Loading lead conversion..." />}>
            <ConvertLeadContent />
        </Suspense>
    );
}

import { LoadingScreen } from '@/src/components/common/LoadingScreen';

export default function HomePage() {

        if (!loading) {
            router.replace(isAuthenticated ? ROUTES.DASHBOARD : ROUTES.LOGIN);

}

"use client";

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
    Box,
    TextField,
    Button,
    Typography,
    InputAdornment,
    IconButton,
    CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
    PersonOutlined as PersonOutlineIcon,
    LockOutlined as LockOutlinedIcon,
    Visibility as VisibilityIcon,
    VisibilityOff as VisibilityOffIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';
import { ROUTES } from '../../config/constants';
import { ErrorAlert } from '../common/ErrorAlert';

export function LoginForm() {
    const router = useRouter();
    const { login } = useAuth();

    const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
    const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
    const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const handleTogglePassword = () => {
        setShowPassword((prev) => !prev);
    };

    const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setError(null);

        const trimmedUsername = username.trim();
        if (!trimmedUsername) {
            setError('Username is required.');
            return;
        }
        if (!password) {
            setError('Password is required.');
            return;
        }

        setLoading(true);
        try {
            await login({ username: trimmedUsername, password });
            router.push(ROUTES.DASHBOARD);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Login failed. Please try again.';
            setError(message);
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    return (
        <Box component="form" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
            <ErrorAlert id="login-error-alert" error={error} onClose={() => setError(null)} />

            {/* Username Input */}
            <Box sx={{ mb: 2.5 }}>
                <Typography
                    sx={{
                        fontSize: '13px',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        color: '#4A5568',
                        mb: 0.75,
                        letterSpacing: '0.1px',
                    }}
                >
                    User Name
                </Typography>
                <TextField
                    id="username"
                    fullWidth
                    placeholder="Enter your CRM username"
                    value={username}
                    onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                    autoComplete="username"
                    disabled={loading}
                    slotProps={{
                        input: {
                            startAdornment: (
                                <InputAdornment position="start">
                                    <PersonOutlineIcon sx={{ color: '#A0AEC0', fontSize: '20px' }} />
                                </InputAdornment>
                            ),
                        },
                    }}
                    sx={{
                        '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
                            borderRadius: '10px',
                            backgroundColor: '#FAFBFC',
                            fontSize: '14px',
                            '& fieldset': { borderColor: '#DDE3EC' },
                            '&:hover fieldset': { borderColor: 'primary.main' },
                            '&.Mui-focused fieldset': {
                                borderColor: 'primary.main',
                                borderWidth: '1.5px',
                            },
                        },
                        '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
                            color: '#2D3748',
                            py: '12px',
                            '&::placeholder': { color: '#A0AEC0', opacity: 1 },
                        },
                    }}
                />
            </Box>

            {/* Password Input */}
            <Box sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                <Box
                    sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        mb: 0.75,
                    }}
                >
                    <Typography
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '13px',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            color: '#4A5568',
                            letterSpacing: '0.1px',
                        }}
                    >
                        Password
                    </Typography>
                    {/* <Link
                        href="#"
                        underline="hover"
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '13px',
                            color: 'primary.main',
                            fontWeight: 500,
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            '&:hover': { color: 'primary.dark' },
                        }}
                    >
                        Forgot password?
                    </Link> */}
                </Box>
                <TextField
                    id="password"
                    fullWidth
                    type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    placeholder="Enter your password"
                    value={password}
                    onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                    autoComplete="current-password"
                    disabled={loading}
                    slotProps={{
                        input: {
                            startAdornment: (
                                <InputAdornment position="start">
                                    <LockOutlinedIcon sx={{ color: '#A0AEC0', fontSize: '20px' }} />
                                </InputAdornment>
                            ),
                            endAdornment: (
                                <InputAdornment position="end">
                                    <IconButton
                                        id="toggle-password-visibility"
                                        aria-label="toggle password visibility"
                                        onClick={handleTogglePassword}
                                        edge="end"
                                        sx={{
                                            color: '#A0AEC0',
                                            '&:hover': { color: 'primary.main' },
                                            transition: 'color 0.2s',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {showPassword ? (
                                            <VisibilityOffIcon sx={{ fontSize: '20px' }} />
                                        ) : (
                                            <VisibilityIcon sx={{ fontSize: '20px' }} />
                                        )}
                                    </IconButton>
                                </InputAdornment>
                            ),
                        },
                    }}
                    sx={{
                        '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
                            borderRadius: '10px',
                            backgroundColor: '#FAFBFC',
                            fontSize: '14px',
                            '& fieldset': { borderColor: '#DDE3EC' },
                            '&:hover fieldset': { borderColor: 'primary.main' },
                            '&.Mui-focused fieldset': {
                                borderColor: 'primary.main',
                                borderWidth: '1.5px',
                            },
                        },
                        '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
                            color: '#2D3748',
                            py: '12px',
                            '&::placeholder': { color: '#A0AEC0', opacity: 1 },
                        },
                    }}
                />
            </Box>

            {/* Submit Button */}
            <Button
                id="login-submit-btn"
                type="submit"
                fullWidth
                variant="contained"
                disabled={loading}
                sx={{
                    py: '12px',
                    borderRadius: '10px',
                    fontSize: '15px',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    letterSpacing: '0.3px',
                    textTransform: 'none',

                    '&.Mui-disabled': {
                        background: '#B0C4DE',
                        boxShadow: 'none',
                    },
                }}

                {loading ? <CircularProgress size={22} sx={{ color: '#fff' }} /> : 'Sign In'}
            </Button>
        </Box>
    );
}

================
File: src/components/common/AppBreadcrumbs.tsx

'use client';

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import NextLink from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import {
    Breadcrumbs as MuiBreadcrumbs,
    Link as MuiLink,
    Typography,
    SxProps,
    Theme,
} from '@mui/material';
import NavigateNextIcon from '@mui/icons-material/NavigateNext';

export interface BreadcrumbItem {
    label: string;
    href?: string;
}

export interface AppBreadcrumbsProps {
    items?: BreadcrumbItem[];
    separator?: React.ReactNode;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

// Module mapping for CRM sections
const ROUTE_MODULE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
    // Sales
    organizations: 'Sales',
    organisation: 'Sales',
    contacts: 'Sales',
    contact: 'Sales',
    opportunities: 'Sales',
    deals: 'Sales',
    leads: 'Sales',
    customers: 'Sales',
    accounts: 'Sales',
    quotations: 'Sales',
    quotes: 'Sales',
    invoices: 'Sales',
    orders: 'Sales',
    sales: 'Sales',

    // Support
    tickets: 'Support',
    cases: 'Support',
    sla: 'Support',
    helpdesk: 'Support',
    support: 'Support',
    services: 'Support',

    // Activities
    activities: 'Activities',
    tasks: 'Activities',
    calls: 'Activities',
    meetings: 'Activities',
    emails: 'Activities',
    calendar: 'Activities',

    // Inventory
    inventory: 'Inventory',
    products: 'Inventory',
    items: 'Inventory',
    stock: 'Inventory',
    warehouse: 'Inventory',
    categories: 'Inventory',

    // Analytics & Settings
    reports: 'Analytics',
    analytics: 'Analytics',
    settings: 'Settings',
    profile: 'Settings',
    integrations: 'Settings',
    users: 'Administration',
    admin: 'Administration',
    dashboard: 'Home',
    home: 'Home',
};

// Formatter for route segment labels
function formatSegmentLabel(segment: string): string {
    if (!segment) return '';
    const lower = segment.toLowerCase();
    if (lower === 'new') return 'Create & Edit View';
    if (lower === 'edit') return 'Edit View';
    if (lower === 'organizations' || lower === 'organisation') return 'Organizations';
    if (lower === 'contacts' || lower === 'contact') return 'Contacts';
    if (lower === 'leads' || lower === 'lead') return 'Leads';
    if (lower === 'opportunities' || lower === 'deals') return 'Opportunities';
    if (lower === 'quotations' || lower === 'quotes') return 'Quotations';
    if (lower === 'quote') return 'Create Quote';
    if (lower === 'dashboard') return 'Dashboard';
    
    // Check if it's an ID (digits or uuid format)
    if (/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}/i.test(segment) || /^\d+$/.test(segment)) {
        return `Record #${segment.slice(0, 8)}`;
    }

    // Capitalize words separated by hyphens or underscores
    return segment
        .split(/[-_]/)
        .map((word) => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1).toLowerCase())
        .join(' ');
}

export function useAutoBreadcrumbs(customItems?: BreadcrumbItem[]): BreadcrumbItem[] {
    const pathname = usePathname();

    return useMemo(() => {
        if (customItems && customItems.length > 0) {
            return customItems;
        }

        if (!pathname || pathname === '/') {
            return [{ label: 'Home', href: '/' }, { label: 'Dashboard' }];
        }

        const segments = pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
        if (segments.length === 0) {
            return [{ label: 'Home', href: '/' }];
        }

        const items: BreadcrumbItem[] = [];
        const primarySegment = segments[0].toLowerCase();
        const moduleName = ROUTE_MODULE_MAP[primarySegment] || 'Sales';

        // 1. Module Level (e.g. Sales, Support, Home)
        items.push({ label: moduleName });

        // 2. Build cumulative breadcrumb trail
        let cumulativePath = '';
        segments.forEach((seg, index) => {
            cumulativePath += `/${seg}`;
            const isLast = index === segments.length - 1;
            const label = formatSegmentLabel(seg);

            items.push({
                label,
                href: isLast ? undefined : cumulativePath,
            });
        });

        return items;
    }, [pathname, customItems]);
}

function BreadcrumbsView({
    items,
    separator = <NavigateNextIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: 16 }} />,
    sx,
}: {
    items: BreadcrumbItem[];
    separator?: React.ReactNode;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}) {
    return (
        <MuiBreadcrumbs
            separator={separator}
            aria-label="breadcrumb"
            sx={{
                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                '& .MuiBreadcrumbs-separator': {
                    mx: 0.75,
                },
                ...sx,
            }}
        >
            {items.map((item, index) => {
                const isLast = index === items.length - 1;

                if (isLast) {
                    return (
                        <Typography
                            key={`${item.label}-${index}`}
                            sx={{
                                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                                color: '#1e293b',
                                fontWeight: 700,
                            }}
                        >
                            {item.label}
                        </Typography>
                    );
                }

                if (item.href) {
                    return (
                        <MuiLink
                            key={`${item.label}-${index}`}
                            component={NextLink}
                            href={item.href}
                            underline="hover"
                            sx={{
                                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                                color: '#6b7280',
                                transition: 'color 0.15s ease',
                                '&:hover': { color: '#2563EB' },
                            }}
                        >
                            {item.label}
                        </MuiLink>
                    );
                }

                return (
                    <Typography
                        key={`${item.label}-${index}`}
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.8rem',
                            color: '#6b7280',
                        }}
                    >
                        {item.label}
                    </Typography>
                );
            })}
        </MuiBreadcrumbs>
    );
}

function DynamicBreadcrumbs({
    separator,
    sx,
}: Omit<AppBreadcrumbsProps, 'items'>) {
    const breadcrumbItems = useAutoBreadcrumbs();
    return <BreadcrumbsView items={breadcrumbItems} separator={separator} sx={sx} />;
}

export function AppBreadcrumbs({
    items,
    separator = <NavigateNextIcon fontSize="small" sx={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: 16 }} />,
    sx,
}: AppBreadcrumbsProps) {
    // If static custom items are provided, render directly without triggering usePathname
    if (items && items.length > 0) {
        return <BreadcrumbsView items={items} separator={separator} sx={sx} />;
    }

    // Wrap dynamic pathname breadcrumb in Suspense to satisfy Next.js prerendering requirements
    return (
        <React.Suspense
            fallback={
                <BreadcrumbsView
                    items={[{ label: 'Home' }]}
                    separator={separator}
                    sx={sx}
                />
            }
        >
            <DynamicBreadcrumbs separator={separator} sx={sx} />
        </React.Suspense>
    );
}

================
File: src/components/common/AppBreadcrumbsBar.tsx
================
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, SxProps, Theme } from '@mui/material';
import { AppBreadcrumbs, type BreadcrumbItem } from './AppBreadcrumbs';

export interface AppBreadcrumbsBarProps {
    items?: BreadcrumbItem[];
    actions?: React.ReactNode;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

export function AppBreadcrumbsBar({ items, actions, sx }: AppBreadcrumbsBarProps) {
    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                gap: 2,
                mb: 2,
                ...sx,
            }}
        >
            {/* Automatic or custom permanent breadcrumbs */}
            <AppBreadcrumbs items={items} />

            {/* Optional right-aligned actions */}
            {actions && (
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    {actions}
                </Box>
            )}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Snackbar, Alert } from '@mui/material';

export interface AppToastProps {
    open: boolean;
    message: string;
    severity?: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    onClose: () => void;
    autoHideDuration?: number;
}

/**
 * Standardized Application Toast notification.
 * Consistently pops up on the top right across the whole CRM application.
 */
export function AppToast({
    open,
    message,
    severity = 'success',
    onClose,
    autoHideDuration = 4000,
}: AppToastProps) {
    return (
        <Snackbar
            open={open}
            autoHideDuration={autoHideDuration}
            onClose={onClose}
            anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'top', horizontal: 'right' }}
            sx={{ zIndex: 2000 }}
        >
            <Alert
                severity={severity}
                variant="filled"
                onClose={onClose}
                sx={{
                    boxShadow: '0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontSize: '0.84rem',
                    minWidth: 260,
                }}
            >
                {message}
            </Alert>
        </Snackbar>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Paper, Typography, type SxProps, type Theme } from '@mui/material';
import { type BreadcrumbItem } from './AppBreadcrumbs';
import { FormHeader } from '../forms/FormHeader';
import { FormStickyFooter } from '../forms/FormStickyFooter';

export interface FormTabItem {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    badge?: React.ReactNode;
    hasDot?: boolean;
    sublabel?: string;
}

export interface CommonFormLayoutProps {
    /**
     * Optional custom breadcrumb elements. If omitted, AppBreadcrumbs is rendered with optional `breadcrumbItems`.
     */
    breadcrumbs?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Optional breadcrumb items passed to AppBreadcrumbs if custom breadcrumbs element is omitted.
     */
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
    /**
     * Optional header extra elements rendered on the right side of the breadcrumbs row (if any).
     */
    headerExtra?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Form tabs displayed at the top of the form card.
     */
    tabs?: FormTabItem[];
    /**
     * ID of the active tab.
     */
    activeTab?: string;
    /**
     * Callback when a tab is clicked.
     */
    onTabChange?: (tabId: string) => void;
    /**
     * Main form fields content (active panel).
     */
    children: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Callback when Cancel button is clicked in the sticky footer.
     */
    onCancel: () => void;
    /**
     * Callback when Save button is clicked in the sticky footer.
     */
    onSave: () => void;
    /**
     * Whether form is currently submitting.
     */
    submitting?: boolean;
    /**
     * Text for the primary save button (e.g. "Save Contact", "Save Lead").
     */
    saveLabel?: string;
    /**
     * Text for the cancel button. Defaults to "Cancel".
     */
    cancelLabel?: string;
    /**
     * Optional toast notification element.
     */
    toast?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Set to true to hide the sticky bottom action bar.
     */
    hideFooter?: boolean;
    /**
     * Disable default padding on the content wrapper (useful when child tab components provide their own internal padding).
     */
    disableContentPadding?: boolean;
    /**
     * Custom sx styling for outer page container.
     */
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
    /**
     * Custom sx styling for the Paper form card.
     */
    paperSx?: SxProps<Theme>;
    /**
     * Custom sx styling for the form content box inside Paper.
     */
    contentSx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

/**
 * CommonFormLayout provides a standard, consistent page layout for all Create/Edit forms across the CRM:
 * 1. Line 1: Route-aware Breadcrumbs (no redundant discard button).
 * 2. Form Card: Clean Paper container with unified horizontal tabs bar.
 * 3. Card Body: Active form sections and fields.
 * 4. Bottom: Enterprise sticky action bar with local buffer status indicator, Cancel, and Save buttons.
 * 5. Toast: Standard enterprise notifications.
 */
export function CommonFormLayout({
    breadcrumbs,
    breadcrumbItems,
    headerExtra,
    tabs,
    activeTab,
    onTabChange,
    children,
    onCancel,
    onSave,
    submitting = false,
    saveLabel = 'Save Record',
    cancelLabel = 'Cancel',
    toast,
    hideFooter = false,
    disableContentPadding = false,
    sx,
    paperSx,
    contentSx,
}: CommonFormLayoutProps) {
    return (
        <Box sx={{ width: '100%', pb: 10, ...sx }}>
            {/* ── Line 1: Route-Aware Breadcrumbs ── */}
            <FormHeader
                breadcrumbs={breadcrumbs}
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems}
                extraActions={headerExtra}
            />

            {/* ── Main Form Card ── */}
            <Paper
                elevation={0}
                sx={{
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                    overflow: 'hidden',
                    boxShadow: '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)',
                    ...paperSx,
                }}
            >
                {/* ── Horizontal Navigation Tabs Bar ── */}
                {tabs && tabs.length > 0 && (
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                            borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            px: { xs: 2, md: 2.5 },
                            py: 1,
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 1,
                            overflowX: 'auto',
                        }}
                    >
                        {tabs.map((tab) => {
                            const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;

                            return (
                                <Box
                                    key={tab.id}
                                    onClick={() => onTabChange?.(tab.id)}
                                    sx={{
                                        display: 'flex',
                                        alignItems: 'center',
                                        gap: 1,
                                        px: 2,
                                        py: 0.9,
                                        borderRadius: '8px',
                                        cursor: onTabChange ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                                        userSelect: 'none',
                                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                                        transition: 'all 0.15s ease-in-out',
                                        backgroundColor: isActive ? '#ffffff' : 'transparent',
                                        border: isActive ? '1px solid #cbd5e1' : '1px solid transparent',
                                        boxShadow: isActive ? '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)' : 'none',
                                        color: isActive ? '#1e3a8a' : '#64748b',
                                        fontWeight: isActive ? 700 : 500,
                                        fontSize: '0.84rem',
                                        '&:hover': {
                                            backgroundColor: isActive ? '#ffffff' : '#f1f5f9',
                                            color: isActive ? '#1e3a8a' : '#1e293b',
                                        },
                                    }}
                                >
                                    {tab.icon && (
                                        <Box
                                            sx={{
                                                display: 'flex',
                                                alignItems: 'center',
                                                color: isActive ? '#2563eb' : '#64748b',
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            {tab.icon}
                                        </Box>
                                    )}
                                    <Typography
                                        sx={{
                                            fontSize: '0.84rem',
                                            fontWeight: 'inherit',
                                            color: 'inherit',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {tab.label}
                                    </Typography>

                                    {tab.badge && (
                                        <Box
                                            sx={{
                                                px: 1,
                                                py: 0.2,
                                                borderRadius: '9999px',
                                                border: '1px solid #93c5fd',
                                                backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                                color: '#2563eb',
                                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                                fontWeight: 600,
                                                lineHeight: 1.2,
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            {tab.badge}
                                        </Box>
                                    )}

                                    {tab.sublabel && (
                                        <Typography
                                            component="span"
                                            sx={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: '#94a3b8', fontWeight: 400 }}
                                        >
                                            {tab.sublabel}
                                        </Typography>
                                    )}

                                    {tab.hasDot && (
                                        <Box
                                            sx={{
                                                width: 7,
                                                height: 7,
                                                borderRadius: '50%',
                                                backgroundColor: '#f97316',
                                                ml: 0.5,
                                            }}
                                        />
                                    )}
                                </Box>
                            );
                        })}
                    </Box>
                )}

                {/* ── Form Content Panels ── */}
                <Box
                    sx={{
                        p: disableContentPadding ? 0 : { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 },
                        ...contentSx,
                    }}
                >
                    {children}
                </Box>
            </Paper>

            {/* ── Bottom Sticky Action Bar ── */}
            {!hideFooter && (
                <FormStickyFooter
                    onCancel={onCancel}
                    onSave={onSave}
                    submitting={submitting}
                    saveLabel={saveLabel}
                    cancelLabel={cancelLabel}
                />
            )}

            {/* ── Notifications Toast ── */}
            {toast}
        </Box>
    );
}

export { CommonFormLayout as CommonFormView };

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Paper, SxProps, Theme } from '@mui/material';
import { AppBreadcrumbs, type BreadcrumbItem } from './AppBreadcrumbs';
import { EnterpriseFooter } from './EnterpriseFooter';
import {
    DataTable,
    DataTableFilterPills,
    DataTablePagination,
    DataTableToolbar,
    type DataTableColumn,
    type DataTableFilterPillsProps,
    type DataTablePaginationProps,
    type DataTableToolbarProps,
    type SortOrder,
} from './DataTable';

export interface CommonMasterViewProps<T = unknown, TFilter extends string = string> {
    /**
     * Optional custom breadcrumb elements. If omitted, AppBreadcrumbs is used with optional `breadcrumbItems`.
     */
    breadcrumbs?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Optional breadcrumb items passed to AppBreadcrumbs if custom breadcrumbs element is omitted.
     */
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
    /**
     * Declarative filter pills configuration.
     */
    filterConfig?: DataTableFilterPillsProps<TFilter>;
    /**
     * Custom filter controls (overrides `filterConfig` if provided).
     */
    filters?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Optional action controls rendered on the right side of the filter row (e.g. Export, Filter/Views).
     */
    headerActions?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Declarative search & toolbar configuration.
     */
    searchConfig?: DataTableToolbarProps;
    /**
     * Custom toolbar component (overrides `searchConfig` if provided).
     */
    toolbar?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Generic table columns definition.
     */
    columns?: DataTableColumn<T>[];
    /**
     * Generic table row data.
     */
    data?: T[];
    /**
     * Unique key extractor for table rows.
     */
    keyExtractor?: (row: T, index: number) => string;
    /**
     * Row selection props.
     */
    selectable?: boolean;
    selectedIds?: Set<string> | string[];
    onToggleSelectRow?: (id: string) => void;
    onToggleSelectAll?: (checked?: boolean) => void;
    isAllSelected?: boolean;
    isIndeterminate?: boolean;
    /**
     * Sorting props.
     */
    sortField?: string;
    sortOrder?: SortOrder;
    onSort?: (field: string) => void;
    /**
     * Row action handlers.
     */
    onView?: (row: T) => void;
    onEdit?: (row: T) => void;
    onDelete?: (row: T) => void;
    onRowClick?: (row: T) => void;
    activeRowId?: string | null;
    viewTooltip?: string;
    editTooltip?: string;
    deleteTooltip?: string;
    actionsPosition?: 'left' | 'right';
    actionsWidth?: number | string;
    actionsHeaderLabel?: string;
    /**
     * Empty state customization.
     */
    emptyState?: React.ReactNode;
    emptyIcon?: React.ReactNode;
    emptyTitle?: string;
    emptyDescription?: string;
    emptyActionLabel?: string;
    onEmptyAction?: () => void;
    minHeight?: number | string;
    /**
     * Custom table component (overrides declarative `DataTable` if provided).
     */
    table?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Table pagination config object or custom ReactNode displayed at the bottom of the table paper.
     */
    pagination?: DataTablePaginationProps | React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Side detail drawer component (rendered outside the paper card).
     */
    drawer?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Whether a side detail drawer is currently open, used to apply subtle blur to the background table.
     */
    isDrawerOpen?: boolean;
    /**
     * Toast notification component (e.g. AppToast).
     */
    toast?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Optional custom footer. If omitted and `hideFooter` is false, EnterpriseFooter is rendered.
     */
    footer?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Set to true to hide the EnterpriseFooter.
     */
    hideFooter?: boolean;
    /**
     * Children rendered inside the table paper card (useful if not passing `table` prop directly).
     */
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Custom sx styling for outer page container.
     */
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
    /**
     * Custom sx styling for the inner content container.
     */
    contentSx?: SxProps<Theme>;
    /**
     * Custom sx styling for the Paper table container.
     */
    paperSx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

function isPaginationConfig(
    value: DataTablePaginationProps | React.ReactNode
): value is DataTablePaginationProps {
    return (
        typeof value === 'object' &&
        value !== null &&
        !React.isValidElement(value) &&
        'page' in value &&
        'rowsPerPage' in value &&
        'totalCount' in value &&
        'onPageChange' in value
    );
}

/**
 * CommonMasterView provides a unified, generic, declarative page template for all master CRM views:
 * 1. Line 1: Route-aware Breadcrumbs.
 * 2. Line 2: Filter pills (`filterConfig`) and optional right-aligned header actions.
 * 3. Line 3: Standard Paper table card housing Toolbar (`searchConfig`), `DataTable<T>`, and `DataTablePagination`.
 * 4. Outside: Detail drawer, standard Enterprise CRM Footer, and Toast notifications.
 */
export function CommonMasterView<T = unknown, TFilter extends string = string>({
    breadcrumbs,
    breadcrumbItems,
    filterConfig,
    filters,
    headerActions,
    searchConfig,
    toolbar,
    columns,
    data,
    keyExtractor,
    selectable = true,
    selectedIds,
    onToggleSelectRow,
    onToggleSelectAll,
    isAllSelected,
    isIndeterminate,
    sortField,
    sortOrder,
    onSort,
    onView,
    onEdit,
    onDelete,
    onRowClick,
    activeRowId,
    viewTooltip,
    editTooltip,
    deleteTooltip,
    actionsPosition = 'left',
    actionsWidth = 70,
    actionsHeaderLabel = 'ACTIONS',
    emptyState,
    emptyIcon,
    emptyTitle,
    emptyDescription,
    emptyActionLabel,
    onEmptyAction,
    minHeight = 280,
    table,
    pagination,
    drawer,
    isDrawerOpen = false,
    toast,
    footer,
    hideFooter = false,
    children,
    sx,
    contentSx,
    paperSx,
}: CommonMasterViewProps<T, TFilter>) {
    const resolvedFilters =
        filters ?? (filterConfig ? <DataTableFilterPills<TFilter> {...filterConfig} /> : null);

    const resolvedToolbar =
        toolbar ?? (searchConfig ? <DataTableToolbar {...searchConfig} /> : null);

    const resolvedTable =
        table ??
        (columns && data ? (
            <DataTable<T>
                data={data}
                columns={columns}
                keyExtractor={keyExtractor}
                selectable={selectable}
                selectedIds={selectedIds}
                onToggleSelectRow={onToggleSelectRow}
                onToggleSelectAll={onToggleSelectAll}
                isAllSelected={isAllSelected}
                isIndeterminate={isIndeterminate}
                sortField={sortField}
                sortOrder={sortOrder}
                onSort={onSort}
                onViewRow={onView}
                onEditRow={onEdit}
                onDeleteRow={onDelete}
                onRowClick={onRowClick}
                activeRowId={activeRowId}
                viewTooltip={viewTooltip}
                editTooltip={editTooltip}
                deleteTooltip={deleteTooltip}
                actionsPosition={actionsPosition}
                actionsWidth={actionsWidth}
                actionsHeaderLabel={actionsHeaderLabel}
                emptyState={emptyState}
                emptyIcon={emptyIcon}
                emptyTitle={emptyTitle}
                emptyDescription={emptyDescription}
                emptyActionLabel={emptyActionLabel}
                onEmptyAction={onEmptyAction}
                minHeight={minHeight}
            />
        ) : null);

    const resolvedPagination = isPaginationConfig(pagination) ? (
        <DataTablePagination {...pagination} />
    ) : (
        pagination
    );

    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                flex: 1,
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 64px)',
                backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                width: '100%',
                minWidth: 0,
                ...sx,
            }}
        >
            {/* ── Main Page Content ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    px: { xs: 2, md: 3 },
                    pt: 2,
                    pb: 2,
                    flex: 1,
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    minHeight: 0,
                    minWidth: 0,
                    width: '100%',
                    ...contentSx,
                }}
            >
                {/* ── Line 1: Route-Aware Breadcrumbs ── */}
                <Box sx={{ mb: 1.5, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    {breadcrumbs || <AppBreadcrumbs items={breadcrumbItems} />}
                </Box>

                {/* ── Line 2: All Filters & Optional Header Actions ── */}
                {(resolvedFilters || headerActions) && (
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'space-between',
                            flexWrap: 'wrap',
                            gap: 1.5,
                            mb: 2,
                            minWidth: 0,
                        }}
                    >
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                            {resolvedFilters}
                        </Box>
                        {headerActions && (
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                                {headerActions}
                            </Box>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                )}

                {/* ── Line 3: Main Table Card ── */}
                <Paper
                    elevation={0}
                    sx={{
                        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                        borderRadius: '10px',
                        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                        display: 'flex',
                        flexDirection: 'column',
                        flex: 1,
                        overflow: 'hidden',
                        minWidth: 0,
                        width: '100%',
                        boxShadow: '0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)',
                        filter: isDrawerOpen ? 'blur(1.5px)' : 'none',
                        transition: 'filter 0.2s ease-in-out',
                        ...paperSx,
                    }}
                >
                    {/* Search & Action Toolbar */}
                    {resolvedToolbar}

                    {/* Table View */}
                    {resolvedTable}
                    {children}

                    {/* Pagination Bar */}
                    {resolvedPagination}
                </Paper>
            </Box>

            {/* ── Modular Detail Drawer ────────────────────────────────────── */}
            {drawer}

            {/* ── Enterprise CRM Global Footer ─────────────────────────────── */}
            {!hideFooter && (footer || <EnterpriseFooter />)}

            {/* ── Toast Notifications ──────────────────────────────────────── */}
            {toast}
        </Box>
    );
}

export { CommonMasterView as MasterViewLayout };

File: src/components/common/DataTable/DataTable.tsx

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Checkbox,
    Table,
    TableBody,
    TableCell,
    TableContainer,
    TableHead,
    TableRow,
} from '@mui/material';
import ArrowDropUpIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowDropUp';
import ArrowDropDownIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowDropDown';
import UnfoldMoreIcon from '@mui/icons-material/UnfoldMore';
import type { DataTableProps, DataTableColumn } from './types';
import { DataTableEmptyState } from './DataTableEmptyState';
import { TableRowActions } from './TableRowActions';

/**
 * Universal Production-Grade Enterprise Data Table.
 * Reusable across all CRM modules (Organizations, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Invoices, etc.).
 */
export function DataTable<T>({
    data,
    columns,
    keyExtractor = (row: T, idx: number) =>
        String((row as Record<string, unknown>)?.id || `row-${idx}`),
    selectable = true,
    selectedIds,
    onToggleSelectRow,
    onToggleSelectAll,
    isAllSelected,
    isIndeterminate,
    sortField,
    sortOrder = 'asc',
    onSort,
    renderActions,
    onViewRow,
    onEditRow,
    onDeleteRow,
    viewTooltip,
    editTooltip,
    deleteTooltip,
    actionsPosition = 'left',
    actionsWidth = 70,
    actionsHeaderLabel = 'ACTIONS',
    onRowClick,
    activeRowId,
    emptyState,
    emptyIcon,
    emptyTitle,
    emptyDescription,
    emptyActionLabel,
    onEmptyAction,
    minHeight = 280,
    stickyHeader = true,
}: DataTableProps<T>) {
    // Determine row selection state helper
    const isRowSelected = (rowId: string): boolean => {
        if (!selectedIds) return false;
        if (selectedIds instanceof Set) {
            return selectedIds.has(rowId);
        }
        if (Array.isArray(selectedIds)) {
            return selectedIds.includes(rowId);
        }
        return false;
    };

    // Calculate selection states if not passed explicitly
    const computedAllSelected =
        isAllSelected !== undefined
            ? isAllSelected
            : data.length > 0 &&
              data.every((item, idx) => isRowSelected(keyExtractor(item, idx)));

    const computedSomeSelected =
        isIndeterminate !== undefined
            ? isIndeterminate
            : !computedAllSelected &&
              data.some((item, idx) => isRowSelected(keyExtractor(item, idx)));

    // Empty state fallback
    if (data.length === 0) {
        if (emptyState) {
            return <>{emptyState}</>;
        }
        return (
            <DataTableEmptyState
                icon={emptyIcon}
                title={emptyTitle}
                description={emptyDescription}
                actionLabel={emptyActionLabel}
                onAction={onEmptyAction}
            />
        );
    }

    // Action presence check (view is now triggered by clicking the row)
    const hasActions = Boolean(renderActions || onEditRow || onDeleteRow);

    // Row click handler: row click opens the view
    const handleRowClick = onRowClick || onViewRow;

    const renderActionButtons = (row: T, index: number) => {
        if (renderActions) {
            return renderActions(row, index);
        }
        return (
            <TableRowActions
                onView={onViewRow ? () => onViewRow(row) : undefined}
                onEdit={onEditRow ? () => onEditRow(row) : undefined}
                onDelete={onDeleteRow ? () => onDeleteRow(row) : undefined}
                viewTooltip={viewTooltip}
                editTooltip={editTooltip}
                deleteTooltip={deleteTooltip}
            />
        );
    };

    // Actions cell renderer
    const renderActionsHeader = () => (
        <TableCell
            sx={{
                backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                color: '#64748b',
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: '0.74rem',
                letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                py: 1.2,
                width: actionsWidth,
                textAlign: actionsPosition === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left',
            }}
        >
            {actionsHeaderLabel}
        </TableCell>
    );

    return (
        <TableContainer
            sx={{
                flex: 1,
                minHeight,
                width: '100%',
                maxWidth: '100%',
                overflowX: 'auto',
                overflowY: 'auto',
                WebkitOverflowScrolling: 'touch',
                '&::-webkit-scrollbar': {
                    width: '8px',
                    height: '8px',
                },
                '&::-webkit-scrollbar-track': {
                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                },
                '&::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb': {
                    backgroundColor: '#cbd5e1',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                    '&:hover': {
                        backgroundColor: '#94a3b8',
                    },
                },
            }}
        >
            <Table
                stickyHeader={stickyHeader}
                size="small"
                sx={{
                    minWidth: 'max-content',
                    width: '100%',
                    tableLayout: 'auto',
                }}
            >
                {/* ── Table Header ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
                <TableHead>
                    <TableRow sx={{ backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' }}>
                        {/* Checkbox Column */}
                        {selectable && (
                            <TableCell
                                padding="checkbox"
                                sx={{
                                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                                    borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                    width: 40,
                                    pl: 1.5,
                                }}
                            >
                                <Checkbox
                                    size="small"
                                    checked={computedAllSelected}
                                    indeterminate={computedSomeSelected}
                                    onChange={(e) => onToggleSelectAll?.(e.target.checked)}
                                    sx={{
                                        p: 0.5,
                                        color: '#94a3b8',
                                        '&.Mui-checked': { color: '#2563eb' },
                                    }}
                                />
                            </TableCell>
                        )}

                        {/* Actions on Left */}
                        {hasActions && actionsPosition === 'left' && renderActionsHeader()}

                        {/* Configurable Columns */}
                        {columns.map((col: DataTableColumn<T>) => {
                            const isSorted = sortField && (col.sortKey || col.id) === sortField;
                            const isSortable = col.sortable && onSort;

                            return (
                                <TableCell
                                    key={col.id}
                                    align={col.align || 'left'}
                                    onClick={
                                        isSortable
                                            ? () => onSort?.(col.sortKey || col.id)
                                            : undefined
                                    }
                                    sx={{
                                        backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                                        borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                        color: isSorted ? '#1e3a8a' : '#64748b',
                                        fontWeight: 700,
                                        fontSize: '0.74rem',
                                        letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                                        py: 1.2,
                                        width: col.width,
                                        minWidth: col.minWidth,
                                        cursor: isSortable ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                                        userSelect: 'none',
                                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                                        transition: 'color 0.15s ease',
                                        '&:hover': isSortable ? { color: '#1e293b' } : {},
                                    }}
                                >
                                    <Box
                                        sx={{
                                            display: 'flex',
                                            alignItems: 'center',
                                            gap: 0.5,
                                            justifyContent:
                                                col.align === 'right'
                                                    ? 'flex-end'
                                                    : col.align === 'center'
                                                    ? 'center'
                                                    : 'flex-start',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <span>{col.label}</span>
                                        {isSortable && (
                                            <Box
                                                component="span"
                                                sx={{
                                                    display: 'inline-flex',
                                                    color: isSorted ? '#2563eb' : '#94a3b8',
                                                }}
                                            >
                                                {isSorted ? (
                                                    sortOrder === 'asc' ? (
                                                        <ArrowDropUpIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                                                    ) : (
                                                        <ArrowDropDownIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                                                    )
                                                ) : (
                                                    <UnfoldMoreIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
                                                )}
                                            </Box>
                                        )}
                                    </Box>
                                </TableCell>
                            );
                        })}

                        {/* Actions on Right */}
                        {hasActions && actionsPosition === 'right' && renderActionsHeader()}
                    </TableRow>
                </TableHead>

                {/* ── Table Body ───────────────────────────────────────────── */}
                <TableBody>
                    {data.map((row: T, index: number) => {
                        const rowId = keyExtractor(row, index);
                        const isSelected = isRowSelected(rowId);
                        const isActive = Boolean(activeRowId && activeRowId === rowId);

                        return (
                            <TableRow
                                key={rowId}
                                hover
                                selected={isSelected || isActive}
                                onClick={handleRowClick ? () => handleRowClick(row) : undefined}
                                sx={{
                                    cursor: handleRowClick ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                                    transition: 'background-color 0.12s ease',
                                    '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                                    ...(isActive && {
                                        backgroundColor: '#eff6ff !important',
                                        boxShadow: 'inset 3px 0 0 #2563eb',
                                    }),
                                    '&.Mui-selected': {
                                        backgroundColor: '#eff6ff !important',
                                    },
                                    '&.Mui-selected:hover': {
                                        backgroundColor: '#dbeafe !important',
                                    },
                                }}
                            >
                                {/* Checkbox Cell */}
                                {selectable && (
                                    <TableCell
                                        padding="checkbox"
                                        sx={{ pl: 1.5, py: 1 }}
                                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                    >
                                        <Checkbox
                                            size="small"
                                            checked={isSelected}
                                            onChange={() => onToggleSelectRow?.(rowId)}
                                            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                            sx={{
                                                p: 0.5,
                                                color: '#cbd5e1',
                                                '&.Mui-checked': { color: '#2563eb' },
                                            }}
                                        />
                                    </TableCell>
                                )}

                                {/* Actions Cell Left */}
                                {hasActions && actionsPosition === 'left' && (
                                    <TableCell
                                        sx={{
                                            py: 1,
                                            borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                                            width: actionsWidth,
                                        }}
                                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                    >
                                        {renderActionButtons(row, index)}
                                    </TableCell>
                                )}

                                {/* Column Data Cells */}
                                {columns.map((col: DataTableColumn<T>) => {
                                    let cellContent: React.ReactNode = null;

                                    if (col.render) {
                                        cellContent = col.render(row, index);
                                    } else if (typeof col.accessor === 'function') {
                                        cellContent = col.accessor(row);
                                    } else if (col.accessor) {
                                        cellContent = (row as Record<string, React.ReactNode>)[
                                            String(col.accessor)
                                        ];
                                    } else {
                                        cellContent = (row as Record<string, React.ReactNode>)[col.id];
                                    }

                                    return (
                                        <TableCell
                                            key={col.id}
                                            align={col.align || 'left'}
                                            sx={{
                                                py: 1.2,
                                                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                                                color: '#334155',
                                                borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                                                maxWidth: col.width,
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            {cellContent}
                                        </TableCell>
                                    );
                                })}

                                {/* Actions Cell Right */}
                                {hasActions && actionsPosition === 'right' && (
                                    <TableCell
                                        align="right"
                                        sx={{
                                            py: 1,
                                            borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                                            width: actionsWidth,
                                        }}
                                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                    >
                                        {renderActionButtons(row, index)}
                                    </TableCell>
                                )}
                            </TableRow>
                        );
                    })}
                </TableBody>
            </Table>
        </TableContainer>
    );
}
