'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import type { DataTableFilterPillsProps } from './types';

export function DataTableFilterPills<TFilter extends string = string>({
    filters,
    activeFilter,
    onFilterChange,
    variant = 'chip',
}: DataTableFilterPillsProps<TFilter>) {
    if (variant === 'pill') {
        const pillBaseSx = (isActive: boolean) => ({
            px: 1.8,
            py: 0.6,
            borderRadius: '8px',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            fontSize: '0.8rem',
            fontWeight: isActive ? 700 : 500,
            backgroundColor: isActive ? '#eff6ff' : '#fff',
            color: isActive ? '#1d4ed8' : '#475569',
            border: isActive ? '1px solid #93c5fd' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
            boxShadow: isActive ? '0 1px 2px rgba(37,99,235,0.1)' : 'none',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: 0.8,
            transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
            '&:hover': { borderColor: '#93c5fd', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' },
        });

        return (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                {filters.map((tab) => {
                    const isActive = activeFilter === tab.id;
                    return (
                        <Box
                            key={tab.id}
                            onClick={() => onFilterChange(tab.id)}
                            sx={pillBaseSx(isActive)}
                        >
                            {tab.icon}
                            {tab.dotColor && (
                                <Box
                                    sx={{
                                        width: 6,
                                        height: 6,
                                        borderRadius: '50%',
                                        backgroundColor: tab.dotColor,
                                    }}
                                />
                            )}
                            {tab.label}
                            {tab.count !== undefined && (
                                <Typography
                                    component="span"
                                    sx={{
                                        fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                        fontWeight: tab.id === 'all' ? 700 : 400,
                                        color: isActive && tab.id === 'all' ? '#1d4ed8' : '#64748b',
                                    }}
                                >
                                    {tab.count.toLocaleString()}
                                </Typography>
                            )}
                        </Box>
                    );
                })}
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1, overflowX: 'auto', pb: 0.5 }}>
            {filters.map((tab) => {
                const isActive = activeFilter === tab.id;
                const tabColor = tab.activeColor || '#1d4ed8';
                const activeBg = tab.activeBgColor || '#eff6ff';
                const activeBadgeBg = tab.activeBadgeBgColor || '#dbeafe';

                return (
                    <Chip
                        key={tab.id}
                        icon={
                            tab.icon
                                ? React.cloneElement(tab.icon as React.ReactElement<{ sx?: object }>, {
                                      sx: {
                                          fontSize: 15,
                                          color: isActive ? `${tabColor} !important` : '#64748b !important',
                                      },
                                  })
                                : undefined
                        }
                        label={
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.75 }}>
                                <span>{tab.label}</span>
                                {tab.count !== undefined && (
                                    <Box
                                        component="span"
                                        sx={{
                                            px: 0.75,
                                            py: 0.1,
                                            borderRadius: '10px',
                                            fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                            fontWeight: 700,
                                            backgroundColor: isActive ? activeBadgeBg : '#e2e8f0',
                                            color: isActive ? (tab.activeColor || '#1e40af') : '#475569',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {tab.count}
                                    </Box>
                                )}
                            </Box>
                        }
                        onClick={() => onFilterChange(tab.id)}
                        sx={{
                            backgroundColor: isActive ? activeBg : '#ffffff',
                            color: isActive ? tabColor : '#334155',
                            border: isActive
                                ? `1.5px solid ${tab.activeColor || '#3b82f6'}`
                                : '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                            fontWeight: isActive ? 700 : 500,
                            fontSize: '0.8rem',
                            height: 32,
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                            '&:hover': {
                                backgroundColor: isActive ? activeBadgeBg : '#f8fafc',
                            },
                        }}
                    />
                );
            })}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Button,
    FormControl,
    IconButton,
    MenuItem,
    Select,
    Typography,
} from '@mui/material';
import ChevronLeftIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChevronLeft';
import ChevronRightIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ChevronRight';
import type { DataTablePaginationProps } from './types';

export function DataTablePagination({
    page,
    rowsPerPage,
    totalCount,
    onPageChange,
    onRowsPerPageChange,
    pageSizeOptions = [10, 25, 50],
    variant = 'compact',
    entityLabel = 'Records',
    displayTotalCount,
    hideWhenEmpty = false,
}: DataTablePaginationProps) {
    if (hideWhenEmpty && totalCount === 0) {
        return null;
    }

    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalCount / rowsPerPage));
    const startItem = totalCount === 0 ? 0 : page * rowsPerPage + 1;
    const endItem = Math.min((page + 1) * rowsPerPage, totalCount);

    if (variant === 'full') {
        const currentPage1Based = page + 1;
        return (
            <Box
                sx={{
                    p: 1.8,
                    borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                    gap: 2,
                }}
            >
                {/* Left: Rows per page & showing records */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                            Rows per page:
                        </Typography>
                        <FormControl size="small">
                            <Select
                                value={rowsPerPage}
                                onChange={(e) => onRowsPerPageChange(Number(e.target.value))}
                                sx={{
                                    height: 28,
                                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                    borderRadius: '6px',
                                    '& .MuiSelect-select': { py: 0.4, px: 1 },
                                }}
                            >
                                {pageSizeOptions.map((size) => (
                                    <MenuItem key={size} value={size}>
                                        {size}
                                    </MenuItem>
                                ))}
                            </Select>
                        </FormControl>
                    </Box>

                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        Showing{' '}
                        <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                            {startItem} - {endItem}
                        </Typography>{' '}
                        of{' '}
                        <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                            {displayTotalCount ?? totalCount.toLocaleString()}
                        </Typography>{' '}
                        {entityLabel}
                    </Typography>
                </Box>

                {/* Right: Full Pagination Navigation Buttons */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        disabled={currentPage1Based === 1}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(0)}
                        sx={{
                            textTransform: 'none',
                            fontSize: '0.76rem',
                            color: '#64748b',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            minWidth: 44,
                            height: 28,
                            py: 0,
                        }}
                    >
                        First
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        disabled={currentPage1Based === 1}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(0, page - 1))}
                        sx={{
                            textTransform: 'none',
                            fontSize: '0.76rem',
                            color: '#64748b',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            minWidth: 44,
                            height: 28,
                            py: 0,
                        }}
                    >
                        Prev
                    </Button>

                    {/* Page number buttons */}
                    {Array.from({ length: Math.min(3, totalPages) }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((pageNum) => (
                        <Button
                            key={pageNum}
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() => onPageChange(pageNum - 1)}
                            sx={{
                                minWidth: 28,
                                height: 28,
                                p: 0,
                                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                                fontWeight: currentPage1Based === pageNum ? 700 : 500,
                                backgroundColor: currentPage1Based === pageNum ? '#eff6ff' : 'transparent',
                                color: currentPage1Based === pageNum ? '#1d4ed8' : '#64748b',
                                border: currentPage1Based === pageNum ? '1px solid #93c5fd' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                borderRadius: '6px',
                            }}
                        >
                            {pageNum}
                        </Button>
                    ))}

                    {totalPages > 3 && (
                        <>
                            <Typography sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.76rem' }}>...</Typography>
                            <Button
                                size="small"
                                onClick={() => onPageChange(totalPages - 1)}
                                sx={{
                                    minWidth: 32,
                                    height: 28,
                                    p: 0,
                                    fontSize: '0.76rem',
                                    fontWeight: 500,
                                    color: '#64748b',
                                    border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                    borderRadius: '6px',
                                }}
                            >
                                457
                            </Button>
                        </>
                    )}

                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        disabled={currentPage1Based >= totalPages}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages - 1, page + 1))}
                        sx={{
                            textTransform: 'none',
                            fontSize: '0.76rem',
                            color: '#64748b',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            minWidth: 44,
                            height: 28,
                            py: 0,
                        }}
                    >
                        Next
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                        size="small"
                        disabled={currentPage1Based >= totalPages}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(totalPages - 1)}
                        sx={{
                            textTransform: 'none',
                            fontSize: '0.76rem',
                            color: '#64748b',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            minWidth: 44,
                            height: 28,
                            py: 0,
                        }}
                    >
                        Last
                    </Button>
                </Box>
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                px: 2,
                py: 1,
                borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                gap: 2,
                backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            }}
        >
            {/* Rows per page selector */}
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                    Rows per page:
                </Typography>
                <Select
                    size="small"
                    value={rowsPerPage}
                    onChange={(e) => onRowsPerPageChange(Number(e.target.value))}
                    sx={{
                        fontSize: '0.78rem',
                        height: 28,
                        '& .MuiSelect-select': { py: 0.5, px: 1 },
                        '& .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1' },
                    }}
                >
                    {pageSizeOptions.map((size) => (
                        <MenuItem key={size} value={size}>
                            {size}
                        </MenuItem>
                    ))}
                </Select>
            </Box>

            {/* Range and page switcher */}
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                    {totalCount > 0 ? `${startItem}-${endItem} of ${totalCount}` : '0 of 0'}
                </Typography>

                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                    <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        disabled={page === 0}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(page - 1)}
                        sx={{
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            p: 0.4,
                            '&:disabled': { opacity: 0.4 },
                        }}
                    >
                        <ChevronLeftIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                    </IconButton>

                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#334155', px: 0.5 }}>
                        {page + 1} / {totalPages}
                    </Typography>

                    <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        disabled={page >= totalPages - 1}
                        onClick={() => onPageChange(page + 1)}
                        sx={{
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            p: 0.4,
                            '&:disabled': { opacity: 0.4 },
                        }}
                    >
                        <ChevronRightIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                    </IconButton>
                </Box>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    IconButton,
    InputAdornment,
    InputBase,
    Menu,
    MenuItem,
    TextField,
    Tooltip,
    Typography,
} from '@mui/material';
import SearchIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Search';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import RefreshIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Refresh';
import DeleteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';
import KeyboardArrowDownIcon from '@mui/icons-material/KeyboardArrowDown';
import FilterListIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FilterList';
import ViewColumnIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ViewColumn';
import ClearIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import type { DataTableToolbarProps } from './types';

export function DataTableToolbar({
    searchQuery,
    onSearchChange,
    searchPlaceholder = 'Search records...',
    searchWidth = { xs: '100%', sm: 320 },
    onNewClick,
    newButtonLabel = 'New Record',
    onRefresh,
    refreshTooltip = 'Refresh',
    selectedCount = 0,
    onBulkDelete,
    bulkDeleteLabel = 'Delete Selected',
    extraActions,
    variant = 'standard',
    isAllPageSelected = false,
    isSomePageSelected = false,
    onToggleSelectAll,
    onSelectAllMatching,
    onSelectVisible,
    onDeselectAll,
    totalRecords = 0,
    displayTotalRecords,
    currentPage = 1,
    rowsPerPage = 25,
    totalPages = 1,
    onPageChange,
    bulkActionItems = [],
    onFilterClick,
    onColumnClick,
}: DataTableToolbarProps) {
    const [selectMenuAnchor, setSelectMenuAnchor] = useState<null | HTMLElement>(null);
    const [bulkMenuAnchor, setBulkMenuAnchor] = useState<null | HTMLElement>(null);

    if (variant === 'extended') {
        return (
            <Box
                sx={{
                    p: 1.5,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    flexWrap: 'wrap',
                    gap: 1.5,
                    borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
                }}
            >
                {/* Left Controls */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                    {/* Checkbox with dropdown */}
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                        <Checkbox
                            size="small"
                            checked={isAllPageSelected}
                            indeterminate={isSomePageSelected}
                            onChange={onToggleSelectAll}
                            sx={{ p: 0.5, color: '#94a3b8', '&.Mui-checked': { color: '#2563eb' } }}
                        />
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            onClick={(e) => setSelectMenuAnchor(e.currentTarget)}
                            sx={{ p: 0.2, color: '#94a3b8' }}
                        >
                            <KeyboardArrowDownIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
                        </IconButton>
                    </Box>

                    <Menu
                        anchorEl={selectMenuAnchor}
                        open={Boolean(selectMenuAnchor)}
                        onClose={() => setSelectMenuAnchor(null)}
                        slotProps={{ paper: { sx: { borderRadius: '8px', minWidth: 160 } } }}
                    >
                        {onSelectAllMatching && (
                            <MenuItem
                                onClick={() => {
                                    setSelectMenuAnchor(null);
                                    onSelectAllMatching();
                                }}
                                sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
                            >
                                Select All ({totalRecords})
                            </MenuItem>
                        )}
                        {onSelectVisible && (
                            <MenuItem
                                onClick={() => {
                                    setSelectMenuAnchor(null);
                                    onSelectVisible();
                                }}
                                sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
                            >
                                Select Visible
                            </MenuItem>
                        )}
                        {onDeselectAll && (
                            <MenuItem
                                onClick={() => {
                                    setSelectMenuAnchor(null);
                                    onDeselectAll();
                                }}
                                sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem' }}
                            >
                                Deselect All
                            </MenuItem>
                        )}
                    </Menu>

                    {/* Bulk Action Dropdown */}
                    {bulkActionItems.length > 0 && (
                        <>
                            <Button
                                variant="outlined"
                                size="small"
                                endIcon={<KeyboardArrowDownIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                onClick={(e) => setBulkMenuAnchor(e.currentTarget)}
                                sx={{
                                    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                                    color: '#334155',
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                    borderRadius: '6px',
                                    height: 32,
                                    px: 1.5,
                                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                                    '&:hover': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                                }}
                            >
                                BULK ACTION
                            </Button>

                            <Menu
                                anchorEl={bulkMenuAnchor}
                                open={Boolean(bulkMenuAnchor)}
                                onClose={() => setBulkMenuAnchor(null)}
                                slotProps={{ paper: { sx: { borderRadius: '8px', minWidth: 190 } } }}
                            >
                                {bulkActionItems.map((item) => (
                                    <MenuItem
                                        key={item.id}
                                        onClick={() => {
                                            setBulkMenuAnchor(null);
                                            item.onClick();
                                        }}
                                        sx={{
                                            fontSize: '0.8rem',
                                            color: item.color === 'error' ? '#ef4444' : undefined,
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        {item.label}
                                    </MenuItem>
                                ))}
                            </Menu>
                        </>
                    )}

                    {/* Filter & Column Layout Buttons */}
                    {onFilterClick && (
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            onClick={onFilterClick}
                            sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '6px', width: 32, height: 32, color: '#64748b' }}
                        >
                            <FilterListIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                        </IconButton>
                    )}

                    {onColumnClick && (
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            onClick={onColumnClick}
                            sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '6px', width: 32, height: 32, color: '#64748b' }}
                        >
                            <ViewColumnIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                        </IconButton>
                    )}

                    {/* Search within table */}
                    <TextField
                        size="small"
                        placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
                        value={searchQuery}
                        onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
                        sx={{
                            width: { xs: 180, sm: 260 },
                            '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
                                height: 32,
                                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                                borderRadius: '6px',
                                backgroundColor: '#fff',
                                '& fieldset': { borderColor: '#e2e8f0' },
                                '&:hover fieldset': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1' },
                                '&.Mui-focused fieldset': { borderColor: '#2563eb' },
                            },
                        }}
                        slotProps={{
                            input: {
                                startAdornment: (
                                    <InputAdornment position="start">
                                        <SearchIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                                    </InputAdornment>
                                ),
                                endAdornment: searchQuery ? (
                                    <InputAdornment position="end">
                                        <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => onSearchChange('')} sx={{ p: 0.2 }}>
                                            <ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                                        </IconButton>
                                    </InputAdornment>
                                ) : undefined,
                            },
                        }}
                    />
                </Box>

                {/* Right: Showing records & Mini Pager */}
                {onPageChange && (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                            Showing{' '}
                            <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                {totalRecords === 0 ? 0 : (currentPage - 1) * rowsPerPage + 1} -{' '}
                                {Math.min(currentPage * rowsPerPage, totalRecords)}
                            </Typography>{' '}
                            of{' '}
                            <Typography component="span" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                {displayTotalRecords ?? totalRecords.toLocaleString()}
                            </Typography>{' '}
                            records
                        </Typography>

                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                            <IconButton
                                size="small"
                                disabled={currentPage === 1}
                                onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(1, currentPage - 1))}
                                sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '4px', width: 26, height: 26 }}
                            >
                                &lt;
                            </IconButton>
                            <Box
                                sx={{
                                    width: 26,
                                    height: 26,
                                    display: 'flex',
                                    alignItems: 'center',
                                    justifyContent: 'center',
                                    border: '1px solid #93c5fd',
                                    borderRadius: '4px',
                                    backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    fontSize: '0.76rem',
                                }}
                            >
                                {currentPage}
                            </Box>
                            <IconButton
                                size="small"
                                disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
                                onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1))}
                                sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '4px', width: 26, height: 26 }}
                            >
                                &gt;
                            </IconButton>
                            <IconButton
                                size="small"
                                disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
                                onClick={() => onPageChange(totalPages)}
                                sx={{ border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: '4px', width: 26, height: 26 }}
                            >
                                &gt;&gt;
                            </IconButton>
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                )}
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                p: 1.5,
                borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                gap: 1.5,
                backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            }}
        >
            {/* Search Input Box */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 1,
                    px: 1.5,
                    py: 0.5,
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                    width: searchWidth,
                    '&:focus-within': {
                        borderColor: '#2563eb',
                        backgroundColor: '#fff',
                        boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(37,99,235,0.1)',
                    },
                }}
            >
                <SearchIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                <InputBase
                    placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
                    value={searchQuery}
                    onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
                    sx={{
                        fontSize: '0.82rem',
                        color: '#1e293b',
                        width: '100%',
                    }}
                />
            </Box>

            {/* Actions: Bulk selection or primary actions */}
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                {selectedCount > 0 ? (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1d4ed8' }}>
                            {selectedCount} selected
                        </Typography>
                        {onBulkDelete && (
                            <Button
                                size="small"
                                variant="outlined"
                                color="error"
                                startIcon={<DeleteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                                onClick={onBulkDelete}
                                sx={{
                                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    borderRadius: '6px',
                                    height: 32,
                                }}
                            >
                                {bulkDeleteLabel}
                            </Button>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ) : null}

                {extraActions}

                {onRefresh && (
                    <Tooltip title={refreshTooltip}>
                        <IconButton
                            size="small"
                            onClick={onRefresh}
                            sx={{
                                color: '#64748b',
                                border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                borderRadius: '8px',
                                p: 0.8,
                                '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9', color: '#1d4ed8' },
                            }}
                        >
                            <RefreshIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />
                        </IconButton>
                    </Tooltip>
                )}

                {onNewClick && (
                    <Button
                        variant="contained"
                        startIcon={<AddIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                        onClick={onNewClick}
                        sx={{
                            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 100%)',
                            borderRadius: '8px',
                            textTransform: 'none',
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            fontSize: '0.82rem',
                            height: 34,
                            px: 2,
                            boxShadow: '0 2px 6px rgba(37,99,235,0.25)',
                            '&:hover': { background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1e40af 0%, #1d4ed8 100%)' },
                        }}
                    >
                        {newButtonLabel}
                    </Button>
                )}
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, IconButton, Tooltip } from '@mui/material';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import DeleteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DeleteOutlined';

export interface TableRowActionsProps {
    onView?: () => void;
    onEdit?: () => void;
    onDelete?: () => void;
    viewTooltip?: string;
    editTooltip?: string;
    deleteTooltip?: string;
    children?: React.ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Standardized Enterprise Table Row Actions Component.
 * Ensures 100% visual and behavioral consistency across all table views in the CRM.
 */
export function TableRowActions({
    onEdit,
    onDelete,
    editTooltip = 'Edit',
    deleteTooltip = 'Delete',
    children,
}: TableRowActionsProps) {
    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>

            {onEdit && (
                <Tooltip title={editTooltip}>
                    <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onEdit();
                        }}
                        sx={{
                            color: '#64748b',
                            p: 0.5,
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            '&:hover': { color: '#2563eb', backgroundColor: '#eff6ff' },
                        }}
                    >
                        <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                    </IconButton>
                </Tooltip>
            )}

            {onDelete && (
                <Tooltip title={deleteTooltip}>
                    <IconButton
                        size="small"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onDelete();
                        }}
                        sx={{
                            color: '#64748b',
                            p: 0.5,
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            '&:hover': { color: '#dc2626', backgroundColor: '#fef2f2' },
                        }}
                    >
                        <DeleteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                    </IconButton>
                </Tooltip>
            )}

            {children}
        </Box>
    );
}

    actionsWidth?: number | string;

    emptyIcon?: React.ReactNode;
    emptyTitle?: string;

    emptyActionLabel?: string;

    // Container styling
    minHeight?: number | string;

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Typography,
    IconButton,
    Chip,
    Tooltip,
    type SxProps,
    type Theme,
} from '@mui/material';
import ContentCopyOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ContentCopyOutlined';

export function copyToClipboard(text: string) {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    }
}

export interface DrawerCopyButtonProps {
    text: string;
    title?: string;
    iconColor?: string;
}

export function DrawerCopyButton({ text, title = 'Copy', iconColor }: DrawerCopyButtonProps) {
    return (
        <Tooltip title={title}>
            <IconButton size="small" onClick={() => copyToClipboard(text)}>
                <ContentCopyOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: iconColor }} />
            </IconButton>
        </Tooltip>
    );
}

export interface DrawerSectionCardProps {
    title?: React.ReactNode;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    action?: React.ReactNode;
    bg?: string;
    borderColor?: string;
    p?: number;
    titleSx?: SxProps<Theme>;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
    children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function DrawerSectionCard({
    title,
    icon,
    action,
    bg = '#ffffff',
    borderColor = '#e2e8f0',
    p = 2,
    titleSx,
    sx,
    children,
}: DrawerSectionCardProps) {
    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                p,
                borderRadius: '8px',
                backgroundColor: bg,
                border: `1px solid ${borderColor}`,
                ...sx,
            }}
        >
            {(title || icon || action) && (
                <Box
                    sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        mb: icon || action ? 1.2 : 0.5,
                    }}
                >
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                        {icon}
                        {typeof title === 'string' ? (
                            <Typography
                                sx={{
                                    fontSize: icon ? '0.78rem' : '0.68rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: icon ? '#0f172a' : '#64748b',
                                    letterSpacing: icon ? undefined : '0.04em',
                                    ...titleSx,
                                }}
                            >
                                {title}
                            </Typography>
                        ) : (
                            title
                        )}
                    </Box>
                    {action}
                </Box>
            )}
            {children}
        </Box>
    );
}

export interface DrawerMetricItem {
    label: string;
    value: React.ReactNode;
    sublabel?: React.ReactNode;
    bg?: string;
    borderColor?: string;
    labelColor?: string;
    valueColor?: string;
    valueSize?: string;
    valueWeight?: number;
    monospace?: boolean;
    p?: number;
}

export interface DrawerMetricGridProps {
    items: DrawerMetricItem[];
    columns?: number;
    gap?: number;
}

export function DrawerMetricGrid({ items, columns = 2, gap = 1.5 }: DrawerMetricGridProps) {
    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${columns}, 1fr)`, gap }}>
            {items.map((item, idx) => (
                <Box
                    key={idx}
                    sx={{
                        p: item.p ?? 1.5,
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        backgroundColor: item.bg || '#ffffff',
                        border: `1px solid ${item.borderColor || '#e2e8f0'}`,
                    }}
                >
                    <Typography
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.68rem',
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            color: item.labelColor || '#64748b',
                            letterSpacing: '0.04em',
                        }}
                    >
                        {item.label}
                    </Typography>
                    {typeof item.value === 'string' || typeof item.value === 'number' ? (
                        <Typography
                            sx={{
                                fontSize: item.valueSize || '0.88rem',
                                fontWeight: item.valueWeight || 700,
                                color: item.valueColor || '#0f172a',
                                fontFamily: item.monospace ? 'monospace' : 'inherit',
                                mt: 0.3,
                            }}
                        >
                            {item.value}
                        </Typography>
                    ) : (
                        <Box sx={{ mt: 0.3 }}>{item.value}</Box>
                    )}
                    {item.sublabel && (
                        typeof item.sublabel === 'string' ? (
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.5 }}>
                                {item.sublabel}
                            </Typography>
                        ) : (
                            item.sublabel
                        )
                    )}
                </Box>
            ))}
        </Box>
    );
}

import React from 'react';
import type { SxProps, Theme } from '@mui/material';

export interface DrawerTabItem {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    icon: React.ReactNode;
    badge?: React.ReactNode | number | string;
    content: React.ReactNode;
}

export interface AuditRevisionItem {
    title: string;
    author: string;
    time: string;
    from?: string;
    to?: string;
    note?: string;
    tag?: string;
}

export interface DrawerBadgeItem {
    label: string;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    color?: string;
    backgroundColor?: string;
    borderColor?: string;
    isMonospace?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Standard form tab definition exported by creation forms.
 * Represents the single source of truth for tab identification, label, and icon.
 */
export interface FormTabDefinition {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    icon: React.ReactNode;
    sublabel?: string;
    badge?: React.ReactNode | number | string;
    hasDot?: boolean;
}


export interface DrawerActionButtonProps {
    label: string;
    onClick: () => void;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    variant?: 'text' | 'outlined' | 'contained';
    disabled?: boolean;
    tooltip?: string;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

export interface EntityDetailDrawerProps {
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    avatarText?: string;
    avatarIcon?: React.ReactNode;
    avatarBg?: string;
    verified?: boolean;
    loading?: boolean;
    badges?: DrawerBadgeItem[];
    headerActions?: {
        onEdit?: () => void;
        onSync?: () => void;
        onPhone?: () => void;
        custom?: React.ReactNode;
    };
    tabs?: DrawerTabItem[];
    formTabs?: readonly FormTabDefinition[] | FormTabDefinition[];
    tabContents?: Record<string, React.ReactNode>;
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    auditRevisions?: AuditRevisionItem[];
    includeChangesTab?: boolean; // Default true: automatically attaches the standardized 'Changes' tab
    changesTabLabel?: string; // Default 'Changes'
    defaultTabIndex?: number;
    statusText?: string;
    primaryAction?: DrawerActionButtonProps;
    secondaryAction?: DrawerActionButtonProps;
    footerActions?: React.ReactNode;
    width?: number | string | { xs?: string | number; sm?: string | number; md?: string | number };
}

/**
 * Dynamically builds DrawerTabItem[] by mapping directly over the creation form's exported tab definitions.
 * Eliminates duplicate/hardcoded labels across side drawers and guarantees 100% sync with creation forms.
 */
export function buildDrawerTabs<T extends string = string>(
    formTabs: readonly FormTabDefinition[] | FormTabDefinition[],
    contentMap: Partial<Record<T, React.ReactNode>>
): DrawerTabItem[] {
    return formTabs.map((tab) => ({
        id: tab.id,
        label: tab.label,
        icon: tab.icon,
        badge: tab.badge,
        content: contentMap[tab.id as T] || null,
    }));
}

"use client";

import { Alert } from '@mui/material';

interface ErrorAlertProps {
    id?: string;
    error: string | null;
    onClose?: () => void;
}

export function ErrorAlert({ id = 'error-alert', error, onClose }: ErrorAlertProps) {
    if (!error) return null;

    return (
        <Alert
            id={id}
            severity="error"
            sx={{ mb: 2.5, borderRadius: '10px', fontSize: '13px' }}
            onClose={onClose}
        >
            {error}
        </Alert>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Divider } from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import ContactPhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ContactPhoneOutlined';
import BusinessOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BusinessOutlined';
import TuneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TuneOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { ROUTES } from '../../config/constants';
import type { ContactFormData } from '../../types/contact.types';
import { contactService } from '@/services';
import { contactFormSchema } from '../../validations';

import { CommonFormLayout } from '../common/CommonFormLayout';

// Reusable Production-grade Form Primitives
import { SectionLabel, useRhfForm } from '@/components/forms';

// Modular Contact Form Sections
import {
    ContactBasicInfoSection,
    ContactPhonesEmailsSection,
    ContactAssignmentSection,
    ContactPreferencesSection,
} from './sections';

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Contact Form Tabs ──────────────────────────────
export const CONTACT_FORM_TABS: FormTabDefinition[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />,
    },
];

export interface ContactFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit';
    initialData?: Partial<ContactFormData>;
    contactId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

const DEFAULT_FORM: ContactFormData = {
    name: '',
    organizationName: '',
    mobile: '',
    officePhone: '',
    phone3: '',
    phone4: '',
    phone5: '',
    emailAddresses: [
        {
            id: 'email-1',
            email: '',
            isPrimary: true,
            isOptedOut: false,
            isInvalidBounce: false,
        },
    ],
    assignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',
    isPrimaryContact: false,
    designation: '',
    department: '',
    location: '',
    leftJob: 'No',
    communicationType: ['Call', 'Email'],
    doNotCall: false,
    description: '',
};

const sectionDividerSx = { my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' } as const;

export default function ContactForm({
    mode = 'create',
    initialData,
    contactId,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: ContactFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } = useRhfForm<ContactFormData>({
        schema: contactFormSchema,
        defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData },
    });
    const { reset, watch, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;
    const contactName = watch('name');

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Sales' },
        { label: 'Contacts', href: ROUTES.CONTACTS },
        { label: mode === 'edit' ? (contactName ? `Edit: ${contactName}` : 'Edit Contact') : 'Create Contact' },
    ];

    // Populate data when editing
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!contactId) return;
        let active = true;
        contactService
            .getById(contactId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) reset({ ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...found });
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [contactId, reset]);

    const handleSave = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            if (contactId && contactService.getByIdSync(contactId)) {
                await contactService.update(contactId, values);
            } else {
                await contactService.create(values);
            }
            showToast(`Contact "${values.name}" saved successfully!`, 'success');
            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACTS), 700);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to save contact.', 'error');
        }
    });

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (isDirty && !window.confirm('Discard unsaved contact changes?')) return;
        router.push(ROUTES.CONTACTS);
    };

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={CONTACT_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab="overview"
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Contact' : 'Save Contact'}
                cancelLabel="Cancel"
                toast={<AppToast open={toast.open} message={toast.message} severity={toast.severity} onClose={closeToast} />}
            >
                <SectionLabel icon={<ContactPhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Contact Details & Association" />
                <ContactBasicInfoSection />

                <Divider sx={sectionDividerSx} />

                <SectionLabel icon={<ContactPhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Alternate Communication Channels" />
                <ContactPhonesEmailsSection />

                <Divider sx={sectionDividerSx} />

                <SectionLabel icon={<BusinessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Internal Assignment & Department Role" />
                <ContactAssignmentSection />

                <Divider sx={sectionDividerSx} />

                <SectionLabel icon={<TuneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />} label="Communication Preferences & Notes" />
                <ContactPreferencesSection />
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import StarBorderIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StarBorder';
import ScheduleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Schedule';
import AccountCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountCircleOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import EmailOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../../common/CommonMasterView';
import { AppToast } from '../../common/AppToast';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '../../../config/constants';
import { contactService, subscribeCrmSync } from '@/services';
import type { Contact } from '../../../types/contact.types';
import type { ContactFilterTab } from './types';
import { ContactDetailDrawer } from '../ContactDetailDrawer';

export function ContactsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();

    const [contacts, setContacts] = useState<Contact[]>([]);
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ContactFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<string>('name');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
    const [selectedDrawerContact, setSelectedDrawerContact] = useState<Contact | null>(null);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    // ── Load Contacts via Service Layer ─────────────────────────────────────
    const loadContacts = useCallback(() => {
        const data = contactService.getAllSync();
        setContacts(data);
        setSelectedDrawerContact((prev) => {
            if (!prev) return null;
            return data.find((c) => c.id === prev.id) || null;
        });
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        contactService
            .getAll()
            .then((data) => {
                if (active) {
                    setContacts(data);
                    setSelectedDrawerContact((prev) => {
                        if (!prev) return null;
                        return data.find((c) => c.id === prev.id) || null;
                    });
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleFocus = () => {
            loadContacts();
        };
        const handleVisibility = () => {
            if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                loadContacts();
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(loadContacts);

        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
            document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
            unsubscribe();
        };
    }, [loadContacts]);

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<ContactFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        const primary = contacts.filter((c) => c.isPrimaryContact).length;
        const myContacts = contacts.filter((c) => c.assignedTo === 'mittal.sharma').length;
        const oneWeekAgo = new Date().getTime() - 7 * 86400000;
        const recentlyAdded = contacts.filter((c) => new Date(c.createdAt).getTime() >= oneWeekAgo).length;

        return [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Contacts',
                icon: <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: contacts.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'primary',
                label: 'Primary Contacts',
                icon: <StarBorderIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: primary,
            },
            {
                id: 'my_contacts',
                label: 'My Contacts',
                icon: <AccountCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: myContacts,
            },
            {
                id: 'recently_added',
                label: 'Recently Added',
                icon: <ScheduleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: recentlyAdded,
            },
        ];
    }, [contacts]);

    // ── Filter & Search Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredContacts = useMemo(() => {
        let result = contacts;

        if (activeTab === 'primary') {
            result = result.filter((c) => c.isPrimaryContact);
        } else if (activeTab === 'my_contacts') {
            result = result.filter((c) => c.assignedTo === 'mittal.sharma');
        } else if (activeTab === 'recently_added') {
            const oneWeekAgo = new Date().getTime() - 7 * 86400000;
            result = result.filter((c) => new Date(c.createdAt).getTime() >= oneWeekAgo);
        }

        if (searchQuery.trim()) {
            const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
            result = result.filter((c) => {
                const name = c.name?.toLowerCase() || '';
                const org = c.organizationName?.toLowerCase() || '';
                const mobile = c.mobile || '';
                const email = c.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email?.toLowerCase() || '';
                const designation = c.designation?.toLowerCase() || '';
                return (
                    name.includes(q) ||
                    org.includes(q) ||
                    mobile.includes(q) ||
                    email.includes(q) ||
                    designation.includes(q)
                );
            });
        }

        if (sortField) {
            result = [...result].sort((a, b) => {
                let valA: string | number = String((a as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] ?? '');
                let valB: string | number = String((b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] ?? '');
                if (sortField === 'email') {
                    valA = a.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email ?? '';
                    valB = b.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email ?? '';
                }
                valA = valA.toLowerCase();
                valB = valB.toLowerCase();
                if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
                if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
                return 0;
            });
        }

        return result;
    }, [contacts, activeTab, searchQuery, sortField, sortOrder]);

    const handleSort = (field: string) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder((prev) => (prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    const paginatedContacts = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return filteredContacts.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [filteredContacts, page, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleToggleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        setSelectedIds((prev) =>
            prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((item) => item !== id) : [...prev, id]
        );
    };

    const handleToggleSelectAll = (checked?: boolean) => {
        if (checked) {
            setSelectedIds(paginatedContacts.map((c) => c.id));
        } else {
            setSelectedIds([]);
        }
    };

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        if (!window.confirm(`Delete ${selectedIds.length} selected contact(s)?`)) return;
        const count = selectedIds.length;
        await contactService.deleteBulk(selectedIds);
        loadContacts();
        setSelectedIds([]);
        setToast({
            open: true,
            message: `${count} contact(s) deleted successfully.`,
            severity: 'success',
        });
    };

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ──────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Contact>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'name',
                label: 'NAME',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 200,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                        <Typography
                            onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                setSelectedDrawerContact(c);
                            }}
                            sx={{
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                color: '#1d4ed8',
                                fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                cursor: 'pointer',
                                '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                            }}
                        >
                            {c.name}
                        </Typography>
                        {c.isPrimaryContact && (
                            <Chip
                                label="Primary"
                                size="small"
                                sx={{
                                    height: 18,
                                    fontSize: '0.64rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                                }}
                            />
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'organizationName',
                label: 'ORGANIZATION',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 180,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                        <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#64748b' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                            {c.organizationName || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'mobile',
                label: 'MOBILE / PHONE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.6 }}>
                        <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                            {c.mobile || c.officePhone || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'email',
                label: 'EMAIL',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 180,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.6 }}>
                        <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                            {c.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email || '-'}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'designation',
                label: 'DESIGNATION',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#334155', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                        {c.designation || c.department || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'assignedTo',
                label: 'ASSIGNED TO',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (c) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {c.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
        ],
        []
    );

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Contact, ContactFilterTab>
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            searchConfig={{
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (v) => {
                    setSearchQuery(v);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by name, organization, phone, email...',
                searchWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: 300 },
                onNewClick: () => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACT_NEW),
                newButtonLabel: 'New Contact',
                onRefresh: () => {
                    loadContacts();
                    setToast({ open: true, message: 'Contacts refreshed.', severity: 'info' });
                },
                refreshTooltip: 'Refresh Contacts',
                selectedCount: selectedIds.length,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
            }}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedContacts}
            keyExtractor={(c) => c.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={handleToggleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={handleToggleSelectAll}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={handleSort}
            onView={(c) => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACT_DETAIL(c.id))}
            onEdit={(c) => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACT_EDIT(c.id))}
            onRowClick={(c) => setSelectedDrawerContact(c)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerContact?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Contact"
            editTooltip="Edit Contact"
            emptyTitle="No contacts recorded yet"
            emptyDescription="Create your first contact person and link them to an active organization account."
            emptyActionLabel="Create Contact"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.CONTACT_NEW)}
            emptyIcon={<PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />}
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: filteredContacts.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onRowsPerPageChange: (size) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(size);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                hideWhenEmpty: true,
            }}
            drawer={
                <ContactDetailDrawer
                    contact={selectedDrawerContact}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerContact)}
                    onClose={() => setSelectedDrawerContact(null)}
                />
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerContact)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        />
    );
}

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Typography, type SxProps, type Theme } from '@mui/material';

export const fieldSx = {
    '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
        borderRadius: '8px',
        backgroundColor: '#fff',
        fontSize: '0.85rem',
        '&:hover .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline': { borderColor: '#2563EB' },
        '&.Mui-focused .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline': {
            borderColor: '#2563EB',
            borderWidth: '1.5px',
        },
    },
    '& .MuiInputLabel-root.Mui-focused': { color: '#2563EB' },
};

export interface FormFieldProps {
    label: string;
    required?: boolean;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
    children: React.ReactNode;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

export function FormField({ label, required, hint, children, sx }: FormFieldProps) {
    return (
        <Box sx={{ mb: 2, ...sx }}>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 0.6 }}>
                <Typography
                    variant="body2"
                    sx={{
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        color: '#374151',
                        fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    }}
                >
                    {label}
                    {required && (
                        <Box component="span" sx={{ color: '#ef4444', ml: 0.4 }}>
                            *
                        </Box>
                    )}
                </Typography>
                {hint && (
                    typeof hint === 'string' ? (
                        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '0.72rem' }}>
                            {hint}
                        </Typography>
                    ) : (
                        hint
                    )
                )}
            </Box>
            {children}
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box } from '@mui/material';
import { AppBreadcrumbs, type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';

export interface FormHeaderProps {
    breadcrumbs?: React.ReactNode;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
    onDiscard?: () => void; // Deprecated: Discard button removed per user requirements
    onSave?: () => void; // Deprecated: top save button removed per requirements
    submitting?: boolean;
    discardLabel?: string;
    extraActions?: React.ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Reusable Form Header with permanent breadcrumbs on the left.
 * Discard action is removed per requirements (Cancel is available in sticky footer).
 */
export function FormHeader({
    breadcrumbs,
    breadcrumbItems,
    extraActions,
}: FormHeaderProps) {
    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                mb: 2.5,
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                gap: 2,
            }}
        >
            {/* Permanent Breadcrumbs (automatic or custom) */}
            {breadcrumbs || <AppBreadcrumbs items={breadcrumbItems} />}

            {extraActions && (
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1.5, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    {extraActions}
                </Box>
            )}
        </Box>
    );
}

                    size="small"
                    onClick={onCancel}
                    disabled={submitting}
                    sx={{
                        borderColor: 'error.main',
                        color: 'error.main',
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        fontSize: '0.82rem',
                        textTransform: 'none',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        px: 2.5,
                        height: 36,
                        '&:hover': {
                            borderColor: 'error.main',
                            backgroundColor: 'error.light',
                            color: '#fff',
                        },
                    }}
                >
                    {cancelLabel}
                </Button>

                <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    size="small"
                    onClick={onSave}
                    disabled={submitting}
                    startIcon={
                        submitting ? (
                            <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" />
                        ) : undefined
                    }
                    sx={{
                        background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 100%)',
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        fontSize: '0.82rem',
                        textTransform: 'none',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        px: 3,
                        height: 36,
                        boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(37,99,235,0.3)',
                        '&:hover': { background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1e40af 0%, #1d4ed8 100%)' },
                    }}
                >
                    {saveLabel}
                </Button>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    TextField,
    IconButton,
    Autocomplete,
    Tooltip,
} from '@mui/material';
import ArrowForwardIosIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArrowForwardIos';
import ClearIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import { fieldSx } from './FormField';

export interface LookupFieldProps {
    value: string;
    onChange: (value: string) => void;
    placeholder?: string;
    options?: string[];
    onSelectClick?: () => void;
    required?: boolean;
}

export function LookupField({
    value,
    onChange,
    placeholder = 'Type or select...',
    options = [],
    onSelectClick,
    required = false,
}: LookupFieldProps) {
    const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState(value);

    const handleClear = () => {
        onChange('');
        setInputValue('');
    };

    return (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
            {options.length > 0 ? (
                <Autocomplete
                    freeSolo
                    options={options}
                    value={value || ''}
                    inputValue={inputValue}
                    onInputChange={(_, newInputValue) => {
                        setInputValue(newInputValue);
                        onChange(newInputValue);
                    }}
                    onChange={(_, newValue) => {
                        onChange(newValue || '');
                    }}
                    sx={{ flex: 1, ...fieldSx }}
                    renderInput={(params) => (
                        <TextField
                            {...params}
                            size="small"
                            placeholder={placeholder}
                            required={required}
                        />
                    )}
                />
            ) : (
                <TextField
                    fullWidth
                    size="small"
                    value={value}
                    onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={placeholder}
                    required={required}
                    sx={fieldSx}
                />
            )}

            {/* Select / Search Action Button */}
            <Tooltip title="Select from Directory">
                <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    onClick={onSelectClick}
                    sx={{
                        width: 34,
                        height: 34,
                        borderRadius: '6px',
                        backgroundColor: '#1e3a8a',
                        color: '#fff',
                        flexShrink: 0,
                        '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#1d4ed8' },
                    }}
                >
                    <ArrowForwardIosIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />
                </IconButton>
            </Tooltip>

            {/* Clear Action Button */}
            <Tooltip title="Clear selection">
                <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    onClick={handleClear}
                    disabled={!value}
                    sx={{
                        width: 34,
                        height: 34,
                        borderRadius: '6px',
                        backgroundColor: '#1e3a8a',
                        color: '#fff',
                        flexShrink: 0,
                        '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#1d4ed8' },
                        '&.Mui-disabled': { backgroundColor: '#e2e8f0', color: '#94a3b8' },
                    }}
                >
                    <ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} />
                </IconButton>
            </Tooltip>
        </Box>
    );
}
