'use client';

import React, { useCallback } from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Typography,
    TextField,
    Button,
    IconButton,
    Select,
    MenuItem,
    FormControl,
    Tooltip,
    Divider,
    Paper,
    Alert,
} from '@mui/material';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import ClearIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Clear';
import { useFormContext, useWatch, type Path, type PathValue } from 'react-hook-form';

import { FormField, fieldSx } from '../FormField';
import {
    OPPORTUNITY_CURRENCIES,
    OPPORTUNITY_TAX_RATES,
    type OpportunityLineItem,
} from '@/types/opportunity.types';

export type CrmLineItem = OpportunityLineItem;

export interface CrmLineItemsValues {
    currency: string;
    groupName: string;
    lineItems: OpportunityLineItem[];
    lumpSumDiscount: number;
    totalAmount?: number;
    totalDiscount?: number;
    subtotal?: number;
    totalTax?: number;
    grandTotal?: number;
}

// Backward compatibility alias
export type CrmLineItemsData = CrmLineItemsValues;

export interface CrmLineItemsEditorProps {
    value: CrmLineItemsValues;
    onChange: <K extends keyof CrmLineItemsValues>(field: K, val: CrmLineItemsValues[K]) => void;
    error?: string;
}

export interface CrmLineItemsSectionProps {
    value?: CrmLineItemsValues;
    onChange?: <K extends keyof CrmLineItemsValues>(field: K, val: CrmLineItemsValues[K]) => void;
    form?: Partial<CrmLineItemsValues>;
    setField?: <K extends keyof CrmLineItemsValues>(key: K, value: CrmLineItemsValues[K]) => void;
    error?: string;
}

// Product catalog for quick autocomplete / selection in the line items
export const PRODUCT_CATALOG: { name: string; defaultPrice: number; category: string }[] = [
    { name: 'TallyPrime Silver (Single User)', defaultPrice: 22500, category: 'Tally' },
    { name: 'TallyPrime Gold (Multi User)', defaultPrice: 67500, category: 'Tally' },
    { name: 'Tally Software Services (TSS) Renewal - Gold', defaultPrice: 15750, category: 'Tally' },
    { name: 'Tally Software Services (TSS) Renewal - Silver', defaultPrice: 5250, category: 'Tally' },
    { name: 'Biz Analyst Mobile App (Annual - 5 Users)', defaultPrice: 12000, category: 'Biz Analyst' },
    { name: 'CredFlow Credit Management Cloud Platform', defaultPrice: 36000, category: 'CredFlow' },
    { name: 'Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud Standard (500GB)', defaultPrice: 42000, category: 'Acronis' },
    { name: 'Connect 21 Multi-Branch Sync Engine', defaultPrice: 18500, category: 'Connect 21' },
    { name: 'WhatsApp Automation for Tally Invoicing', defaultPrice: 14500, category: 'Automation' },
    { name: 'Implementation & Custom Workflow Engineering', defaultPrice: 35000, category: 'Services' },
];

export function parseTaxRate(taxRateStr: string): number {
    if (!taxRateStr || taxRateStr === '--None--' || taxRateStr === 'GST 0%') return 0;
    const match = taxRateStr.match(/(\d+)%/);
    return match ? Number(match[1]) : 0;
}

export const DEFAULT_LINE_ITEMS_VALUES: CrmLineItemsValues = {
    currency: 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
    groupName: 'Products & Services',
    lineItems: [],
    lumpSumDiscount: 0,
    totalAmount: 0,
    totalDiscount: 0,
    subtotal: 0,
    totalTax: 0,
    grandTotal: 0,
};

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COMPONENT A: CrmLineItemsEditor (Pure Controlled UI — Zero RHF Hooks)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function CrmLineItemsEditor({ value, onChange, error }: CrmLineItemsEditorProps) {
    const currency = value.currency || 'Indian Rupee: ₹';
    const groupName = value.groupName || '';
    const lineItems = Array.isArray(value.lineItems) ? value.lineItems : [];
    const lumpSumDiscount = value.lumpSumDiscount || 0;
    const totalAmount = value.totalAmount ?? 0;
    const totalDiscount = value.totalDiscount ?? 0;
    const subtotal = value.subtotal ?? 0;
    const totalTax = value.totalTax ?? 0;
    const grandTotal = value.grandTotal ?? 0;

    // ── Helper to recalculate all totals from line items ──────────────────────────
    const recalculateTotals = useCallback(
        (items: OpportunityLineItem[], lumpSum: number) => {
            let grossAmount = 0;
            let grossDiscount = 0;
            let grossSubtotal = 0;
            let grossTax = 0;

            items.forEach((item) => {
                const qty = item.quantity || 1;
                const baseAmount = item.amount * qty;
                grossAmount += baseAmount;

                let discVal = 0;
                if (item.discountType === 'percentage') {
                    discVal = (baseAmount * (item.discount || 0)) / 100;
                } else {
                    discVal = (item.discount || 0) * qty;
                }
                grossDiscount += discVal;

                const lineSubtotal = Math.max(0, baseAmount - discVal);
                grossSubtotal += lineSubtotal;

                const taxPercent = parseTaxRate(item.taxRate);
                const lineTax = (lineSubtotal * taxPercent) / 100;
                grossTax += lineTax;
            });

            const computedGrandTotal = Math.max(0, grossSubtotal + grossTax - (lumpSum || 0));

            onChange('lineItems', items);
            onChange('totalAmount', Math.round(grossAmount));
            onChange('totalDiscount', Math.round(grossDiscount));
            onChange('subtotal', Math.round(grossSubtotal));
            onChange('totalTax', Math.round(grossTax));
            onChange('grandTotal', Math.round(computedGrandTotal));
        },
        [onChange]
    );

    // ── Add new product line item ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleAddLineItem = () => {
        const newItem: OpportunityLineItem = {
            id: `line-${Date.now()}`,
            productId: 'prod-tally',
            productName: '',
            quantity: 1,
            amount: 0,
            discount: 0,
            discountType: 'percentage',
            salePrice: 0,
            taxRate: 'GST 18%',
            taxAmount: 0,
            total: 0,
            description: '',
            note: '',
        };
        const updated = [...lineItems, newItem];
        recalculateTotals(updated, lumpSumDiscount);
    };

    // ── Remove product line item ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleRemoveLineItem = (index: number) => {
        const updated = lineItems.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
        recalculateTotals(updated, lumpSumDiscount);
    };

    // ── Update specific line item ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleUpdateLineItem = (index: number, updates: Partial<OpportunityLineItem>) => {
        const updated = lineItems.map((item, i) => {
            if (i !== index) return item;
            const merged: OpportunityLineItem = { ...item, ...updates };

            const qty = merged.quantity || 1;
            const baseAmount = merged.amount;
            let discPerUnit = 0;
            if (merged.discountType === 'percentage') {
                discPerUnit = (baseAmount * (merged.discount || 0)) / 100;
            } else {
                discPerUnit = merged.discount || 0;
            }
            const salePrice = Math.max(0, baseAmount - discPerUnit);
            const lineSubtotal = salePrice * qty;
            const taxPercent = parseTaxRate(merged.taxRate);
            const lineTax = (lineSubtotal * taxPercent) / 100;
            const lineTotal = lineSubtotal + lineTax;

            return {
                ...merged,
                salePrice: Math.round(salePrice),
                taxAmount: Math.round(lineTax),
                total: Math.round(lineTotal),
            };
        });

        recalculateTotals(updated, lumpSumDiscount);
    };

    // ── Select product from catalog ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleSelectProduct = (index: number, productName: string) => {
        const found = PRODUCT_CATALOG.find((p) => p.name === productName);
        const amount = found ? found.defaultPrice : 0;
        handleUpdateLineItem(index, {
            productName,
            amount,
            salePrice: amount,
            taxRate: 'GST 18%',
        });
    };

    // ── Handle lump sum discount update ─────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleLumpSumChange = (val: number) => {
        onChange('lumpSumDiscount', val);
        recalculateTotals(lineItems, val);
    };

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2, md: 3 } }}>
            {error && (
                <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 3 }}>
                    {error}
                </Alert>
            )}

            {/* ════════════ TOP SETTINGS (Currency) ════════════ */}
            <Box sx={{ maxWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: 400 }, mb: 3 }}>
                <FormField label="Currency" hint="Base billing currency">
                    <FormControl size="small" fullWidth sx={fieldSx}>
                        <Select
                            value={currency}
                            onChange={(e) => onChange('currency', e.target.value)}
                        >
                            {OPPORTUNITY_CURRENCIES.map((cur) => (
                                <MenuItem key={cur} value={cur}>
                                    {cur}
                                </MenuItem>
                            ))}
                        </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                </FormField>
            </Box>

            {/* ════════════ LINE ITEMS SECTION ════════════ */}
            <Paper
                variant="outlined"
                sx={{
                    p: 2.5,
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                    border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                    mb: 4,
                }}
            >
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.92rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e293b', mb: 2 }}>
                    Line Items
                </Typography>

                {/* Group Name input */}
                <Box sx={{ maxWidth: 500, mb: 3 }}>
                    <FormField label="Group Name" hint="Logical bundle name (e.g. Products / Software / AMC)">
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            value={groupName}
                            onChange={(e) => onChange('groupName', e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="e.g. Software Licenses & Add-ons"
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>
                </Box>

                {/* Dynamic Line items table container */}
                <Box sx={{ overflowX: 'auto', mb: 2 }}>
                    {lineItems.length === 0 ? (
                        <Box
                            sx={{
                                p: 4,
                                textAlign: 'center',
                                backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                                border: '1px dashed #cbd5e1',
                                borderRadius: '8px',
                            }}
                        >
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.86rem', color: '#64748b', mb: 1.5 }}>
                                No product line items added yet. Click below to add products or services.
                            </Typography>
                            <Button
                                variant="contained"
                                startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                                onClick={handleAddLineItem}
                                sx={{
                                    backgroundColor: '#1e3a8a',
                                    color: '#ffffff',
                                    textTransform: 'none',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    px: 2.5,
                                    '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#1d4ed8' },
                                }}
                            >
                                Add Product Line
                            </Button>
                        </Box>
                    ) : (
                        <Box sx={{ minWidth: 960 }}>
                            {/* Table Header Row */}
                            <Box
                                sx={{
                                    display: 'grid',
                                    gridTemplateColumns: '70px 2.2fr 1.1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr 40px',
                                    gap: 1.5,
                                    px: 1.5,
                                    py: 1,
                                    backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                                    borderRadius: '6px 6px 0 0',
                                    border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                    borderBottom: 'none',
                                    fontSize: '0.74rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#475569',
                                }}
                            >
                                <Box>Quantity</Box>
                                <Box>Product</Box>
                                <Box>Amount (₹)</Box>
                                <Box>Discount</Box>
                                <Box>Sale Price (₹)</Box>
                                <Box>Tax Amount (₹)</Box>
                                <Box>Total (₹)</Box>
                                <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>Action</Box>
                            </Box>

                            {/* Table Line Items */}
                            {lineItems.map((item, idx) => (
                                <Box
                                    key={item.id || idx}
                                    sx={{
                                        border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                        borderTop: idx > 0 ? 'none' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                        p: 1.5,
                                        backgroundColor: idx % 2 === 0 ? '#ffffff' : '#fafafa',
                                        '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                                    }}
                                >
                                    {/* Main numbers row */}
                                    <Box
                                        sx={{
                                            display: 'grid',
                                            gridTemplateColumns: '70px 2.2fr 1.1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr 40px',
                                            gap: 1.5,

                                    >
                                        {/* Quantity */}
                                        <TextField

                                                handleUpdateLineItem(idx, {

                                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { min: 1 } }}

                                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                                            <FormControl size="small" fullWidth sx={fieldSx}>

                                                            {p.name}

                                                    ))}
                                                </Select>
                                            </FormControl>
                                        </Box>

                                        {/* Amount (Unit price) */}
                                        <TextField

                                                        <MenuItem key={rate} value={rate}>
                                                            {rate}

                                        {/* Total */}
                                        <TextField

                                            disabled

                                                '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
                                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                                    color: '#1e3a8a',
                                                    backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                                },
                                            }}
                                        />

                                        {/* Delete button (X) */}
                                        <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
                                            <Tooltip title="Remove item">
                                                <IconButton
                                                    size="small"
                                                    onClick={() => handleRemoveLineItem(idx)}
                                                    sx={{
                                                        width: 32,
                                                        height: 32,
                                                        backgroundColor: '#1e3a8a',
                                                        color: '#ffffff',

                                                        '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#b91c1c' },
                                                    }}

                                                    <ClearIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />

                                            </Tooltip>

                                    </Box>

                                    {/* Description and Note textareas below each row */}

                                        sx={{

                                            gap: 2,
                                            pt: 1,
                                            borderTop: '1px dashed #e2e8f0',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <Box>
                                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b', mb: 0.5 }}>
                                                Description:
                                            </Typography>
                                            <TextField
                                                fullWidth
                                                size="small"
                                                multiline
                                                rows={2}
                                                placeholder="Line item scope or package specifications..."
                                                value={item.description || ''}
                                                onChange={(e) =>
                                                    handleUpdateLineItem(idx, { description: e.target.value })
                                                }
                                                sx={fieldSx}
                                            />
                                        </Box>
                                        <Box>
                                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b', mb: 0.5 }}>
                                                Note:
                                            </Typography>
                                            <TextField
                                                fullWidth
                                                size="small"

                                                placeholder="Internal notes, discount justifications, or terms..."

                                                onChange={(e) =>
                                                    handleUpdateLineItem(idx, { note: e.target.value })
                                                }
                                                sx={fieldSx}
                                            />
                                        </Box>
                                    </Box>
                                </Box>
                            ))}
                        </Box>
                    )}
                </Box>

                {/* + ADD PRODUCT LINE Button */}
                <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                    onClick={handleAddLineItem}
                    sx={{

                sx={{

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COMPONENT B: RhfLineItemsConnected (Safe RHF Hook Caller)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function RhfLineItemsConnected() {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<CrmLineItemsValues>();

    const currency = useWatch({ control, name: 'currency' });
    const groupName = useWatch({ control, name: 'groupName' });
    const lineItems = useWatch({ control, name: 'lineItems' });
    const lumpSumDiscount = useWatch({ control, name: 'lumpSumDiscount' });
    const totalAmount = useWatch({ control, name: 'totalAmount' });
    const totalDiscount = useWatch({ control, name: 'totalDiscount' });
    const subtotal = useWatch({ control, name: 'subtotal' });
    const totalTax = useWatch({ control, name: 'totalTax' });
    const grandTotal = useWatch({ control, name: 'grandTotal' });

    const currentValue: CrmLineItemsValues = {
        currency: currency || 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
        groupName: groupName || '',
        lineItems: Array.isArray(lineItems) ? lineItems : [],
        lumpSumDiscount: typeof lumpSumDiscount === 'number' ? lumpSumDiscount : 0,
        totalAmount: typeof totalAmount === 'number' ? totalAmount : 0,
        totalDiscount: typeof totalDiscount === 'number' ? totalDiscount : 0,
        subtotal: typeof subtotal === 'number' ? subtotal : 0,
        totalTax: typeof totalTax === 'number' ? totalTax : 0,
        grandTotal: typeof grandTotal === 'number' ? grandTotal : 0,
    };

    const handleChange = useCallback(
        <K extends keyof CrmLineItemsValues>(field: K, val: CrmLineItemsValues[K]) => {
            setValue(
                field as unknown as Path<CrmLineItemsValues>,
                val as unknown as PathValue<CrmLineItemsValues, Path<CrmLineItemsValues>>,
                {
                    shouldDirty: true,
                    shouldValidate: true,
                }
            );
        },
        [setValue]
    );

    return <CrmLineItemsEditor value={currentValue} onChange={handleChange} />;
}

export function RhfLineItemsSection() {
    const rhfContext = useFormContext<CrmLineItemsValues>();
    if (!rhfContext) {
        return null;
    }
    return <RhfLineItemsConnected />;
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SAFE HYBRID WRAPPER: CrmLineItemsSection
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export function CrmLineItemsSection(props: CrmLineItemsSectionProps = {}) {
    const rhfContext = useFormContext<CrmLineItemsValues>();

    // 1. If explicit value and onChange are provided, render pure controlled component
    if (props.value && props.onChange) {
        return <CrmLineItemsEditor value={props.value} onChange={props.onChange} error={props.error} />;
    }

    // 2. If legacy form & setField are provided, adapt without RHF
    if (props.form && props.setField) {
        const legacyValue: CrmLineItemsValues = {
            currency: props.form.currency || 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
            groupName: props.form.groupName || '',
            lineItems: Array.isArray(props.form.lineItems) ? props.form.lineItems : [],
            lumpSumDiscount: props.form.lumpSumDiscount || 0,
            totalAmount: props.form.totalAmount || 0,
            totalDiscount: props.form.totalDiscount || 0,
            subtotal: props.form.subtotal || 0,
            totalTax: props.form.totalTax || 0,
            grandTotal: props.form.grandTotal || 0,
        };
        return <CrmLineItemsEditor value={legacyValue} onChange={props.setField} error={props.error} />;
    }

    // 3. If within a FormProvider, delegate to the RHF connected wrapper
    if (rhfContext) {
        return <RhfLineItemsConnected />;
    }

    // 4. Fallback safe editor if neither context nor props are supplied
    return (
        <CrmLineItemsEditor
            value={DEFAULT_LINE_ITEMS_VALUES}
            onChange={() => {}}
            error={props.error}
        />
    );
}

export default CrmLineItemsSection;

import { INDIAN_STATES, COUNTRIES } from '@/config/constants';

export interface AddressFieldNames<T extends FieldValues> {
    address: Path<T>;
    city: Path<T>;
    state: Path<T>;
    postalCode: Path<T>;
    country: Path<T>;
}

export interface RhfAddressSectionProps<T extends FieldValues> {
    billingTitle?: string;
    shippingTitle?: string;
    streetLabel?: string;
    shippingStreetLabel?: string;
    billingFields?: AddressFieldNames<T>;
    shippingFields?: AddressFieldNames<T>;
    copyFieldName?: Path<T>;
    copyLabel?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
}

const columnSx = { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 } as const;

export function RhfAddressSection<T extends FieldValues>({
    billingTitle = 'BILLING ADDRESS',
    shippingTitle = 'SHIPPING ADDRESS',
    streetLabel = 'Address',
    shippingStreetLabel = 'Shipping Address',
    billingFields = {
        address: 'billingAddress' as Path<T>,
        city: 'billingCity' as Path<T>,
        state: 'billingState' as Path<T>,
        postalCode: 'billingPostalCode' as Path<T>,
        country: 'billingCountry' as Path<T>,
    },
    shippingFields = {
        address: 'shippingAddress' as Path<T>,
        city: 'shippingCity' as Path<T>,
        state: 'shippingState' as Path<T>,
        postalCode: 'shippingPostalCode' as Path<T>,
        country: 'shippingCountry' as Path<T>,
    },
    copyFieldName = 'copyAddressFromBilling' as Path<T>,
    copyLabel = 'Copy address from left',
    required = true,
    disabled = false,
}: RhfAddressSectionProps<T>) {
    const { control, getValues, setValue } = useFormContext<T>();
    const copy = Boolean(useWatch({ control, name: copyFieldName }));

    const billingAddressVal = useWatch({ control, name: billingFields.address });
    const billingCityVal = useWatch({ control, name: billingFields.city });
    const billingStateVal = useWatch({ control, name: billingFields.state });
    const billingPostalCodeVal = useWatch({ control, name: billingFields.postalCode });
    const billingCountryVal = useWatch({ control, name: billingFields.country });

    // Sync shipping fields with billing when copy toggle is enabled
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!copy) return;
        const opts = { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true } as const;

        if (getValues(shippingFields.address) !== billingAddressVal) {
            setValue(shippingFields.address, (billingAddressVal || '') as never, opts);
        }
        if (getValues(shippingFields.city) !== billingCityVal) {
            setValue(shippingFields.city, (billingCityVal || '') as never, opts);
        }
        if (getValues(shippingFields.state) !== billingStateVal) {
            setValue(shippingFields.state, (billingStateVal || 'Delhi') as never, opts);
        }
        if (getValues(shippingFields.postalCode) !== billingPostalCodeVal) {
            setValue(shippingFields.postalCode, (billingPostalCodeVal || '') as never, opts);
        }
        if (getValues(shippingFields.country) !== billingCountryVal) {
            setValue(shippingFields.country, (billingCountryVal || 'India') as never, opts);
        }
    }, [
        copy,
        billingAddressVal,
        billingCityVal,
        billingStateVal,
        billingPostalCodeVal,
        billingCountryVal,
        getValues,
        setValue,
        shippingFields,
    ]);

    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                display: 'grid',
                gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' },
                gap: { xs: 3, md: 4 },
            }}
        >
            {/* ── Left Column: Primary / Billing Address ── */}
            <Box sx={columnSx}>
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />}
                    label={billingTitle}
                    sx={{ mb: 1 }}
                />
                <RhfTextField<T>
                    name={billingFields.address}
                    label={streetLabel}
                    required={required}
                    hint="Street address, building, premises"
                    multiline
                    minRows={3}
                    maxRows={4}
                    placeholder="Enter street and building address..."
                    disabled={disabled}
                />
                <RhfTextField<T>
                    name={billingFields.city}
                    label="City"
                    required={required}
                    placeholder="e.g. New Delhi / Gurugram"
                    disabled={disabled}
                />
                <RhfSelect<T>
                    name={billingFields.state}
                    label="State / Region"
                    required={required}
                    options={INDIAN_STATES}
                    placeholder="Select State / Region"
                    disabled={disabled}
                />
                <RhfPinCodeField<T>
                    name={billingFields.postalCode}
                    label="Postal Code (PIN)"
                    required={required}
                    placeholder="e.g. 110020"
                    disabled={disabled}
                />
                <RhfSelect<T>
                    name={billingFields.country}
                    label="Country"
                    required={required}
                    options={COUNTRIES}
                    placeholder="Select Country"
                    disabled={disabled}
                />
            </Box>

            {/* ── Right Column: Shipping / Other Address ── */}
            <Box sx={columnSx}>
                <Box
                    sx={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        flexWrap: 'wrap',
                        gap: 1,
                        mb: 1,
                    }}
                >
                    <SectionLabel
                        icon={<LocalShippingOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#64748b' }} />}
                        label={shippingTitle}
                    />
                    <RhfCheckbox<T> name={copyFieldName} label={copyLabel} />
                </Box>

                <RhfTextField<T>
                    name={shippingFields.address}
                    label={shippingStreetLabel}
                    hint="Delivery warehouse, facility, or office"
                    multiline
                    minRows={3}
                    maxRows={4}
                    placeholder="Enter shipping address..."
                    disabled={copy ? true : disabled}
                />
                <RhfTextField<T>
                    name={shippingFields.city}
                    label="City"
                    placeholder="Enter delivery city"
                    disabled={copy ? true : disabled}
                />
                <RhfSelect<T>
                    name={shippingFields.state}
                    label="State / Region"
                    options={INDIAN_STATES}
                    placeholder="Select State / Region"
                    disabled={copy ? true : disabled}
                />
                <RhfPinCodeField<T>
                    name={shippingFields.postalCode}
                    label="Postal Code (PIN)"
                    placeholder="Enter delivery PIN code"
                    disabled={copy ? true : disabled}
                />
                <RhfSelect<T>
                    name={shippingFields.country}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Chip, FormHelperText } from '@mui/material';
import CheckIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Check';
import { useController, type FieldPath, type FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormField } from '../FormField';

export interface RhfChipGroupProps<T extends FieldValues> {
    name: FieldPath<T>;
    label: string;
    options: readonly string[];
    required?: boolean;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
}

/** React Hook Form bound multi-select chip group (string[] field). */
export function RhfChipGroup<T extends FieldValues>({
    name,
    label,
    options,
    required,
    hint,
}: RhfChipGroupProps<T>) {
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<T>({ name });
    const selected: string[] = Array.isArray(field.value) ? field.value : [];

    const toggle = (option: string) =>
        field.onChange(
            selected.includes(option) ? selected.filter((o) => o !== option) : [...selected, option]
        );

    return (
        <FormField label={label} required={required} hint={hint}>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.8 }}>
                {options.map((option) => {
                    const active = selected.includes(option);
                    return (
                        <Chip
                            key={option}
                            label={option}
                            size="small"
                            onClick={() => toggle(option)}
                            icon={active ? <CheckIcon sx={{ fontSize: '14px !important' }} /> : undefined}
                            sx={{
                                fontSize: '0.74rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                cursor: 'pointer',
                                backgroundColor: active ? '#dcfce7' : '#f1f5f9',
                                color: active ? '#166534' : '#475569',
                                border: `1px solid ${active ? '#86efac' : '#e2e8f0'}`,
                            }}
                        />
                    );
                })}
            </Box>
            {fieldState.error && <FormHelperText error>{fieldState.error.message}</FormHelperText>}
        </FormField>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, FormHelperText, InputAdornment, TextField } from '@mui/material';
import CalendarTodayOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarTodayOutlined';
import AccessTimeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccessTimeOutlined';
import { useController, type FieldPath, type FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormField, fieldSx } from '../FormField';

export interface RhfDateTimeFieldProps<T extends FieldValues> {
    dateName: FieldPath<T>;
    timeName?: FieldPath<T>;
    label: string;
    required?: boolean;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
}

const adornment = (icon: React.ReactNode) => ({
    input: { startAdornment: <InputAdornment position="start">{icon}</InputAdornment> },
});

/** Paired date + optional time input bound to two RHF fields. */
export function RhfDateTimeField<T extends FieldValues>({
    dateName,
    timeName,
    label,
    required,
    hint,
}: RhfDateTimeFieldProps<T>) {
    const date = useController<T>({ name: dateName });
    // useController requires a name; fall back to the date name when no time field is configured.
    const time = useController<T>({ name: (timeName ?? dateName) as FieldPath<T> });
    const error = date.fieldState.error?.message ?? (timeName ? time.fieldState.error?.message : undefined);

    return (
        <FormField label={label} required={required} hint={hint}>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: timeName ? '1.4fr 1fr' : '1fr', gap: 1.5 }}>
                <TextField
                    {...date.field}
                    value={date.field.value ?? ''}
                    type="date"
                    fullWidth
                    size="small"
                    error={Boolean(date.fieldState.error)}
                    slotProps={adornment(<CalendarTodayOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />)}
                    sx={fieldSx}
                />
                {timeName && (
                    <TextField
                        {...time.field}
                        value={time.field.value ?? ''}
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="e.g. 11:30 AM"
                        error={Boolean(time.fieldState.error)}
                        slotProps={adornment(<AccessTimeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                    />
                )}
            </Box>
            {error && <FormHelperText error>{error}</FormHelperText>}
        </FormField>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Button, FormHelperText, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import { useController, type FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { EmailRow } from '../EmailRow';
import type { CorporateEmail } from '@/types/organization.types';

export interface RhfEmailListProps {
    /** Name of the `CorporateEmail[]` field. Defaults to `emailAddresses`. */
    name?: string;
    label?: string;
    required?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Repeatable email list bound to a `CorporateEmail[]` field.
 * Guarantees exactly one primary address whenever at least one row exists.
 */
export function RhfEmailList({
    name = 'emailAddresses',
    label = 'Email Address',
    required,
}: RhfEmailListProps) {
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<FieldValues>({ name });
    const rows: CorporateEmail[] = Array.isArray(field.value) ? field.value : [];

    const errorMessage =
        (fieldState.error as { root?: { message?: string } } | undefined)?.root?.message ??
        fieldState.error?.message;

    const commit = (next: CorporateEmail[]) => field.onChange(next);

    const handleAdd = () =>
        commit([
            ...rows,
            {
                id: `eml-${Date.now()}`,
                email: '',
                isPrimary: rows.length === 0,
                isOptedOut: false,
                isInvalidBounce: false,
            },
        ]);

    const handleChange = (index: number, updated: CorporateEmail) =>
        commit(
            rows.map((row, i) => {
                if (i === index) return updated;
                return updated.isPrimary ? { ...row, isPrimary: false } : row;
            })
        );

    const handleRemove = (index: number) => {
        const next = rows.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
        if (next.length > 0 && !next.some((e) => e.isPrimary)) {
            next[0] = { ...next[0], isPrimary: true };
        }
        commit(next);
    };

    return (
        <Box sx={{ mb: 1 }}>
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 1 }}>
                <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                    {label}
                    {required && (
                        <Box component="span" sx={{ color: '#ef4444', ml: 0.4 }}>
                            *
                        </Box>
                    )}
                </Typography>
                <Button
                    size="small"
                    startIcon={<AddIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                    onClick={handleAdd}
                    sx={{
                        textTransform: 'none',
                        fontSize: '0.75rem',
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        color: '#2563eb',
                        backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                        px: 1.2,
                        py: 0.3,
                        borderRadius: '6px',
                        border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                        '&:hover': { backgroundColor: '#dbeafe' },
                    }}
                >
                    Add Email
                </Button>
            </Box>

            {rows.map((row, index) => (
                <EmailRow
                    key={row.id}
                    email={row}
                    onChange={(updated) => handleChange(index, updated)}
                    onRemove={() => handleRemove(index)}
                />
            ))}

            {errorMessage && <FormHelperText error>{errorMessage}</FormHelperText>}
        </Box>
    );
}

File: src/components/forms/rhf/RhfTextField.tsx
================
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { TextField, type TextFieldProps } from '@mui/material';
import { useController, type FieldPath, type FieldValues } from 'react-hook-form';
import { FormField, fieldSx } from '../FormField';

export interface RhfTextFieldProps<T extends FieldValues>
    extends Pick<
        TextFieldProps,
        'type' | 'multiline' | 'minRows' | 'maxRows' | 'placeholder' | 'disabled' | 'slotProps' | 'sx'
    > {
    name: FieldPath<T>;
    label: string;
    required?: boolean;
    hint?: React.ReactNode;
    numericOnly?: boolean;
    uppercase?: boolean;
    lowercase?: boolean;
    maxLength?: number;
    min?: number | string;
    max?: number | string;
    step?: number | string;
    onChange?: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>) => void;
}

/**
 * React Hook Form bound text input rendered inside the shared {@link FormField} shell.
 * Must be rendered inside a `FormProvider`.
 * Enforces production-grade enterprise input constraints (numeric-only, uppercase, lowercase, max/min limits).
 */
export function RhfTextField<T extends FieldValues>({
    name,
    label,
    required,
    hint,
    numericOnly,
    uppercase,
    lowercase,
    maxLength,
    min,
    max,
    step,
    sx,
    slotProps,
    ...inputProps
}: RhfTextFieldProps<T>) {
    const { field, fieldState } = useController<T>({ name });

    const isNumeric =
        numericOnly ??
        (inputProps.type === 'tel' ||
            /(mobile|phone|postalcode|pincode|pin_code)/i.test(name) ||
            /(mobile|phone|postal code|pin code|pincode)/i.test(label));

    const isUppercase =
        uppercase ??
        (/(gst|pan|ifsc)/i.test(name) || /(gst|pan|ifsc)/i.test(label));

    const isEmail =
        lowercase ??
        (inputProps.type === 'email' ||
            /(email)/i.test(name) ||
            /(email)/i.test(label));

    const existingHtmlInput =
        (slotProps?.htmlInput as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) || {};

    const resolvedMaxLength =
        maxLength ??
        (existingHtmlInput.maxLength as number | undefined) ??
        (/(postalcode|pincode|pin code|postal code)/i.test(name) ||
        /(postal code|pin code|pincode)/i.test(label)
            ? 6
            : /(mobile|phone)/i.test(name) || /(mobile|phone)/i.test(label)
            ? 10
            : undefined);

    const handleChange = (
        e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>
    ) => {
        let val = e.target.value;
        if (isNumeric) {
            val = val.replace(/\D/g, '');
            if (resolvedMaxLength) {
                val = val.slice(0, resolvedMaxLength);
            }
            e.target.value = val;
        } else if (isUppercase) {
            val = val.toUpperCase();
            if (resolvedMaxLength) {
                val = val.slice(0, resolvedMaxLength);
            }
            e.target.value = val;
        } else if (isEmail) {
            val = val.toLowerCase().trim();
            e.target.value = val;
        } else if (inputProps.type === 'number') {
            const num = parseFloat(val);
            if (!isNaN(num)) {
                if (max !== undefined && num > Number(max)) {
                    val = String(max);
                    e.target.value = val;
                } else if (min !== undefined && num < Number(min)) {
                    val = String(min);
                    e.target.value = val;
                }
            }
        }
        field.onChange(val);
        inputProps.onChange?.(e);
    };

    const mergedSlotProps = {
        ...slotProps,
        htmlInput: {
            ...existingHtmlInput,
            ...(min !== undefined ? { min } : {}),
            ...(max !== undefined ? { max } : {}),
            ...(step !== undefined ? { step } : {}),
            ...(isNumeric
                ? {
                      inputMode: 'numeric',
                      pattern: '[0-9]*',
                  }
                : {}),
            ...(resolvedMaxLength ? { maxLength: resolvedMaxLength } : {}),
            onInput: (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
                const target = e.currentTarget;
                if (isNumeric && target.value) {
                    let val = target.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
                    if (resolvedMaxLength) {
                        val = val.slice(0, resolvedMaxLength);
                    }
                    target.value = val;
                } else if (isUppercase && target.value) {
                    let val = target.value.toUpperCase();
                    if (resolvedMaxLength) {
                        val = val.slice(0, resolvedMaxLength);
                    }
                    target.value = val;
                } else if (isEmail && target.value) {
                    let val = target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
                    target.value = val;
                } else if (inputProps.type === 'number' && target.value) {
                    const num = parseFloat(target.value);
                    if (!isNaN(num)) {
                        if (max !== undefined && num > Number(max)) {
                            target.value = String(max);
                        } else if (min !== undefined && num < Number(min)) {
                            target.value = String(min);
                        }
                    }
                }
            },
        },
    };

    return (
        <FormField label={label} required={required} hint={hint}>
            <TextField
                {...inputProps}
                {...field}
                value={field.value ?? ''}
                onChange={handleChange}
                fullWidth
                size="small"
                slotProps={mergedSlotProps}
                error={Boolean(fieldState.error)}
                helperText={fieldState.error?.message}
                sx={{ ...fieldSx, ...sx }}
            />
        </FormField>
    );
}

File: src/components/forms/rhf/useRhfForm.ts
================
'use client';

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import {
    useForm,
    type DefaultValues,
    type FieldErrors,
    type FieldValues,
    type Resolver,
    type UseFormReturn,
} from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import type { ZodType } from 'zod';
import { getFirstErrorMessage } from '@/validations';

export type FormToastState = {
    open: boolean;
    message: string;
    severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
};

const CLOSED_TOAST: FormToastState = { open: false, message: '', severity: 'success' };

export interface UseRhfFormOptions<T extends FieldValues> {
    schema: ZodType<unknown>;
    defaultValues: DefaultValues<T>;
}

export interface UseRhfFormReturn<T extends FieldValues> {
    methods: UseFormReturn<T>;
    toast: FormToastState;
    showToast: (message: string, severity?: FormToastState['severity']) => void;
    closeToast: () => void;
    /** Builds a submit handler that toasts the first zod issue on validation failure. */
    createSubmitHandler: (onValid: (values: T) => Promise<void> | void) => () => Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Standard form hook for the CRM: React Hook Form + zod resolver + the shared toast convention
 * (first validation error is surfaced in the top-right AppToast, field errors render inline).
 */
export function useRhfForm<T extends FieldValues>({
    schema,
    defaultValues,
}: UseRhfFormOptions<T>): UseRhfFormReturn<T> {
    const methods = useForm<T>({
        // zod schemas with defaults have differing input/output types; the form works on the output shape.
        resolver: zodResolver(schema as never) as unknown as Resolver<T>,
        defaultValues,
        mode: 'onTouched',
    });

    const [toast, setToast] = useState<FormToastState>(CLOSED_TOAST);

    const showToast = useCallback<UseRhfFormReturn<T>['showToast']>(
        (message, severity = 'error') => setToast({ open: true, message, severity }),
        []
    );
    const closeToast = useCallback(() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false })), []);

    const createSubmitHandler = useCallback<UseRhfFormReturn<T>['createSubmitHandler']>(
        (onValid) =>
            methods.handleSubmit(onValid, (errors: FieldErrors<T>) =>
                showToast(getFirstErrorMessage(errors) ?? 'Please correct the highlighted fields.', 'error')
            ),
        [methods, showToast]
    );

    return { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler };
}

File: src/components/forms/StyledSelect.tsx

import React from 'react';
import { FormControl, Select, MenuItem, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { fieldSx } from './FormField';

export interface StyledSelectProps {
    label?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    value: string;
    onChange: (v: string) => void;
    options: string[];
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
}

export function StyledSelect({
    label,
    placeholder,
    value,
    onChange,
    options,
    required,
    disabled,
}: StyledSelectProps) {
    const placeholderText =
        placeholder || (label ? `Select ${label.replace(/\s*\*$/, '')}` : 'Select an option');

    return (
        <FormControl fullWidth size="small" sx={fieldSx} required={required} disabled={disabled}>
            <Select
                displayEmpty
                disabled={disabled}
                value={value}
                onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
                renderValue={(selected) => {
                    if (!selected) {
                        return (
                            <Typography component="span" sx={{ color: '#9ca3af', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                                {placeholderText}
                            </Typography>
                        );
                    }
                    return (
                        <Typography component="span" sx={{ color: '#1e293b', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                            {selected}
                        </Typography>
                    );
                }}
                sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
            >
                <MenuItem value="" disabled sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#9ca3af', display: 'none' }}>
                    <em>{placeholderText}</em>
                </MenuItem>
                {options.map((o) => (
                    <MenuItem key={o} value={o} sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                        {o}
                    </MenuItem>
                ))}
            </Select>
        </FormControl>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box, Container, SxProps, Theme } from '@mui/material';
import { Navbar } from './Navbar';
import { AppBreadcrumbs, type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { EnterpriseFooter } from '../common/EnterpriseFooter';

export interface AppPageLayoutProps {
    children: React.ReactNode;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
    headerActions?: React.ReactNode;
    maxWidth?: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | false;
    fullWidth?: boolean;
    showFooter?: boolean;
    sx?: SxProps<Theme>;
}

/**
 * Standard enterprise page shell for all CRM views.
 * Guarantees permanent Navbar, route-aware auto-breadcrumbs, and consistent footer.
 */
export function AppPageLayout({
    children,
    breadcrumbItems,
    headerActions,
    maxWidth = 'xl',
    fullWidth = false,
    showFooter = true,
    sx,
}: AppPageLayoutProps) {
    return (
        <Box
            sx={{
                minHeight: '100vh',
                backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                ...sx,
            }}
        >
            {/* Global Navbar */}
            <Navbar />

            {/* Main Content Area */}
            {fullWidth ? (
                <Box sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                    {/* Header Row with permanent breadcrumbs */}
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            px: { xs: 2, md: 3 },
                            pt: 2,
                            pb: 1.5,
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'space-between',
                            flexWrap: 'wrap',
                            gap: 1.5,
                        }}
                    >
                        <AppBreadcrumbs items={breadcrumbItems} />
                        {headerActions && (
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                                {headerActions}
                            </Box>
                        )}
                    </Box>

                    {/* Children */}
                    <Box sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                        {children}
                    </Box>
                </Box>
            ) : (
                <Container
                    maxWidth={maxWidth}
                    sx={{
                        pt: 2.5,
                        pb: 4,
                        flex: 1,
                        display: 'flex',
                        flexDirection: 'column',
                    }}
                >
                    {/* Header Row with permanent breadcrumbs */}
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            mb: 2.5,
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'space-between',
                            flexWrap: 'wrap',
                            gap: 1.5,
                        }}
                    >
                        <AppBreadcrumbs items={breadcrumbItems} />
                        {headerActions && (
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                                {headerActions}
                            </Box>
                        )}
                    </Box>

                    {/* Children */}
                    <Box sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                        {children}
                    </Box>
                </Container>
            )}

            {/* Enterprise Footer */}
            {showFooter && <EnterpriseFooter />}
        </Box>
    );
}

/* ─── Hover-dropdown pill ───────────────────────────────── */
function NavPill({ item }: { item: { label: string; icon?: React.ReactNode; items: readonly { label: string; href: string }[] } }) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [anchorEl, setAnchorEl] = useState<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
    const closeTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

    const handleMouseEnter = () => {
        if (closeTimer.current) clearTimeout(closeTimer.current);
        setOpen(true);
    };
    const handleMouseLeave = () => {
        closeTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setOpen(false), 120);
    };

    return (

                        sx={{

                        }}
                    />

                    color: open ? '#2563EB' : '#374151',
                    fontWeight: 500,
                    fontSize: '0.8rem',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    px: 1.5,
                    py: 0.6,

                        backgroundColor: '#EFF6FF',
                        color: '#2563EB',
                        border: '1px solid #BFDBFE',
                    },
                    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                }}
            >
                {item.label}
            </Button>

            <Popper
                open={open}
                anchorEl={anchorEl}
                placement="bottom-start"
                transition
                style={{ zIndex: 1400 }}

            >

'use client';

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, Grid } from '@mui/material';
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
    FormField,
    LookupField,
    RhfCheckbox,
    RhfChipGroup,
    RhfEmailList,
    RhfLookup,
    RhfSelect,
    RhfTextField,
    RhfPhoneField,
} from '@/components/forms';
import { contactService, findExistingContact } from '@/services';
import {
    COMMUNICATION_TYPES,
    CONTACT_DEPARTMENTS,
    CONTACT_DESIGNATIONS,
} from '@/types/contact.types';
import { LEAD_ASSIGNED_USERS } from '@/types/lead.types';
import type { ConvertLeadFormValues } from '@/validations';

type F = ConvertLeadFormValues;

/** "Create Contact OR Select Contact" section of the Convert Lead form. */
export function ConvertContactSection() {
    const { setValue, control } = useFormContext<F>();
    const mobile = useWatch({ control, name: 'contactMobile' });
    const existingContactId = useWatch({ control, name: 'existingContactId' });
    const [selected, setSelected] = useState('');

    // Label → contact lookup for the "select existing" picker.
    const contactsByLabel = useMemo(() => {
        const map = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof contactService.getAllSync>[number]>();
        contactService.getAllSync().forEach((c) => map.set(`${c.name} (${c.mobile})`, c));
        return map;
    }, []);

    const handleSelect = (label: string) => {
        setSelected(label);
        const contact = contactsByLabel.get(label);
        if (!contact) {
            setValue('existingContactId', '');
            return;
        }
        const opts = { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true } as const;
        setValue('existingContactId', contact.id, opts);
        setValue('contactName', contact.name, opts);
        setValue('contactMobile', contact.mobile, opts);
        setValue('contactPhone3', contact.phone3 ?? '', opts);
        setValue('contactEmails', contact.emailAddresses, opts);
        setValue('designation', contact.designation ?? '', opts);
        setValue('department', contact.department ?? '', opts);
        setValue('location', contact.location ?? '', opts);
        setValue('communicationType', contact.communicationType ?? [], opts);
        setValue('isPrimaryContact', contact.isPrimaryContact, opts);
        setValue('doNotCall', contact.doNotCall, opts);
        setValue('contactDescription', contact.description ?? '', opts);
        setValue('contactAssignedTo', contact.assignedTo, opts);
    };

    const duplicate = useMemo(
        () => (mobile ? findExistingContact(mobile, existingContactId || undefined) : undefined),
        [mobile, existingContactId]
    );

    return (
        <>
            <Grid container spacing={3.5}>
                <Grid size={{ xs: 12 }}>
                    <FormField label="Select Existing Contact" hint="Optional — leave blank to create a new contact">
                        <LookupField
                            value={selected}
                            onChange={handleSelect}
                            options={[...contactsByLabel.keys()]}
                            placeholder="Search existing contacts by name or mobile..."
                        />
                    </FormField>

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Alert, Grid } from '@mui/material';
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import { RhfLookup, RhfSelect, RhfTextField } from '@/components/forms';
import {
    NATURE_OF_BUSINESS,
    ENTITY_TYPES,
    CUSTOMER_TYPES,
    LEAD_SOURCES as ORG_LEAD_SOURCES,
} from '@/components/organizations/constants';
import { findExistingOrganization, organizationService } from '@/services';
import { LEAD_ASSIGNED_USERS } from '@/types/lead.types';
import type { ConvertLeadFormValues } from '@/validations';

type F = ConvertLeadFormValues;

/** "Create Organization OR Select Organization" section of the Convert Lead form. */
export function ConvertOrganizationSection() {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<F>();
    const organizationName = useWatch({ control, name: 'organizationName' });

    const organizationNames = useMemo(
        () => organizationService.getAllSync().map((o) => o.organizationName),
        []
    );
    const existing = useMemo(() => findExistingOrganization(organizationName), [organizationName]);

    // Link to (and prefill from) an existing organization when the typed name matches one.
    useEffect(() => {
        const opts = { shouldValidate: true } as const;
        if (!existing) {
            setValue('existingOrganizationId', '');
            return;
        }
        setValue('existingOrganizationId', existing.id);
        setValue('mailingName', existing.mailingName ?? '', opts);
        setValue('natureOfBusiness', existing.natureOfBusiness || '', opts);
        setValue('typeOfEntity', existing.typeOfEntity || '', opts);
        setValue('customerType', existing.customerType || '', opts);
        setValue('sourceOfLead', existing.sourceOfLead || '', opts);
        setValue('memberOf', existing.memberOfParentCorp ?? '', opts);
        setValue('organizationDescription', existing.description ?? '', opts);
    }, [existing, setValue]);

    return (
        <>
            {existing && (
                <Alert severity="info" sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
                    Organization “{existing.organizationName}” already exists and will be linked — no duplicate will be created.
                </Alert>
            )}
            <Grid container spacing={3.5}>
                <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                    <RhfLookup<F>
                        name="organizationName"
                        label="Organization Name"
                        required
                        hint="Type a new name or pick an existing organization"
                        options={organizationNames}
                        placeholder="Search or enter organization..."
                    />
                    <RhfTextField<F> name="mailingName" label="Mailing Name" placeholder="Official mailing name" />
                    <RhfSelect<F> name="natureOfBusiness" label="Nature of Business" required options={NATURE_OF_BUSINESS} placeholder="Select Nature of Business" />
                    <RhfSelect<F> name="typeOfEntity" label="Type of Entity" required options={ENTITY_TYPES} placeholder="Select Type of Entity" />
                    <RhfSelect<F> name="customerType" label="Customer Type" required options={CUSTOMER_TYPES} placeholder="Select Customer Type" />
                </Grid>
                <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                    <RhfSelect<F> name="sourceOfLead" label="Source of Lead" options={ORG_LEAD_SOURCES} placeholder="Select Source of Lead" />
                    <RhfTextField<F> name="memberOf" label="Member of" placeholder="Parent corporation" />
                    <RhfTextField<F> name="organizationDescription" label="Description" multiline minRows={3} placeholder="Notes about this organization..." />
                    <RhfLookup<F> name="organizationAssignedTo" label="Assigned to" required options={LEAD_ASSIGNED_USERS} placeholder="Select assigned representative" />
                </Grid>
            </Grid>
        </>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Box, CircularProgress, Divider, Typography } from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import PersonOutlineOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlineOutlined';
import BusinessOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BusinessOutlined';
import MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MonetizationOnOutlined';
import TransformOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TransformOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { CommonFormLayout } from '../common/CommonFormLayout';
import { SectionLabel, useRhfForm } from '@/components/forms';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { Lead } from '@/types/lead.types';
import {
    buildConvertLeadDefaults,
    convertLead,
    leadService,
} from '@/services';
import {
    convertLeadFormSchema,
    type ConvertLeadFormValues,
} from '@/validations';
import {
    ConvertContactSection,
    ConvertOpportunitySection,
    ConvertOrganizationSection,
} from './convert';

export interface ConvertLeadFormProps {
    leadId: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

const CONVERT_TABS = [
    {
        id: 'convert',
        label: 'Convert Lead',
        icon: <TransformOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />,
    },
];

const sectionDividerSx = { my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' } as const;

const EMPTY_DEFAULTS: ConvertLeadFormValues = {
    existingOrganizationId: '',
    organizationName: '',
    mailingName: '',
    natureOfBusiness: '',
    typeOfEntity: '',
    customerType: '',
    sourceOfLead: '',
    memberOf: '',
    organizationDescription: '',
    organizationAssignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',

    existingContactId: '',
    contactName: '',
    contactMobile: '',
    contactPhone3: '',
    contactEmails: [{ id: 'eml-1', email: '', isPrimary: true, isOptedOut: false, isInvalidBounce: false }],
    isPrimaryContact: true,
    designation: '',
    department: '',
    location: '',
    communicationType: ['Call', 'Email'],
    doNotCall: false,
    contactDescription: '',
    contactAssignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',

    productCategory: ['Biz Analyst'],
    principalCompany: '',
    referredBy: '',
    opportunityType: 'New Business',
    nextFollowupDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    nextFollowupTime: '11:00 AM',
    followupType: 'Call',
    opportunityDescription: '',
    opportunityLeadSource: 'Website Enquiry',
    opportunityAssignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',
    copyActivitiesTo: [],
};

export function ConvertLeadForm({ leadId, breadcrumbItems }: ConvertLeadFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const [lead, setLead] = useState<Lead | null>(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } =
        useRhfForm<ConvertLeadFormValues>({
            schema: convertLeadFormSchema,
            defaultValues: EMPTY_DEFAULTS,
        });

    const { reset, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        leadService
            .getById(leadId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (!active) return;
                if (!found) {
                    showToast('Lead record not found.', 'error');
                } else {
                    setLead(found);
                    reset(buildConvertLeadDefaults(found));
                }
            })
            .catch((err) => {
                if (active) {
                    showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load lead details.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .finally(() => {
                if (active) setLoading(false);
            });

        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [leadId, reset, showToast]);

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Sales' },
        { label: 'Leads', href: ROUTES.LEADS },
        { label: lead?.name ? `Convert: ${lead.name}` : 'Convert Lead' },
    ];

    const handleSave = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            const result = await convertLead(leadId, values);
            const orgNote = result.organizationCreated
                ? `Created organization "${result.organization.organizationName}".`
                : `Linked existing organization "${result.organization.organizationName}".`;
            const contactNote = result.contactCreated
                ? `Created contact "${result.contact.name}".`
                : `Linked existing contact "${result.contact.name}".`;

            showToast(`Lead converted successfully! ${orgNote} ${contactNote}`, 'success');
            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.LEADS), 1000);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to convert lead.', 'error');
        }
    });

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (isDirty && !window.confirm('Discard unsaved lead conversion data?')) return;
        router.push(ROUTES.LEADS);
    };

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', py: 12 }}>
                <CircularProgress size={36} sx={{ color: '#2563eb' }} />
                <Typography sx={{ ml: 2, color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                    Loading lead data...
                </Typography>
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={CONVERT_TABS}
                activeTab="convert"
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel="Convert Lead"
                cancelLabel="Cancel"
                toast={
                    <AppToast
                        open={toast.open}
                        message={toast.message}
                        severity={toast.severity}
                        onClose={closeToast}
                    />
                }
            >
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<PersonOutlineOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="1. Create Contact OR Select Contact"
                />
                <ConvertContactSection />

                <Divider sx={sectionDividerSx} />

                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<BusinessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="2. Create Organization OR Select Organization"
                />
                <ConvertOrganizationSection />

                <Divider sx={sectionDividerSx} />

                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="3. Create Opportunity"
                />
                <ConvertOpportunitySection />
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

export default ConvertLeadForm;

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Typography, Chip, Divider } from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import EmailOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import LocalFireDepartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalFireDepartment';
import CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined';
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';
import BusinessOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BusinessOutlined';
import CheckCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import AccessTimeOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccessTimeOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import PublishedWithChangesIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PublishedWithChanges';

import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { Lead } from '@/types/lead.types';
import { leadService, subscribeCrmSync } from '@/services';
import {
    EntityDetailDrawer,
    DrawerSectionCard,
    DrawerMetricGrid,
    DrawerChannelRow,
    type AuditRevisionItem,
} from '@/components/common/Drawer';
import { AppToast } from '@/components/common/AppToast';
import { LEAD_FORM_TABS } from './LeadForm';

export interface LeadDetailDrawerProps {
    lead: Lead | null;
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onEdit?: (id: string) => void;
    onLeadUpdated?: (updatedLead: Lead) => void;
    onShowToast?: (message: string, severity?: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning') => void;
}

export function LeadDetailDrawer({
    lead,
    open,
    onClose,
    onEdit,
    onLeadUpdated,
    onShowToast,
}: LeadDetailDrawerProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const [currentLead, setCurrentLead] = useState<Lead | null>(lead);
    const [, setSyncVersion] = useState(0);

    useEffect(() => {
        setCurrentLead(lead);
    }, [lead]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open || !lead?.id) return;

        const refreshLead = () => {
            const fresh = leadService.getByIdSync(lead.id);
            if (fresh) {
                setCurrentLead(fresh);
                onLeadUpdated?.(fresh);
            }
            setSyncVersion((v) => v + 1);
        };

        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(refreshLead);
        return unsubscribe;
    }, [open, lead?.id, onLeadUpdated]);

    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'error',
    });

    if (!lead && !currentLead) return null;

    const l = currentLead || lead!;

    const triggerToast = (message: string, severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning' = 'error') => {
        setToast({ open: true, message, severity });
        onShowToast?.(message, severity);
    };

    const handleConvertLead = () => {
        const orgName = (l.organizationName || '').trim();
        if (!orgName) {
            triggerToast('Organisation Name is required.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        if (l.status === 'Converted') {
            triggerToast('This lead has already been converted.', 'info');
            return;
        }

        router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_CONVERT(l.id));
    };

    const handleEdit = () => {
        if (onEdit) {
            onEdit(l.id);
        } else {
            router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_EDIT(l.id));
        }
    };

    const isHot = l.leadType === 'Hot';
    const isWarm = l.leadType === 'Warm';
    const hasOrg = Boolean(l.organizationName && l.organizationName.trim().length > 0);
    const isConverted = l.status === 'Converted';

    const auditRevisions: AuditRevisionItem[] = [
        ...(isConverted
            ? [
                  {
                      title: 'Lead converted to Account & Contact',
                      author: l.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
                      time: 'Just now',
                      note: `Converted with organization: ${l.organizationName || 'Entity'}`,
                      tag: 'Converted',
                  },
              ]
            : []),
        {
            title: 'Lead record updated',
            author: l.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
            time: '2 hours ago',
            note: `Status synchronized: ${l.status}`,
            tag: l.status,
        },
        {
            title: `Followup scheduled: ${l.followupType}`,
            author: l.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
            time: '1 day ago',
            note: l.addDescription,
        },
        {
            title: `Lead captured via ${l.leadSource}`,
            author: l.createdBy || 'mittal.sharma',
            time: '3 days ago',
            note: `Assigned to ${l.assignedTo}`,
        },
    ];

    return (
        <>
            <EntityDetailDrawer
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            title={l.name}
            subtitle={`${l.leadCode} • ${l.organizationName || 'Prospect'}`}
            avatarIcon={<PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 24, color: '#ffffff' }} />}
            avatarBg={
                isHot
                    ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #dc2626 0%, #b91c1c 100%)'
                    : 'linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb 0%, #1d4ed8 100%)'
            }
            verified={true}
            badges={[
                {
                    label: l.leadType || 'Normal',
                    icon: isHot ? <LocalFireDepartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: '13px !important' }} /> : undefined,
                    color: isHot ? '#b91c1c' : isWarm ? '#b45309' : '#1e3a8a',
                    backgroundColor: isHot ? '#fee2e2' : isWarm ? '#fef3c7' : '#eff6ff',
                    borderColor: isHot ? '#fca5a5' : isWarm ? '#fde68a' : '#bfdbfe',
                },
                {
                    label: l.status,
                    color: '#047857',
                    backgroundColor: '#ecfdf5',
                    borderColor: '#a7f3d0',
                },
                {
                    label: l.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
                    color: '#475569',
                    backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                    borderColor: '#cbd5e1',
                },
            ]}
            headerActions={{
                onEdit: handleEdit,
                onPhone: () => window.open(`tel:${l.mobile}`),
            }}
            formTabs={LEAD_FORM_TABS}
            tabContents={{
                overview: (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
                        {/* Linked Organization Card */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard title="PROSPECTIVE ORGANIZATION" bg="#f8fafc">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mt: 0.5 }}>
                                <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.98rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#1d4ed8' }}>
                                    {l.organizationName || 'Individual Prospect / Non-Entity'}
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                            {l.mailingName && l.mailingName !== l.organizationName && (
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.3 }}>

                                </Typography>
                            )}
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        {/* Next Followup Highlight Card */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard
                            title="NEXT SCHEDULED FOLLOWUP"
                            icon={<CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#d97706' }} />}
                            titleSx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#92400e' }}
                            bg="#fffbeb"
                            borderColor="#fde68a"

                                    <Chip
                                        label={l.followupType}
                                        size="small"
