                                            icon={<PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />}

                                )}

                            items={[
                                { label: 'DESIGNATION', value: l.designation || 'Key Decision Maker', valueSize: '0.86rem' },
                                { label: 'DEPARTMENT', value: l.department || 'Management', valueSize: '0.86rem' },

                                    valueSize: '0.82rem',
                                    valueWeight: 600,
                                    valueColor: '#334155',
                                },
                                {
                                    label: 'NO OF EMPLOYEES',
                                    value: l.noOfEmployee || '11 – 50 Staff',
                                    valueSize: '0.82rem',

                                    valueColor: '#334155',

                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#334155', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>

                        >
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#1e293b', fontWeight: 500, lineHeight: 1.4 }}>

                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 2, mt: 1.2, pt: 1, borderTop: '1px solid #f1f5f9' }}>

                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 700 }}>POSTAL PIN</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155' }}>
                                        {l.primaryPostalCode || '-'}

                                </Box>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 700 }}>COUNTRY</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155' }}>
                                        {l.primaryCountry || 'India'}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>

                            {l.primaryLatitude && l.primaryLatitude !== '0.00000000' && (

                                {l.otherAddress || 'Same as primary address or not provided'}

                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 700 }}>CITY / STATE</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155' }}>
                                        {l.otherCity || '-'}, {l.otherState || '-'}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b', fontWeight: 700 }}>POSTAL PIN</Typography>

                                        {l.otherPostalCode || '-'}

            auditRevisions={auditRevisions}
            includeChangesTab={true}
            statusText={isConverted ? 'Lead Converted' : `Next Followup: ${l.nextFollowupDate}`}
            primaryAction={{
                label: 'Edit Lead',
                onClick: handleEdit,
                icon: <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
            }}
            secondaryAction={{
                label: isConverted ? 'Lead Converted' : 'Convert Lead',
                icon: isConverted ? (
                    <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#059669' }} />
                ) : (
                    <PublishedWithChangesIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                ),
                onClick: handleConvertLead,
                variant: 'outlined',
                tooltip: !hasOrg
                    ? 'Organisation Name is required to convert lead'
                    : isConverted
                    ? 'Lead has already been converted'
                    : 'Convert Lead to Organization & Contact',
                sx: {
                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    height: 36,
                    px: 1.8,
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    color: isConverted ? '#047857' : hasOrg ? '#047857' : '#dc2626',
                    borderColor: isConverted ? '#a7f3d0' : hasOrg ? '#a7f3d0' : '#fca5a5',
                    backgroundColor: isConverted ? '#ecfdf5' : hasOrg ? '#ecfdf5' : '#fef2f2',
                    '&:hover': {
                        borderColor: isConverted ? '#047857' : hasOrg ? '#059669' : '#ef4444',
                        backgroundColor: isConverted ? '#d1fae5' : hasOrg ? '#d1fae5' : '#fee2e2',
                    },
                },
            }}
        />
        <AppToast
            open={toast.open}
            message={toast.message}
            severity={toast.severity}
            onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
        />
    </>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider } from 'react-hook-form';
import ArticleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArticleOutlined';
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { CommonFormLayout } from '../common/CommonFormLayout';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { useRhfForm } from '../forms/rhf';
import { ROUTES } from '../../config/constants';
import { leadFormSchema } from '../../validations';
import type { LeadFormData } from '../../types/lead.types';
import { leadService } from '@/services';

// Modular Lead Form Sections
import {
    LeadOverviewSection,
    LeadAddressSection,
} from './sections';

export type LeadTabKey = 'overview' | 'address';

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Lead Form Tabs ────────────────────────────────
export const LEAD_FORM_TABS: (FormTabDefinition & { id: LeadTabKey })[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <ArticleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'address',
        label: 'Address Information',
        icon: <PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
];

export interface LeadFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit';
    initialData?: Partial<LeadFormData>;
    leadId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

const DEFAULT_FORM: LeadFormData = {
    name: '',
    mobile: '',
    emailAddresses: [
        {
            id: 'eml-1',
            email: '',
            isPrimary: true,
            isOptedOut: false,
            isInvalidBounce: false,
        },
    ],
    mailingName: '',
    designation: '',
    leadSource: 'Website Enquiry',
    productCategory: ['Biz Analyst'],
    followupType: 'Call',
    addDescription: '',
    registrationType: 'Registered',
    turnover: '₹5 Cr – ₹25 Cr',
    assignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',

    otherPhone: '',
    organizationName: '',
    department: 'Executive Management',
    leadType: 'Hot',
    status: 'New',
    nextFollowupDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0], // Tomorrow
    nextFollowupTime: '11:00 AM',
    description: '',
    noOfEmployee: '11 – 50 Staff Members',
    referredBy: '',

    primaryAddress: '',
    primaryCity: '',
    primaryState: 'Delhi',
    primaryPostalCode: '',
    primaryCountry: 'India',
    primaryLatitude: '0.00000000',

    otherAddress: '',
    otherCity: '',
    otherState: 'Delhi',
    otherPostalCode: '',
    otherCountry: 'India',
    copyAddressFromLeft: false,
    otherLongitude: '0.00000000',
};

export default function LeadForm({
    mode = 'create',
    initialData,
    leadId,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: LeadFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<LeadTabKey>('overview');

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } = useRhfForm<LeadFormData>({
        schema: leadFormSchema,
        defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData },
    });
    const { reset, watch, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;
    const leadName = watch('name');

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Sales' },
        { label: 'Leads', href: ROUTES.LEADS },
        { label: mode === 'edit' ? (leadName ? `Edit: ${leadName}` : 'Edit Lead') : 'Create Lead' },
    ];

    // Populate data when editing
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!leadId) return;
        let active = true;
        leadService
            .getById(leadId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) reset(found);
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [leadId, reset]);

    const handleSave = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            if (mode === 'edit' && leadId) {
                await leadService.update(leadId, values);
                showToast('Lead details updated successfully!', 'success');
            } else {
                await leadService.create(values);
                showToast('Lead created successfully! Added to your sales pipeline.', 'success');
            }
            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.LEADS), 800);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'An error occurred while saving the lead.', 'error');
        }
    });

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (isDirty && !confirm('You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?')) {
            return;
        }
        router.push(ROUTES.LEADS);
    };

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={LEAD_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onTabChange={(tabId) => setActiveTab(tabId as LeadTabKey)}
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Lead' : 'Save Lead'}
                cancelLabel="Cancel"
                disableContentPadding
                toast={<AppToast open={toast.open} message={toast.message} severity={toast.severity} onClose={closeToast} />}
            >
                {/* Keep both panels mounted so validation state of hidden tab is preserved */}
                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'overview'}>
                    <LeadOverviewSection />
                </div>
                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'address'}>
                    <LeadAddressSection />
                </div>
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

File: src/components/leads/LeadsMasterView.tsx

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import GroupOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/GroupOutlined';
import LocalFireDepartmentOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalFireDepartmentOutlined';
import LocalFireDepartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalFireDepartment';
import FiberNewOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FiberNewOutlined';
import TodayOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TodayOutlined';
import AccountCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountCircleOutlined';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import EmailOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../common/CommonMasterView';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '../../config/constants';
import type { Lead } from '../../types/lead.types';
import { leadService, subscribeCrmSync } from '@/services';
import type { LeadFilterTab } from './master';
import { LeadDetailDrawer } from './LeadDetailDrawer';

export function LeadsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();

    const [leads, setLeads] = useState<Lead[]>([]);
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<LeadFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<string>('name');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
    const [selectedDrawerLead, setSelectedDrawerLead] = useState<Lead | null>(null);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const todayStr = useMemo(() => new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], []);

    const loadLeads = useCallback(() => {
        const data = leadService.getAllSync();
        setLeads(data);
        setSelectedDrawerLead((prev) => {
            if (!prev) return null;
            return data.find((l) => l.id === prev.id) || null;
        });
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        leadService
            .getAll()
            .then((data) => {
                if (active) {
                    setLeads(data);
                    setSelectedDrawerLead((prev) => {
                        if (!prev) return null;
                        return data.find((l) => l.id === prev.id) || null;
                    });
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleFocus = () => {
            loadLeads();
        };
        const handleVisibility = () => {
            if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                loadLeads();
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(loadLeads);

        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
            document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
            unsubscribe();
        };
    }, [loadLeads]);

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<LeadFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        return [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Leads',
                icon: <GroupOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: leads.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'hot',
                label: 'Hot Leads',
                icon: <LocalFireDepartmentOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: leads.filter((l) => l.leadType === 'Hot').length,
                activeColor: '#dc2626',
                activeBgColor: '#fef2f2',
                activeBadgeBgColor: '#fee2e2',
            },
            {
                id: 'new',
                label: 'New Enquiries',
                icon: <FiberNewOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: leads.filter((l) => l.status === 'New').length,
            },
            {
                id: 'followup_today',
                label: 'Followup Today',
                icon: <TodayOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: leads.filter((l) => l.nextFollowupDate === todayStr).length,
                activeColor: '#d97706',
            },
            {
                id: 'my_leads',
                label: 'My Leads',
                icon: <AccountCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: leads.filter((l) => (l.assignedTo || '').includes('mittal.sharma')).length,
            },
        ];
    }, [leads, todayStr]);

    // ── Filter Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredLeads = useMemo(() => {
        return leads.filter((lead) => {
            if (activeTab === 'hot' && lead.leadType !== 'Hot') return false;
            if (activeTab === 'new' && lead.status !== 'New') return false;
            if (activeTab === 'followup_today' && lead.nextFollowupDate !== todayStr) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'my_leads' && !(lead.assignedTo || '').includes('mittal.sharma')) return false;

            if (searchQuery.trim()) {
                const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
                const inName = lead.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inCode = lead.leadCode.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inOrg = (lead.organizationName || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inPhone = (lead.mobile || '').includes(q) || (lead.otherPhone || '').includes(q);
                const inEmail = (lead.emailAddresses || []).some((e) => e.email.toLowerCase().includes(q));
                const inProduct = (lead.productCategory || []).some((p) => p.toLowerCase().includes(q));
                const inStatus = lead.status.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inSource = lead.leadSource.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inAssigned = lead.assignedTo.toLowerCase().includes(q);

                return (
                    inName ||
                    inCode ||
                    inOrg ||
                    inPhone ||
                    inEmail ||
                    inProduct ||
                    inStatus ||
                    inSource ||
                    inAssigned
                );
            }

            return true;
        });
    }, [leads, activeTab, searchQuery, todayStr]);

    // ── Sort Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const sortedLeads = useMemo(() => {
        return [...filteredLeads].sort((a, b) => {
            const valA = ((a as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            const valB = ((b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
            if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
            return 0;
        });
    }, [filteredLeads, sortField, sortOrder]);

    const paginatedLeads = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return sortedLeads.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [sortedLeads, page, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleToggleSelectAll = (checked?: boolean) => {
        if (checked) {
            setSelectedIds(paginatedLeads.map((l) => l.id));
        } else {
            setSelectedIds([]);
        }
    };

    const handleToggleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        setSelectedIds((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]));
    };

    const handleSort = (field: string) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder((prev) => (prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;
        if (!confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${selectedIds.length} selected lead(s)?`)) return;

        await leadService.deleteBulk(selectedIds);
        setSelectedIds([]);
        loadLeads();
        setToast({
            open: true,
            message: `${selectedIds.length} lead(s) deleted successfully.`,
            severity: 'success',
        });
    };

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Lead>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'name',
                label: 'LEAD NAME',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 200,
                render: (l) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0.3 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                            <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                            <Typography
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    setSelectedDrawerLead(l);
                                }}
                                sx={{
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                                }}
                            >
                                {l.name}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8, pl: 3 }}>
                            <Chip
                                label={l.leadCode}
                                size="small"
                                sx={{
                                    height: 18,
                                    fontSize: '0.62rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,

                                {l.mobile || l.otherPhone || '-'}

                                fontWeight: 700,

                                color: isHot ? '#991b1b' : isWarm ? '#92400e' : '#475569',
                                border: isHot ? '1px solid #fecaca' : isWarm ? '1px solid #fde68a' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                            }}
                        />
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'status',
                label: 'STATUS',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 120,
                render: (l) => {
                    let bg = '#eff6ff';
                    let color = '#1d4ed8';
                    let border = '#bfdbfe';

                    if (l.status === 'New') {
                        bg = '#eff6ff';
                        color = '#1e40af';
                        border = '#bfdbfe';
                    } else if (l.status === 'Contacted' || l.status === 'In Discussion') {
                        bg = '#f5f3ff';
                        color = '#6d28d9';
                        border = '#ddd6fe';
                    } else if (l.status === 'Demo Scheduled') {
                        bg = '#fdf4ff';
                        color = '#a21caf';
                        border = '#f5d0fe';
                    } else if (l.status === 'Proposal Sent' || l.status === 'Negotiation') {
                        bg = '#fffbeb';
                        color = '#b45309';
                        border = '#fde68a';
                    } else if (l.status === 'Converted') {
                        bg = '#ecfdf5';
                        color = '#047857';
                        border = '#a7f3d0';
                    } else if (l.status.includes('Lost') || l.status.includes('Unqualified')) {
                        bg = '#fef2f2';
                        color = '#b91c1c';
                        border = '#fecaca';

                    return (
                        <Chip
                            label={l.status || 'New'}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                                height: 22,
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                backgroundColor: bg,
                                color: color,
                                border: `1px solid ${border}`,
                            }}
                        />
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'nextFollowupDate',
                label: 'NEXT FOLLOWUP',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (l) => {
                    const isToday = l.nextFollowupDate === todayStr;

                    return (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                            <CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon
                                sx={{

                                    sx={{
                                        fontSize: '0.78rem',

                                        color: isToday ? '#b45309' : '#334155',

                                >
                                    {l.nextFollowupDate || '-'}
                                    {isToday && (

                                            component="span"
                                            sx={{
                                                ml: 0.6,
                                                px: 0.6,
                                                py: 0.1,
                                                borderRadius: '4px',
                                                fontSize: '0.62rem',
                                                fontWeight: 800,
                                                backgroundColor: '#fef3c7',
                                                color: '#b45309',
                                                border: '1px solid #fde68a',
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            TODAY
                                        </Box>
                                    )}
                                </Typography>
                                {(l.nextFollowupTime || l.followupType) && (
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                                        {l.followupType ? `${l.followupType} • ` : ''}
                                        {l.nextFollowupTime || ''}
                                    </Typography>
                                )}
                            </Box>
                        </Box>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'assignedTo',
                label: 'ASSIGNED TO',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 130,
                render: (l) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                        {l.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
        ],
        [todayStr]
    );

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Lead, LeadFilterTab>
            breadcrumbItems={[
                { label: 'Sales' },
                { label: 'Leads' },
            ]}
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            searchConfig={{
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by name, company, phone, product, status...',
                searchWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: 340 },
                onNewClick: () => router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_NEW),
                newButtonLabel: 'New Lead',
                onRefresh: () => {
                    loadLeads();
                    setToast({ open: true, message: 'Leads refreshed.', severity: 'info' });
                },
                refreshTooltip: 'Refresh Leads',
                selectedCount: selectedIds.length,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
            }}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedLeads}
            keyExtractor={(l) => l.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={handleToggleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={handleToggleSelectAll}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={handleSort}
            onView={(l) => setSelectedDrawerLead(l)}
            onEdit={(l) => router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_EDIT(l.id))}
            onRowClick={(lead) => setSelectedDrawerLead(lead)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerLead?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Lead Details"
            editTooltip="Edit Lead"
            emptyTitle="No leads in pipeline"
            emptyDescription="Record new prospective clients, followups, and product interests to begin converting sales."
            emptyActionLabel="Create Lead"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_NEW)}
            emptyIcon={<PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />}
            minHeight={300}
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: sortedLeads.length,
                onPageChange: (newPage) => setPage(newPage),
                onRowsPerPageChange: (newRows) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(newRows);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            drawer={
                <LeadDetailDrawer
                    lead={selectedDrawerLead}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerLead)}
                    onClose={() => setSelectedDrawerLead(null)}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.LEAD_EDIT(id))}
                    onLeadUpdated={(updatedLead) => {
                        setSelectedDrawerLead(updatedLead);
                        loadLeads();
                    }}
                    onShowToast={(message, severity = 'success') => {
                        setToast({ open: true, message, severity });
                    }}
                />
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerLead)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Box } from '@mui/material';
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';
import BusinessOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BusinessOutlined';
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
    SectionLabel,
    RhfTextField,
    RhfPinCodeField,
    RhfSelect,
    RhfCheckbox,
} from '@/components/forms';
import { INDIAN_STATES, COUNTRIES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { LeadFormData } from '@/types/lead.types';

const columnSx = { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 } as const;

const PRIMARY_TO_OTHER = [
    ['primaryAddress', 'otherAddress'],
    ['primaryCity', 'otherCity'],
    ['primaryState', 'otherState'],
    ['primaryPostalCode', 'otherPostalCode'],
    ['primaryCountry', 'otherCountry'],
] as const;

/** Address tab of the Lead form. Must be rendered inside a `FormProvider<LeadFormData>`. */
export function LeadAddressSection() {
    const { control, getValues, setValue } = useFormContext<LeadFormData>();
    const copy = Boolean(useWatch({ control, name: 'copyAddressFromLeft' }));
    const primaryValues = useWatch({
        control,
        name: PRIMARY_TO_OTHER.map(([primary]) => primary),
    });

    // Keep "other address" mirrored while the copy toggle is on.
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (!copy) return;
        PRIMARY_TO_OTHER.forEach(([primary, other], i) => {
            const next = (primaryValues[i] as string) || (primary === 'primaryCountry' ? 'India' : '');
            if (getValues(other) !== next) setValue(other, next, { shouldDirty: true });
        });
    }, [copy, primaryValues, getValues, setValue]);

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'grid',
                    gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' },
                    gap: { xs: 3, md: 4 },
                }}
            >
                <Box sx={columnSx}>
                    <SectionLabel icon={<PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />} label="PRIMARY ADDRESS" sx={{ mb: 1 }} />
                    <RhfTextField<LeadFormData> name="primaryAddress" label="Address" hint="Registered or primary premises" multiline minRows={3} maxRows={4} placeholder="Enter a location" />
                    <RhfTextField<LeadFormData> name="primaryCity" label="City" placeholder="e.g. Gurugram / New Delhi" />
                    <RhfSelect<LeadFormData> name="primaryState" label="State/Region" options={INDIAN_STATES} placeholder="Select State / Region" />
                    <RhfPinCodeField<LeadFormData> name="primaryPostalCode" label="Postal Code" placeholder="e.g. 110001" />
                    <RhfSelect<LeadFormData> name="primaryCountry" label="Country" options={COUNTRIES} placeholder="Select Country" />
                    <RhfTextField<LeadFormData> name="primaryLatitude" label="Latitude" hint="GPS coordinate" placeholder="0.00000000" />
                </Box>

                <Box sx={columnSx}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1, mb: 1 }}>
                        <SectionLabel icon={<BusinessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#64748b' }} />} label="OTHER ADDRESS" />
                        <RhfCheckbox<LeadFormData> name="copyAddressFromLeft" label="Copy address from left" />
                    </Box>
                    <RhfTextField<LeadFormData> name="otherAddress" label="Other Address" hint="Branch, factory, or dispatch location" multiline minRows={3} maxRows={4} placeholder="Enter branch or factory location" disabled={copy} />
                    <RhfTextField<LeadFormData> name="otherCity" label="City" placeholder="Enter city" disabled={copy} />
                    <RhfSelect<LeadFormData> name="otherState" label="State/Region" options={INDIAN_STATES} placeholder="Select State / Region" />
                    <RhfPinCodeField<LeadFormData> name="otherPostalCode" label="Postal Code" placeholder="Enter PIN code" disabled={copy} />
                    <RhfSelect<LeadFormData> name="otherCountry" label="Country" options={COUNTRIES} placeholder="Select Country" />
                    <RhfTextField<LeadFormData> name="otherLongitude" label="Longitude" hint="GPS coordinate" placeholder="0.00000000" />
                </Box>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import TrendingUpOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/TrendingUpOutlined';
import MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MonetizationOnOutlined';
import CheckCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import ScheduleIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Schedule';
import AccountCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountCircleOutlined';
import WorkspacePremiumOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WorkspacePremiumOutlined';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../common/CommonMasterView';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '../../config/constants';
import type { Opportunity } from '../../types/opportunity.types';
import { opportunityService } from '../../services/opportunity.service';
import { subscribeCrmSync } from '@/services';
import type { OpportunityFilterTab, OpportunitySortField } from './master';
import { OpportunityDetailDrawer } from './OpportunityDetailDrawer';

const formatCurrency = (val: number) =>
    new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
        style: 'currency',
        currency: 'INR',
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(val);

export function OpportunitiesMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();

    const [opportunities, setOpportunities] = useState<Opportunity[]>([]);
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<OpportunityFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<OpportunitySortField>('createdAt');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');
    const [selectedDrawerOpp, setSelectedDrawerOpp] = useState<Opportunity | null>(null);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const todayStr = useMemo(() => new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], []);

    const loadOpportunities = useCallback(() => {
        const data = opportunityService.getAllOpportunities();
        setOpportunities(data);
        setSelectedDrawerOpp((prev) => {
            if (!prev) return null;
            return data.find((o) => o.id === prev.id) || null;
        });
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        opportunityService
            .getAll()
            .then((data) => {
                if (active) {
                    setOpportunities(data);
                    setSelectedDrawerOpp((prev) => {
                        if (!prev) return null;
                        return data.find((o) => o.id === prev.id) || null;
                    });
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleFocus = () => {
            loadOpportunities();
        };
        const handleVisibility = () => {
            if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                loadOpportunities();
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(loadOpportunities);

        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
            document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
            unsubscribe();
        };
    }, [loadOpportunities]);

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<OpportunityFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        return [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Opportunities',
                icon: <TrendingUpOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'open',
                label: 'Active Pipeline',
                icon: <MonetizationOnOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.filter(
                    (o) => !['Closed Won', 'Closed Lost'].includes(o.salesStage)
                ).length,
                activeColor: '#2563eb',
            },
            {
                id: 'closing_soon',
                label: 'Followup Today',
                icon: <ScheduleIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.filter((o) =>
                    ['Proposal/Price Quote', 'Negotiation/Review'].includes(o.salesStage)
                ).length,
                activeColor: '#d97706',
            },
            {
                id: 'won',
                label: 'Closed Won',
                icon: <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.filter((o) => o.salesStage === 'Closed Won').length,
                activeColor: '#16a34a',
            },
            {
                id: 'high_value',
                label: 'High Value (₹1L+)',
                icon: <WorkspacePremiumOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.filter((o) => (o.grandTotal || 0) >= 100000).length,
                activeColor: '#7c3aed',
            },
            {
                id: 'my_deals',
                label: 'My Deals',
                icon: <AccountCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: opportunities.filter((o) =>
                    (o.assignedTo || '').includes('mittal.sharma')
                ).length,
            },
        ];
    }, [opportunities]);

    // ── Filter Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredOpportunities = useMemo(() => {
        return opportunities.filter((opp) => {
            if (activeTab === 'open' && ['Closed Won', 'Closed Lost'].includes(opp.salesStage)) {
                return false;
            }
            if (
                activeTab === 'closing_soon' &&
                !['Proposal/Price Quote', 'Negotiation/Review'].includes(opp.salesStage)
            ) {
                return false;
            }
            if (activeTab === 'won' && opp.salesStage !== 'Closed Won') {
                return false;
            }
            if (activeTab === 'high_value' && (opp.grandTotal || 0) < 100000) {
                return false;
            }
            if (activeTab === 'my_deals' && !(opp.assignedTo || '').includes('mittal.sharma')) {
                return false;
            }

            if (searchQuery.trim()) {
                const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
                const inOrg = opp.organizationName.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inCode = opp.opportunityCode.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inContact = opp.contactName.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inPhone = opp.contactNumber.includes(q);
                const inEmail = (opp.emailAddress || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inStage = opp.salesStage.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inType = opp.type.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inSource = opp.leadSource.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inAssigned = opp.assignedTo.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const inProduct = (opp.productCategory || []).some((p) =>
                    p.toLowerCase().includes(q)
                );

                return (
                    inOrg ||
                    inCode ||
                    inContact ||
                    inPhone ||
                    inEmail ||
                    inStage ||
                    inType ||
                    inSource ||
                    inAssigned ||
                    inProduct
                );
            }

            return true;
        });
    }, [opportunities, activeTab, searchQuery]);

    // ── Sort Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const sortedOpportunities = useMemo(() => {
        return [...filteredOpportunities].sort((a, b) => {
            if (sortField === 'grandTotal') {
                const valA = a.grandTotal || 0;
                const valB = b.grandTotal || 0;
                return sortOrder === 'asc' ? valA - valB : valB - valA;
            }

            const valA = ((a as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            const valB = ((b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
            if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
            return 0;
        });
    }, [filteredOpportunities, sortField, sortOrder]);

    const paginatedOpportunities = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return sortedOpportunities.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [sortedOpportunities, page, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleSort = (field: OpportunitySortField) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder((prev) => (prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'));
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    const handleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        setSelectedIds((prev) =>
            prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
        );
    };

    const handleSelectAll = (checked?: boolean) => {
        if (checked) {
            setSelectedIds(paginatedOpportunities.map((o) => o.id));
        } else {
            setSelectedIds([]);
        }
    };

    const handleEdit = useCallback(
        (id: string) => {
            router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_EDIT(id));
        },
        [router]
    );

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        if (
            confirm(
                `Are you sure you want to delete ${selectedIds.length} selected opportunities?`
            )
        ) {
            try {
                await opportunityService.bulkDeleteOpportunities(selectedIds);
                setSelectedIds([]);
                loadOpportunities();
                setToast({
                    open: true,
                    message: `${selectedIds.length} opportunities deleted successfully.`,
                    severity: 'success',
                });
            } catch {
                setToast({
                    open: true,
                    message: 'Failed to bulk delete opportunities.',
                    severity: 'error',
                });
            }
        }
    };

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Opportunity>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'opportunityCode',
                label: 'DEAL / CODE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 190,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0.3 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                            <TrendingUpOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                            <Typography
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    setSelectedDrawerOpp(o);
                                }}
                                sx={{
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                                }}
                            >
                                {o.opportunityCode}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        <Box sx={{ pl: 3 }}>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b' }} noWrap>
                                {o.groupName || 'Primary Solution'}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'organizationName',
                label: 'ORGANIZATION & CONTACT',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 200,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 0.3 }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                            <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: '#64748b', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#1e293b', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                                {o.organizationName}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        {o.contactName && (
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.6, pl: 2.8 }}>
                                <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#64748b' }} noWrap>
                                    {o.contactName} ({o.contactNumber})
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'salesStage',
                label: 'SALES STAGE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (o) => {
                    let bg = '#eff6ff';
                    let color = '#1d4ed8';
                    let border = '#bfdbfe';

                    if (o.salesStage === 'Closed Won') {
                        bg = '#ecfdf5';
                        color = '#047857';
                        border = '#a7f3d0';
                    } else if (o.salesStage === 'Closed Lost') {
                        bg = '#fef2f2';
                        color = '#b91c1c';
                        border = '#fecaca';
                    } else if (o.salesStage.includes('Proposal') || o.salesStage.includes('Negotiation')) {
                        bg = '#fffbeb';
                        color = '#b45309';
                        border = '#fde68a';
                    } else if (o.salesStage.includes('Value') || o.salesStage.includes('Needs')) {
                        bg = '#f5f3ff';
                        color = '#6d28d9';
                        border = '#ddd6fe';
                    }

                    return (
                        <Chip
                            label={o.salesStage}
                            size="small"
                            icon={
                                o.salesStage === 'Closed Won' ? (
                                    <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon
                                        sx={{ fontSize: '13px !important', color: '#047857 !important' }}
                                    />
                                ) : undefined
                            }
                            sx={{
                                height: 22,
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                backgroundColor: bg,
                                color: color,
                                border: `1px solid ${border}`,
                            }}
                        />
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'grandTotal',
                label: 'DEAL VALUE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 130,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                            {formatCurrency(o.grandTotal || 0)}
                        </Typography>
                        {o.lineItems && o.lineItems.length > 0 && (
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                                {o.lineItems.length} line item(s)
                            </Typography>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'productCategory',
                label: 'PRODUCT CATEGORY',
                sortable: false,
                minWidth: 170,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 0.5 }}>
                        {o.productCategory && o.productCategory.length > 0 ? (
                            o.productCategory.map((cat, idx) => (
                                <Chip
                                    key={idx}
                                    label={cat}
                                    size="small"
                                    sx={{
                                        height: 20,
                                        fontSize: '0.66rem',
                                        fontWeight: 600,
                                        backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                        color: '#1d4ed8',
                                        border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                                    }}
                                />
                            ))
                        ) : (
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>-</Typography>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'type',
                label: 'TYPE & SOURCE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#334155', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            {o.type || 'New Business'}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                            via {o.leadSource}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'nextFollowupDate',
                label: 'NEXT FOLLOWUP',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (o) => {
                    const isToday = o.nextFollowupDate === todayStr;

                    return (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                            <CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon
                                sx={{
                                    fontSize: 16,
                                    color: isToday ? '#d97706' : '#64748b',
                                }}
                            />
                            <Box>
                                <Typography
                                    sx={{
                                        fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                        fontWeight: isToday ? 700 : 500,
                                        color: isToday ? '#b45309' : '#334155',
                                    }}
                                >
                                    {o.nextFollowupDate || '-'}
                                    {isToday && (
                                        <Box
                                            component="span"
                                            sx={{
                                                ml: 0.6,
                                                px: 0.6,
                                                py: 0.1,
                                                borderRadius: '4px',
                                                fontSize: '0.62rem',
                                                fontWeight: 800,
                                                backgroundColor: '#fef3c7',
                                                color: '#b45309',
                                                border: '1px solid #fde68a',
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            TODAY
                                        </Box>
                                    )}
                                </Typography>
                                {o.followupType && (
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                                        {o.followupType} {o.nextFollowupTime ? `• ${o.nextFollowupTime}` : ''}
                                    </Typography>
                                )}
                            </Box>
                        </Box>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'assignedTo',
                label: 'ASSIGNED TO',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 130,
                render: (o) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                        {o.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
        ],
        [todayStr]
    );

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Opportunity, OpportunityFilterTab>
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            searchConfig={{
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by deal, company, contact, stage, amount...',
                searchWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: 340 },
                onNewClick: () => router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_NEW),
                newButtonLabel: 'New Opportunity',
                selectedCount: selectedIds.length,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
                onRefresh: () => {
                    loadOpportunities();
                    setToast({ open: true, message: 'Opportunities refreshed.', severity: 'info' });
                },
                refreshTooltip: 'Refresh Opportunities',
            }}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedOpportunities}
            keyExtractor={(o) => o.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={handleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={handleSelectAll}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={(f) => handleSort(f as OpportunitySortField)}
            onView={(o) => setSelectedDrawerOpp(o)}
            onEdit={(o) => handleEdit(o.id)}
            onRowClick={(opp) => setSelectedDrawerOpp(opp)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerOpp?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Deal Details"
            editTooltip="Edit Opportunity"
            emptyTitle="No opportunities in pipeline"
            emptyDescription="Create your first deal opportunity and track it from qualification to closed won."
            emptyActionLabel="Create Opportunity"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_NEW)}
            emptyIcon={<TrendingUpOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />}
            minHeight={300}
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: sortedOpportunities.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onRowsPerPageChange: (r) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(r);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                hideWhenEmpty: true,
            }}
            drawer={
                <OpportunityDetailDrawer
                    opportunity={selectedDrawerOpp}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerOpp)}
                    onClose={() => setSelectedDrawerOpp(null)}
                    onEdit={handleEdit}
                />
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerOpp)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Typography, Chip, Divider } from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import BusinessOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/BusinessOutlined';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import PhoneOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PhoneOutlined';
import EmailOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EmailOutlined';
import CalendarMonthOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CalendarMonthOutlined';
import EditOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/EditOutlined';
import RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RequestQuoteOutlined';
import CheckCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';

import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { Opportunity } from '@/types/opportunity.types';
import {
    EntityDetailDrawer,
    DrawerSectionCard,
    DrawerCopyButton,
    type AuditRevisionItem,
} from '@/components/common/Drawer';
import { AppToast } from '@/components/common/AppToast';
import { organizationService, quotationService, opportunityService, subscribeCrmSync } from '@/services';
import { OPPORTUNITY_FORM_TABS } from './OpportunityForm';

export interface OpportunityDetailDrawerProps {
    opportunity: Opportunity | null;
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onEdit?: (id: string) => void;
    onShowToast?: (message: string, severity?: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning') => void;
}

export function OpportunityDetailDrawer({
    opportunity,
    open,
    onClose,
    onEdit,
    onShowToast,
}: OpportunityDetailDrawerProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const [currentOpp, setCurrentOpp] = useState<Opportunity | null>(opportunity);
    const [, setSyncVersion] = useState(0);

    useEffect(() => {
        setCurrentOpp(opportunity);
    }, [opportunity]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open || !opportunity?.id) return;

        const refreshLinkedData = () => {
            const freshOpp = opportunityService.getOpportunityById(opportunity.id);
            if (freshOpp) {
                setCurrentOpp(freshOpp);
            }
            setSyncVersion((v) => v + 1);
        };

        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(refreshLinkedData);
        return unsubscribe;
    }, [open, opportunity?.id]);

    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'error',
    });

    if (!opportunity && !currentOpp) return null;

    const opp = currentOpp || opportunity!;

    const triggerToast = (
        message: string,
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning' = 'error'
    ) => {
        setToast({ open: true, message, severity });
        onShowToast?.(message, severity);
    };

    // Check whether the linked Organization has a complete address
    const linkedOrg = opp.organizationId
        ? organizationService.getByIdSync(opp.organizationId)
        : organizationService
              .getAllSync()
              .find(
                  (o) =>
                      o.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() ===
                      opp.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase()
              );

    const billingStreet = (linkedOrg?.billingStreet || '').trim();
    const billingCity = (linkedOrg?.billingCity || '').trim();
    const billingState = (linkedOrg?.billingState || '').trim();
    const billingPostalCode = (linkedOrg?.billingPostalCode || '').trim();

    const hasAddress = Boolean(
        billingStreet && billingCity && billingState && billingPostalCode
    );

    const existingQuote = quotationService
        .getAllSync()
        .find((q) => q.opportunityId === opp.id);
    const isQuoteCreated = Boolean(existingQuote);

    const handleCreateQuote = () => {
        if (!hasAddress) {
            triggerToast(
                'Address is required before creating a quotation. Please update the address details first.',
                'error'
            );
            return;
        }

        router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_CREATE_QUOTE(opp.id));
    };

    const handleEdit = () => {
        if (onEdit) {
            onEdit(opp.id);
        } else {
            router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITY_EDIT(opp.id));
        }
    };

    const getStageColor = (stage: string) => {
        switch (stage) {
            case 'Closed Won':
                return { bg: '#dcfce7', text: '#15803d', border: '#86efac' };
            case 'Closed Lost':
                return { bg: '#fee2e2', text: '#b91c1c', border: '#fca5a5' };
            case 'Negotiation/Review':
            case 'Proposal/Price Quote':
                return { bg: '#fef3c7', text: '#b45309', border: '#fde68a' };
            default:
                return { bg: '#eff6ff', text: '#1d4ed8', border: '#bfdbfe' };
        }
    };

    const stageColors = getStageColor(opp.salesStage);

    const auditRevisions: AuditRevisionItem[] = [
        {
            title: `Stage set to "${opp.salesStage}"`,
            author: opp.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
            time: 'Yesterday at 3:15 PM',
            tag: opp.salesStage,
            note: 'Updated proposal specifications & client sign-off timeline.',
        },
        {
            title: 'Opportunity Created',
            author: opp.createdBy || 'mittal.sharma',
            time: opp.createdAt || '3 days ago',
            tag: 'Created',
            note: `Initial deal value ₹${opp.grandTotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')} generated from lead.`,
        },
    ];

    return (
        <>
            <EntityDetailDrawer
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            title={opp.organizationName}
            subtitle={`${opp.opportunityCode} • ${opp.contactName}`}
            avatarText={opp.organizationName.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
            avatarBg="#1e3a8a"
            badges={[
                {
                    label: opp.salesStage,
                    backgroundColor: stageColors.bg,
                    color: stageColors.text,
                    borderColor: stageColors.border,
                },
                {
                    label: `₹${opp.grandTotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`,
                    backgroundColor: '#f0fdf4',
                    color: '#15803d',
                    borderColor: '#bbf7d0',
                },
                {
                    label: opp.type,
                    backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                    color: '#475569',
                    borderColor: '#cbd5e1',
                },
            ]}
            headerActions={{
                onEdit: handleEdit,
            }}
            formTabs={OPPORTUNITY_FORM_TABS}
            tabContents={{
                basic: (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
                        {/* Organization & Deal Card */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard title="CLIENT ORGANIZATION" bg="#f8fafc">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mt: 0.5 }}>
                                <BusinessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.98rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                    {opp.organizationName}
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.3 }}>
                                Deal Ref: {opp.opportunityCode} • Type: {opp.type}
                            </Typography>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        {/* Primary Contact Person Details */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard title="CONTACT PERSON DETAILS">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.2, mt: 1 }}>
                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                    <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                        {opp.contactName}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>

                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                        <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                            {opp.contactNumber}
                                        </Typography>
                                    </Box>
                                    <DrawerCopyButton text={opp.contactNumber} title="Copy Phone Number" iconColor="#94a3b8" />
                                </Box>

                                {opp.emailAddress && (
                                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                            <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#1e293b' }}>
                                                {opp.emailAddress}
                                            </Typography>
                                        </Box>
                                        <DrawerCopyButton text={opp.emailAddress} title="Copy Email" iconColor="#94a3b8" />
                                    </Box>
                                )}
                            </Box>

                                    </Typography>

                            </Box>

                label: 'Edit Opportunity',
                onClick: handleEdit,
                icon: <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
            }}
            secondaryAction={{
                label: isQuoteCreated ? 'Quote Created' : 'Create Quote',
                icon: isQuoteCreated ? (
                    <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#059669' }} />
                ) : (
                    <RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                ),
                onClick: handleCreateQuote,
                variant: 'outlined',
                tooltip: !hasAddress
                    ? 'Complete Address is required to create a quotation'
                    : isQuoteCreated
                    ? 'Quotation already created for this opportunity'
                    : 'Create Quotation from Opportunity details',
                sx: {
                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    height: 36,
                    px: 1.8,
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    color: isQuoteCreated ? '#047857' : hasAddress ? '#047857' : '#dc2626',
                    borderColor: isQuoteCreated ? '#a7f3d0' : hasAddress ? '#a7f3d0' : '#fca5a5',
                    backgroundColor: isQuoteCreated ? '#ecfdf5' : hasAddress ? '#ecfdf5' : '#fef2f2',
                    '&:hover': {
                        borderColor: isQuoteCreated ? '#047857' : hasAddress ? '#059669' : '#ef4444',
                        backgroundColor: isQuoteCreated ? '#d1fae5' : hasAddress ? '#d1fae5' : '#fee2e2',
                    },
                },
            }}
            width={{ xs: '100vw', sm: 600, md: 660 }}
        />
        <AppToast
            open={toast.open}
            message={toast.message}
            severity={toast.severity}
            onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
        />
    </>
    );
}
