'use client';

import React, { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider } from 'react-hook-form';

// Icons
import ArticleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArticleOutlined';
import ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ReceiptLongOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { CommonFormLayout } from '../common/CommonFormLayout';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { useRhfForm } from '../forms/rhf';
import { ROUTES } from '../../config/constants';
import { opportunityFormSchema } from '../../validations';
import type { OpportunityFormData } from '../../types/opportunity.types';
import { opportunityService } from '../../services/opportunity.service';

// Modular Opportunity Form Sections
import {
    OpportunityBasicSection,
    OpportunityLineItemsSection,
} from './sections';

export type OpportunityTabKey = 'basic' | 'line_items';

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Opportunity Form Tabs ─────────────────────────
export const OPPORTUNITY_FORM_TABS: (FormTabDefinition & { id: OpportunityTabKey })[] = [
    {
        id: 'basic',
        label: 'BASIC',
        icon: <ArticleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'line_items',
        label: 'Line Items',
        icon: <ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
];

export interface OpportunityFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit';
    initialData?: Partial<OpportunityFormData>;
    opportunityId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

const DEFAULT_OPPORTUNITY_FORM: OpportunityFormData = {
    productCategory: ['Biz Analyst'],
    contactName: '',
    organizationName: '',
    contactNumber: '',
    emailAddress: '',
    referredBy: '',
    type: 'New Business',
    salesStage: 'Qualification',
    leadSource: 'Website Enquiry',
    leadGivenBy: 'Direct Inbound Marketing',
    nextFollowupDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    nextFollowupTime: '11:00 AM',
    followupType: 'Call',
    addDescription: '',
    description: '',
    assignedTo: 'mittal.sharma',

    // Billing Details
    tallySerialNo: '',
    invoiceNo: '',
    invoiceDate: '',

    // Commission Details
    commission: 'Standard (10%)',

    // Document
    addDocument: 'No',

    // Line Items
    currency: 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
    groupName: 'Products & Services',
    lineItems: [
        {
            id: 'line-1',
            productId: 'prod-tally',
            productName: 'TallyPrime Silver (Single User)',
            quantity: 1,
            amount: 22500,
            discount: 0,
            discountType: 'percentage',
            salePrice: 22500,
            taxRate: 'GST 18%',
            taxAmount: 4050,
            total: 26550,
            description: 'Standard single-user perpetual license for accounting & compliance',
            note: '',
        },
    ],
    lumpSumDiscount: 0,
    totalAmount: 22500,
    totalDiscount: 0,
    subtotal: 22500,
    totalTax: 4050,
    grandTotal: 26550,
};

export default function OpportunityForm({
    mode = 'create',
    initialData,
    opportunityId,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: OpportunityFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<OpportunityTabKey>('basic');

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } =
        useRhfForm<OpportunityFormData>({
            schema: opportunityFormSchema,
            defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_OPPORTUNITY_FORM, ...initialData },
        });

    const { reset, watch, setValue, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;
    const orgName = watch('organizationName');

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Sales' },
        { label: 'Opportunities', href: ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES },
        {
            label:
                mode === 'edit'
                    ? orgName
                        ? `Edit: ${orgName}`
                        : 'Edit Opportunity'
                    : 'Create Opportunity',
        },
    ];

    // Populate data when editing
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!opportunityId) return;
        let active = true;
        opportunityService
            .getById(opportunityId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) {
                    reset(found);
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [opportunityId, reset]);

    const setField = useCallback(
        <K extends keyof OpportunityFormData>(key: K, value: OpportunityFormData[K]) => {
            setValue(key, value as never, {
                shouldDirty: true,
                shouldValidate: true,
            });
        },
        [setValue]
    );

    // ── Submit Logic with Validation ──────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleSave = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            if (mode === 'create') {
                await opportunityService.createOpportunity(values);
                showToast('Opportunity created successfully! Added to your sales pipeline.', 'success');
            } else if (mode === 'edit' && opportunityId) {
                await opportunityService.updateOpportunity(opportunityId, values);
                showToast('Opportunity details updated successfully!', 'success');
            }

            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => {
                router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES);
            }, 800);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(
                err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'An error occurred while saving the opportunity.',
                'error'
            );
        }
    });

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (
            isDirty &&
            !confirm('You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?')
        ) {
            return;
        }
        router.push(ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES);
    };

    const formValues = watch();

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={OPPORTUNITY_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onTabChange={(tabId) => setActiveTab(tabId as OpportunityTabKey)}
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Opportunity' : 'Save Opportunity'}
                cancelLabel="Cancel"
                disableContentPadding
                toast={
                    <AppToast
                        open={toast.open}
                        message={toast.message}
                        severity={toast.severity}
                        onClose={closeToast}
                    />
                }
            >
                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'basic'}>
                    <OpportunityBasicSection form={formValues} setField={setField} />
                </div>

                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'line_items'}>
                    <OpportunityLineItemsSection />
                </div>
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

import {
    FormField,
    LookupField,

    fieldSx,
} from '@/components/forms';
import type { OpportunityFormData } from '../../../types/opportunity.types';

export interface OpportunityBasicSectionProps {
    form: OpportunityFormData;
    setField: <K extends keyof OpportunityFormData>(key: K, value: OpportunityFormData[K]) => void;
}

export function OpportunityBasicSection({ form, setField }: OpportunityBasicSectionProps) {
    // ── Product Category Toggle Handler ─────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleToggleProduct = (product: string) => {
        const current = form.productCategory || [];
        const exists = current.includes(product);
        if (exists) {
            setField(
                'productCategory',
                current.filter((p) => p !== product)
            );
        } else {
            setField('productCategory', [...current, product]);
        }
    };

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>
            {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            {/* PRIMARY OPPORTUNITY DETAILS (2 COLUMNS)                              */}
            {/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
            <SectionLabel
                icon={<ArticleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                label="Primary Opportunity Details"
                sx={{ mb: 2.5 }}
            />
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'grid',
                    gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' },
                    gap: { xs: 2.5, md: 4 },
                    mb: 4,
                }}
            >
                {/* ════════════ LEFT COLUMN ════════════ */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
                    {/* Product Category:* (Multi-select) */}
                    <FormField
                        label="Product Category"
                        required
                        hint={`${(form.productCategory || []).length} category selected`}
                    >
                        <Box
                            sx={{
                                border: '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                                borderRadius: '8px',
                                p: 1.5,
                                backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                                minHeight: 92,
                                display: 'flex',
                                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                                gap: 0.8,
                                transition: 'border-color 0.15s ease',
                                '&:hover': { borderColor: '#2563eb' },
                            }}
                        >
                            {PRODUCT_CATEGORIES.map((prod) => {
                                const selected = (form.productCategory || []).includes(prod);
                                return (
                                    <Chip
                                        key={prod}
                                        label={prod}
                                        onClick={() => handleToggleProduct(prod)}
                                        icon={
                                            selected ? (
                                                <CheckIcon sx={{ fontSize: '14px !important', color: '#166534 !important' }} />
                                            ) : undefined
                                        }
                                        sx={{
                                            fontSize: '0.78rem',
                                            fontWeight: selected ? 700 : 500,
                                            height: 28,
                                            cursor: 'pointer',
                                            backgroundColor: selected ? '#dcfce7' : '#f8fafc',
                                            color: selected ? '#15803d' : '#475569',
                                            border: selected ? '1.5px solid #86efac' : '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                                            transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                                            '&:hover': {
                                                backgroundColor: selected ? '#bbf7d0' : '#e2e8f0',
                                            },
                                        }}
                                    />
                                );
                            })}
                        </Box>
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Contact:* */}
                    <FormField label="Contact" required hint="Primary decision maker or technical sponsor">
                        <LookupField
                            value={form.contactName}
                            onChange={(val) => setField('contactName', val)}
                            placeholder="Type or select contact..."
                            options={[
                                'Vikram Singhania',
                                'Neha Mehta',
                                'Rohit Bansal',
                                'Priya Nair',
                                'Sunil Aggarwal',
                                'Rajesh Gupta',
                                'Amit Patel',
                                'Pooja Verma',
                            ]}
                            required
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Contact Number:* */}
                    <FormField label="Contact Number" required hint="Mobile / direct work phone">
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            type="tel"
                            placeholder="+91 98000 00000"
                            value={form.contactNumber}
                            onChange={(e) => setField('contactNumber', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Referred By */}
                    <FormField label="Referred By" hint="Referring partner, agent, or client">
                        <LookupField
                            value={form.referredBy || ''}
                            onChange={(val) => setField('referredBy', val)}
                            placeholder="Referred by partner or person..."
                            options={[
                                'Shree Associates',
                                'Apex Tally Partners',
                                'Chartered Financials Ltd',
                                'Global Tech Network',
                                'Direct Partner Network',
                            ]}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Type:* */}
                    <FormField label="Type" required hint="Nature of deal">
                        <StyledSelect
                            value={form.type}
                            onChange={(v) => setField('type', v)}
                            options={OPPORTUNITY_TYPES}

                    </FormField>

                    {/* Lead Source:* */}

File: src/components/organizations/OrganizationForm.tsx

'use client';

import { useState, useCallback, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider, useForm, type Path } from 'react-hook-form';
// Icons
import ArticleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ArticleOutlined';
import PlaceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PlaceOutlined';
import AccountBalanceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountBalanceOutlined';
import WorkspacePremiumOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WorkspacePremiumOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import { CommonFormLayout } from '../common/CommonFormLayout';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { organizationService } from '@/services';
import { ROUTES } from '../../config/constants';
import { validateWithToast, organizationFormSchema } from '../../validations';
import type {
    OrganizationFormData,
    CorporateEmail,
} from '../../types/organization.types';

// Tab components
import {
    OverviewTab,
    AddressTab,
    TaxBankTab,
    PartnerLicensingTab,
} from './tabs';

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Organization Form Tabs ──────────────────────────
export const ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS: (FormTabDefinition & { id: TabKey })[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <ArticleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'address',
        label: 'Address Information',
        icon: <PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'tax_bank',
        label: 'Tax & Bank Details',
        icon: <AccountBalanceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
        hasDot: true,
    },
    {
        id: 'partner_licensing',
        label: 'Partner Company',
        icon: <WorkspacePremiumOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
];

// ─── Default Form State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const DEFAULT_FORM: OrganizationFormData = {
    organizationName: '',
    mailingName: '',
    natureOfBusiness: '',
    accountStatus: 'Active',
    typeOfEntity: '',
    customerType: '',
    sapCodeTallyId: '',
    showroomBranchCode: '',
    sourceOfLead: '',
    memberOfParentCorp: '',
    numberOfEmployees: '',
    annualTurnover: '',
    description: '',
    accountVerified: false,
    provideSupport: 'Yes',
    corporateEmails: [],

    // Billing Address
    billingAddress: '',
    billingStreet: '',
    billingCity: '',
    billingState: '',
    billingPostalCode: '',
    billingCountry: 'India',
    billingLatitude: '0.00000000',

    // Shipping Address
    shippingAddress: '',
    shippingStreet: '',
    shippingCity: '',
    shippingState: '',
    shippingPostalCode: '',
    shippingCountry: 'India',
    shippingLongitude: '0.00000000',
    copyAddressFromBilling: false,

    // Tax & Bank Details
    registrationType: 'Registered',
    panNumber: '',
    msmeRegnNumber: '',
    accountName: '',
    bankName: '',
    bankIfscCode: '',
    gstNo: '',
    gstNumber: '',
    cinNo: '',
    tanNumber: '',
    accountNumber: '',
    typeOfAccount: '',
    bankAddress: '',

    // Partner Company
    partnerCompanies: [],
};

type TabKey = 'overview' | 'address' | 'tax_bank' | 'partner_licensing';

// ─── Component Props ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface OrganizationFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit';
    initialData?: Partial<OrganizationFormData>;
    organizationId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

export default function OrganizationForm({
    mode = 'create',
    initialData,
    organizationId,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: OrganizationFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const [form, setForm] = useState<OrganizationFormData>({ ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData });
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabKey>('overview');
    const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
    const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState(false);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: 'success' | 'error' }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const methods = useForm<OrganizationFormData>({
        defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData },
        mode: 'onTouched',
    });

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Sales' },
        { label: 'Organizations', href: ROUTES.ORGANIZATIONS },
        { label: mode === 'edit' ? (form.organizationName ? `Edit: ${form.organizationName}` : 'Edit Organization') : 'Create & Edit View' },
    ];

    // Populate data when editing
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!organizationId) return;
        let active = true;
        organizationService
            .getById(organizationId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) {
                    const normalized: OrganizationFormData = {
                        ...found,
                        accountStatus: found.accountStatus === 'Inactive' ? 'Inactive' : 'Active',
                        billingAddress: found.billingAddress || found.billingStreet || '',
                        shippingAddress: found.shippingAddress || found.shippingStreet || '',
                        gstNo: found.gstNo || found.gstNumber || '',
                    };
                    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...normalized }));
                    methods.reset(normalized);
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [organizationId, methods]);

    // ── Field updaters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const set = useCallback(
        <K extends keyof OrganizationFormData>(key: K, value: OrganizationFormData[K]) => {
            setForm((prev) => {
                const next = { ...prev, [key]: value };
                if (next.copyAddressFromBilling) {
                    if (key === 'billingStreet' || key === 'billingAddress') {
                        next.shippingStreet = value as string;
                        next.shippingAddress = value as string;
                    }
                    if (key === 'billingCity') next.shippingCity = value as string;
                    if (key === 'billingState') next.shippingState = value as string;
                    if (key === 'billingPostalCode') next.shippingPostalCode = value as string;
                    if (key === 'billingCountry') next.shippingCountry = value as string;
                }
                return next;
            });
            methods.setValue(key as Path<OrganizationFormData>, value as never, {
                shouldDirty: true,
                shouldValidate: true,
            });
            setIsDirty(true);
        },
        [methods]
    );

    const handleCopyAddressToggle = (checked: boolean) => {
        const billingAddr = form.billingAddress || form.billingStreet || '';
        setForm((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            copyAddressFromBilling: checked,
            ...(checked
                ? {
                      shippingStreet: billingAddr,
                      shippingAddress: billingAddr,
                      shippingCity: prev.billingCity || '',
                      shippingState: prev.billingState || '',
                      shippingPostalCode: prev.billingPostalCode || '',
                      shippingCountry: prev.billingCountry || 'India',
                  }
                : {}),
        }));
        methods.setValue('copyAddressFromBilling', checked, { shouldDirty: true });
        if (checked) {
            methods.setValue('shippingAddress', billingAddr, { shouldDirty: true });
            methods.setValue('shippingStreet', billingAddr, { shouldDirty: true });
            methods.setValue('shippingCity', form.billingCity || '', { shouldDirty: true });
            methods.setValue('shippingState', form.billingState || '', { shouldDirty: true });
            methods.setValue('shippingPostalCode', form.billingPostalCode || '', { shouldDirty: true });
            methods.setValue('shippingCountry', form.billingCountry || 'India', { shouldDirty: true });
        }
        setIsDirty(true);
    };

    // ── Email management ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const addEmail = () => {
        const newEmail: CorporateEmail = {
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),
            email: '',
            isPrimary: form.corporateEmails.length === 0,
            isOptedOut: false,
            isInvalidBounce: false,
        };
        const updated = [...form.corporateEmails, newEmail];
        set('corporateEmails', updated);
    };

    const updateEmail = (id: string, updated: CorporateEmail) => {
        const next = form.corporateEmails.map((e) => (e.id === id ? updated : e));
        set('corporateEmails', next);
    };

    const removeEmail = (id: string) => {
        const next = form.corporateEmails.filter((e) => e.id !== id);
        set('corporateEmails', next);
    };

    // ── Calculation of completion progress ────────────────────────────────────
    const progressCount = useMemo(() => {
        let count = 0;
        if (form.organizationName.trim()) count++;
        if (form.natureOfBusiness) count++;
        if (form.accountStatus) count++;
        if (form.typeOfEntity) count++;
        if (form.customerType) count++;
        if (form.sapCodeTallyId.trim()) count++;
        if (form.sourceOfLead) count++;
        if (form.corporateEmails.length > 0) count++;
        if (form.annualTurnover) count++;
        if (form.description.trim()) count++;
        return Math.min(count, 10);
    }, [form]);

    // ── Submit logic with Zod Validation ──────────────────────────────────────
    const handleSubmit = async (redirectAfter: boolean) => {
        const currentData = { ...form, ...methods.getValues() };
        if (!currentData.billingAddress && currentData.billingStreet) {
            currentData.billingAddress = currentData.billingStreet;
        }
        if (!currentData.billingStreet && currentData.billingAddress) {
            currentData.billingStreet = currentData.billingAddress;
        }
        if (!currentData.shippingAddress && currentData.shippingStreet) {
            currentData.shippingAddress = currentData.shippingStreet;
        }
        if (!currentData.shippingStreet && currentData.shippingAddress) {
            currentData.shippingStreet = currentData.shippingAddress;
        }
        if (!currentData.gstNo && currentData.gstNumber) {
            currentData.gstNo = currentData.gstNumber;
        }
        if (!currentData.gstNumber && currentData.gstNo) {
            currentData.gstNumber = currentData.gstNo;
        }

        const validation = validateWithToast(organizationFormSchema, currentData);
        if (!validation.success) {
            setToast({ open: true, message: validation.error, severity: 'error' });
            return;
        }
        setSubmitting(true);
        try {
            if (mode === 'create') {
                await organizationService.create(currentData as OrganizationFormData);
                setToast({ open: true, message: 'Organization created successfully!', severity: 'success' });
                if (redirectAfter) {
                    setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATIONS), 800);
                } else {
                    setForm(DEFAULT_FORM);
                    methods.reset(DEFAULT_FORM);
                    setIsDirty(false);
                }
            } else if (mode === 'edit' && organizationId) {
                await organizationService.update(organizationId, currentData as OrganizationFormData);
                setToast({ open: true, message: 'Organization updated successfully!', severity: 'success' });
                setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATIONS), 800);
            }
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
            setToast({ open: true, message, severity: 'error' });
        } finally {
            setSubmitting(false);
        }
    };

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (isDirty && !confirm('You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?')) return;
        router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATIONS);
    };

    // ─── Tabs Configuration (derived from ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS) ───────────────
    const tabs = useMemo(() => [
        {
            ...ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS[0],
            badge: `${progressCount}/10 done`,
        },
        {
            ...ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS[1],
            sublabel: form.billingCity || form.shippingCity ? '(Configured)' : '(3 Locs)',
        },
        ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS[2],
        ORGANIZATION_FORM_TABS[3],
    ], [progressCount, form.billingCity, form.shippingCity]);

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={tabs}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onTabChange={(tabId) => setActiveTab(tabId as TabKey)}
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={() => handleSubmit(true)}
                submitting={submitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Organization' : 'Save Organization'}
                cancelLabel="Cancel"
                disableContentPadding
                toast={
                    <AppToast
                        open={toast.open}
                        message={toast.message}
                        severity={toast.severity}
                        onClose={() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false }))}
                    />
                }
            >
                {/* ── Tab Content Panels ────────────────────────────────────── */}
                {activeTab === 'overview' && (
                    <OverviewTab
                        form={form}
                        set={set}
                        addEmail={addEmail}
                        updateEmail={updateEmail}
                        removeEmail={removeEmail}
                    />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'address' && (
                    <AddressTab
                        form={form}
                        set={set}
                        handleCopyAddressToggle={handleCopyAddressToggle}
                    />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'tax_bank' && (
                    <TaxBankTab
                        form={form}
                        set={set}
                    />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'partner_licensing' && (
                    <PartnerLicensingTab
                        form={form}
                        set={set}
                    />
                )}
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

File: src/components/organizations/OrganizationsMasterView.tsx

'use client';

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
    Box,
    Button,
    Typography,
} from '@mui/material';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import FilterListIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FilterList';
import ViewColumnIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ViewColumn';
import FileDownloadOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FileDownloadOutlined';
import HistoryIcon from '@mui/icons-material/History';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';

import { ROUTES } from '../../config/constants';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../common/CommonMasterView';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../common/DataTable';
import { organizationService, subscribeCrmSync } from '@/services';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '@/types/organization.types';
import { OrganizationDetailDrawer } from './OrganizationDetailDrawer';
import type { FilterTab, SortField } from './master';

const getNatureBadgeStyle = (nature: string = '') => {
    const n = nature.toLowerCase();
    if (n.includes('education')) return { backgroundColor: '#f3e8ff', color: '#7e22ce', border: '1px solid #d8b4fe' };
    if (n.includes('construction')) return { backgroundColor: '#fff7ed', color: '#c2410c', border: '1px solid #fed7aa' };
    if (n.includes('distributor') || n.includes('trading') || n.includes('wholesale')) return { backgroundColor: '#eff6ff', color: '#1d4ed8', border: '1px solid #bfdbfe' };
    if (n.includes('transportation') || n.includes('logistics')) return { backgroundColor: '#ecfeff', color: '#0e7490', border: '1px solid #a5f3fc' };
    if (n.includes('consulting')) return { backgroundColor: '#eef2ff', color: '#4338ca', border: '1px solid #c7d2fe' };
    if (n.includes('it') || n.includes('software')) return { backgroundColor: '#f0f9ff', color: '#0284c7', border: '1px solid #bae6fd' };
    if (n.includes('manufacturing')) return { backgroundColor: '#ecfdf5', color: '#047857', border: '1px solid #a7f3d0' };
    if (n.includes('healthcare')) return { backgroundColor: '#fff1f2', color: '#be123c', border: '1px solid #fecdd3' };
    if (n.includes('retail')) return { backgroundColor: '#fefce8', color: '#a16207', border: '1px solid #fef08a' };
    return { backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', color: '#475569', border: '1px solid #cbd5e1' };
};

const formatNatureLabel = (nature: string = '') => {
    if (nature.includes('Distributor / Wholesale Trading')) return 'Distributor/Trading';
    return nature;
};

export function OrganizationsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();

    // ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const [organizations, setOrganizations] = useState<ExtendedOrganization[]>([]);
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(['org-004']));
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<FilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState<number>(25);
    const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<number>(1);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<SortField>('organizationName');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');

    // Detail View Side Drawer
    const [selectedDrawerOrg, setSelectedDrawerOrg] = useState<ExtendedOrganization | null>(null);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: 'success' | 'info' | 'error' }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const loadOrganizations = useCallback(() => {
        const data = organizationService.getAllSync();
        setOrganizations(data);
        setSelectedDrawerOrg((prev) => {
            if (!prev) return null;
            return data.find((o) => o.id === prev.id) || null;
        });
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        organizationService
            .getAll()
            .then((data) => {
                if (active) {
                    setOrganizations(data);
                    setSelectedDrawerOrg((prev) => {
                        if (!prev) return null;
                        return data.find((o) => o.id === prev.id) || null;
                    });
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleFocus = () => {
            loadOrganizations();
        };
        const handleVisibility = () => {
            if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                loadOrganizations();
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(loadOrganizations);

        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
            document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
            unsubscribe();
        };
    }, [loadOrganizations]);

    // ── Filter & Search Logic ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredOrganizations = useMemo(() => {
        return organizations.filter((org) => {
            if (activeTab === 'recent' && !org.isRecentlyViewed) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'my' && !org.isMyAccount) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'distributor' && !org.natureOfBusiness?.toLowerCase().includes('distributor')) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'enduser' && org.customerType !== 'End User') return false;

            if (searchQuery.trim()) {
                const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
                return (
                    org.organizationName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.natureOfBusiness?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.customerType?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.billingCity?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.billingState?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.billingStreet?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    org.gstNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
                );
            }
            return true;
        });
    }, [organizations, activeTab, searchQuery]);

    // ── Sort Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const sortedOrganizations = useMemo(() => {
        return [...filteredOrganizations].sort((a, b) => {
            const valA = ((a as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            const valB = ((b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
            if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
            return 0;
        });
    }, [filteredOrganizations, sortField, sortOrder]);

    // ── Pagination Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const totalRecords = sortedOrganizations.length;
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalRecords / rowsPerPage));
    const paginatedOrganizations = useMemo(() => {
        const start = (currentPage - 1) * rowsPerPage;
        return sortedOrganizations.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [sortedOrganizations, currentPage, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleSort = (field: SortField) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    // ── Selection Logic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const isAllPageSelected = paginatedOrganizations.length > 0 && paginatedOrganizations.every((o) => selectedIds.has(o.id));
    const isSomePageSelected = paginatedOrganizations.some((o) => selectedIds.has(o.id)) && !isAllPageSelected;

    const toggleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        const next = new Set(selectedIds);
        if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
        else next.add(id);
        setSelectedIds(next);
    };

    const toggleSelectAll = () => {
        const next = new Set(selectedIds);
        if (isAllPageSelected) {
            paginatedOrganizations.forEach((o) => next.delete(o.id));
        } else {
            paginatedOrganizations.forEach((o) => next.add(o.id));
        }
        setSelectedIds(next);
    };

    // ── Export CSV ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleExport = (onlySelected = false) => {
        const recordsToExport = onlySelected
            ? organizations.filter((o) => selectedIds.has(o.id))
            : filteredOrganizations;

        if (recordsToExport.length === 0) {
            setToast({ open: true, message: 'No organizations to export.', severity: 'info' });
            return;
        }

        const headers = ['Account Code', 'Organization Name', 'Nature of Business', 'Customer Type', 'Status', 'Billing Street', 'City', 'State', 'GST Number'];
        const rows = recordsToExport.map((o) => [
            o.accountCode,
            `"${o.organizationName.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
            `"${o.natureOfBusiness || ''}"`,
            `"${o.customerType || ''}"`,
            `"${o.accountStatus || ''}"`,
            `"${(o.billingStreet || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
            `"${o.billingCity || ''}"`,
            `"${o.billingState || ''}"`,
            `"${o.gstNumber || ''}"`,
        ]);

        const csvContent = 'data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map((r) => r.join(','))].join('\n');
        const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.setAttribute('href', encodedUri);
        link.setAttribute('download', `organizations_export_${Date.now()}.csv`);
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        document.body.removeChild(link);

        setToast({ open: true, message: `Exported ${recordsToExport.length} organizations to CSV.`, severity: 'success' });
    };

    // ── Bulk Actions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const handleBulkAction = async (action: 'active' | 'inactive' | 'delete' | 'export') => {
        if (selectedIds.size === 0) {
            setToast({ open: true, message: 'Please select records to perform bulk action.', severity: 'info' });
            return;
        }

        if (action === 'delete') {
            const count = selectedIds.size;
            await organizationService.deleteBulk(Array.from(selectedIds));
            setOrganizations(organizationService.getAllSync());
            setSelectedIds(new Set());
            setToast({ open: true, message: `${count} organizations deleted.`, severity: 'success' });
        } else if (action === 'active' || action === 'inactive') {
            const status = action === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Inactive';
            const nextOrgs = organizationService.updateStatusBulk(selectedIds, status);
            setOrganizations(nextOrgs);
            setToast({ open: true, message: `${selectedIds.size} organizations updated to ${status}.`, severity: 'success' });
        } else if (action === 'export') {
            handleExport(true);
        }
    };

    // ── Filter Pills Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<FilterTab>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Organizations',
                count: 11417,
            },
            {
                id: 'recent',
                label: 'Recently Viewed',
                icon: <HistoryIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: '#94a3b8' }} />,
                count: 24,
            },
            {
                id: 'my',
                label: 'My Accounts',
                icon: <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#94a3b8' }} />,
            },
            {
                id: 'distributor',
                label: 'Distributor/Trading',
                dotColor: '#2563eb',
            },
            {
                id: 'enduser',
                label: 'End User',
                dotColor: '#10b981',
            },
        ],
        []
    );

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<ExtendedOrganization>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'organizationName',
                label: 'ORGANIZATION NAME',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 240,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.2 }}>
                        <Box
                            sx={{
                                width: 28,
                                height: 28,
                                borderRadius: '6px',
                                backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                display: 'flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                justifyContent: 'center',
                                color: '#2563eb',
                                flexShrink: 0,
                            }}
                        >
                            <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />
                        </Box>
                        <Box>
                            <Typography
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    setSelectedDrawerOrg(org);
                                }}
                                sx={{
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    lineHeight: 1.3,
                                    '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                                }}
                            >
                                {org.organizationName}
                            </Typography>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1, mt: 0.2 }}>
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: '#94a3b8', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                                    {org.accountCode}
                                </Typography>
                                {org.accountVerified && (
                                    <Box
                                        component="span"
                                        sx={{
                                            fontSize: '0.62rem',
                                            fontWeight: 700,
                                            color: '#059669',
                                            backgroundColor: '#ecfdf5',
                                            px: 0.6,
                                            py: 0.1,
                                            borderRadius: '4px',
                                            border: '1px solid #a7f3d0',
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        Verified
                                    </Box>
                                )}
                            </Box>
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'natureOfBusiness',
                label: 'NATURE OF BUSINESS',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (org) => {
                    const badge = getNatureBadgeStyle(org.natureOfBusiness);
                    return (
                        <Box
                            component="span"
                            sx={{
                                display: 'inline-block',
                                px: 1,
                                py: 0.3,
                                borderRadius: '6px',
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                ...badge,
                            }}
                        >
                            {formatNatureLabel(org.natureOfBusiness)}
                        </Box>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'customerType',
                label: 'CUSTOMER TYPE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 130,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Box
                        component="span"
                        sx={{
                            display: 'inline-block',
                            px: 1,
                            py: 0.25,
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            fontSize: '0.72rem',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                            color: '#334155',
                            border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                        }}
                    >
                        {org.customerType}
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'accountStatus',
                label: 'STATUS',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 110,
                render: (org) => {
                    const isActive = org.accountStatus === 'Active';
                    return (
                        <Box
                            component="span"
                            sx={{
                                display: 'inline-flex',
                                alignItems: 'center',
                                gap: 0.6,
                                px: 0.9,
                                py: 0.25,
                                borderRadius: '12px',
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                backgroundColor: isActive ? '#ecfdf5' : '#fef3c7',
                                color: isActive ? '#059669' : '#d97706',
                                border: isActive ? '1px solid #a7f3d0' : '1px solid #fde68a',
                            }}
                        >
                            <Box
                                component="span"
                                sx={{
                                    width: 6,
                                    height: 6,
                                    borderRadius: '50%',
                                    backgroundColor: isActive ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b',
                                }}
                            />
                            {org.accountStatus}
                        </Box>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'billingStreet',
                label: 'BILLING STREET',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Typography noWrap sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569', maxWidth: 200 }}>
                        {org.billingStreet || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'billingCity',
                label: 'BILLING CITY',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 120,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                        {org.billingCity || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'billingState',
                label: 'BILLING STATE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 120,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                        {org.billingState || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'annualTurnover',
                label: 'ANNUAL TURNOVER',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 130,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#334155' }}>
                        {org.annualTurnover || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'assignedUser',
                label: 'ASSIGNED USER',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (org) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {org.assignedUser || 'mittal.sharma'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
        ],
        []
    );

    const headerActions = (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.2 }}>
            <Button
                variant="outlined"
                size="small"
                startIcon={<FilterListIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                onClick={() => setToast({ open: true, message: 'Custom filters active.', severity: 'info' })}
                sx={{
                    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                    color: '#334155',
                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontSize: '0.8rem',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    height: 36,
                    px: 1.8,
                    '&:hover': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                }}
            >
                Filter / Views
            </Button>

            <Button
                variant="outlined"
                size="small"
                startIcon={<ViewColumnIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                onClick={() => setToast({ open: true, message: 'Column Manager: All 7 standard columns visible.', severity: 'info' })}
                sx={{
                    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                    color: '#334155',
                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontSize: '0.8rem',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    height: 36,
                    px: 1.8,
                    '&:hover': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                }}
            >
                Column Manager
            </Button>

            <Button
                variant="outlined"
                size="small"
                startIcon={<FileDownloadOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                onClick={() => handleExport(false)}
                sx={{
                    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                    color: '#334155',
                    backgroundColor: '#fff',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    fontSize: '0.8rem',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    height: 36,
                    px: 1.8,
                    '&:hover': { borderColor: '#cbd5e1', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc' },
                }}
            >
                Export
            </Button>

            <Button
                variant="contained"
                size="small"
                startIcon={<AddIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />}
                onClick={() => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_NEW)}
                sx={{
                    background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 100%)',
                    color: '#fff',
                    textTransform: 'none',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    height: 36,
                    px: 2,
                    boxShadow: 'none',
                    '&:hover': { background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1e40af 0%, #1d4ed8 100%)' },
                }}
            >
                New Organization
            </Button>
        </Box>
    );

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<ExtendedOrganization, FilterTab>
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                },
                variant: 'pill',
            }}
            headerActions={headerActions}
            searchConfig={{
                variant: 'extended',
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search within table...',
                isAllPageSelected,
                isSomePageSelected,
                onToggleSelectAll: toggleSelectAll,
                onSelectAllMatching: () => setSelectedIds(new Set(organizations.map((o) => o.id))),
                onSelectVisible: () => {
                    const next = new Set(selectedIds);
                    paginatedOrganizations.forEach((o) => next.add(o.id));
                    setSelectedIds(next);
                },
                onDeselectAll: () => setSelectedIds(new Set()),
                totalRecords,
                displayTotalRecords: '11,417',
                currentPage,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalPages,
                onPageChange: setCurrentPage,
                bulkActionItems: [
                    { id: 'active', label: 'Mark as Active', onClick: () => handleBulkAction('active') },
                    { id: 'inactive', label: 'Mark as Inactive', onClick: () => handleBulkAction('inactive') },
                    { id: 'export', label: 'Export Selected to CSV', onClick: () => handleBulkAction('export') },
                    { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete Selected', color: 'error', onClick: () => handleBulkAction('delete') },
                ],
                onFilterClick: () => setToast({ open: true, message: 'Filter panel toggled.', severity: 'info' }),
                onColumnClick: () => setToast({ open: true, message: 'Layout columns toggled.', severity: 'info' }),
            }}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedOrganizations}
            keyExtractor={(org) => org.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={toggleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={toggleSelectAll}
            isAllSelected={isAllPageSelected}
            isIndeterminate={isSomePageSelected}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={(field) => handleSort(field as SortField)}
            onView={(org) => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_DETAIL(org.id))}
            onEdit={(org) => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_EDIT(org.id))}
            onRowClick={(org) => setSelectedDrawerOrg(org)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerOrg?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Details"
            editTooltip="Edit Organization"
            emptyTitle="No organizations found"
            emptyDescription="No organizations match your current search and filter criteria."
            emptyActionLabel="Create Organization"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_NEW)}
            pagination={{
                variant: 'full',
                page: currentPage - 1,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: totalRecords,
                displayTotalCount: '11,417',
                entityLabel: 'Organizations',
                pageSizeOptions: [10, 25, 50, 100],
                onPageChange: (pageZeroBased) => setCurrentPage(pageZeroBased + 1),
                onRowsPerPageChange: (rows) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(rows);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                },
            }}
            drawer={
                <OrganizationDetailDrawer
                    organization={selectedDrawerOrg}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerOrg)}
                    onClose={() => setSelectedDrawerOrg(null)}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.ORGANIZATION_EDIT(id))}
                />
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerOrg)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
    Drawer,
    Box,
    Typography,
    IconButton,
    TextField,
    Button,
    Grid,
    CircularProgress,
    Alert,
} from '@mui/material';
import CloseIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Close';
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import InfoOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/InfoOutlined';
import CheckCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';

import { StyledSelect, fieldSx } from '@/components/forms';
import { INDIAN_STATES } from '@/config/constants';
import { NATURE_OF_BUSINESS, CUSTOMER_TYPES } from './constants';
import type { ExtendedOrganization } from '@/types/organization.types';

export interface QuickCreateDrawerProps {
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onSave: (newOrg: ExtendedOrganization, addAnother?: boolean) => void;
}

const DEFAULT_QUICK_FORM = {
    organizationName: '',
    natureOfBusiness: 'Distributor / Wholesale Trading',
    customerType: 'End User',
    gstNumber: '',
    billingStreet: '',
    billingCity: '',
    billingState: 'Delhi',
    assignedUser: 'mittal.sharma (You)',
    accountStatus: 'Active',
};

export function QuickCreateDrawer({ open, onClose, onSave }: QuickCreateDrawerProps) {
    const [formData, setFormData] = useState(DEFAULT_QUICK_FORM);
    const [verifyingGst, setVerifyingGst] = useState(false);
    const [gstVerified, setGstVerified] = useState(false);
    const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState('');

    const handleChange = (field: string, value: string) => {
        setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
        if (field === 'gstNumber') {
            setGstVerified(false);
        }
        if (errorMsg) setErrorMsg('');
    };

    const handleVerifyGst = () => {
        if (!formData.gstNumber) {
            setErrorMsg('Please enter a GST number to verify.');
            return;
        }
        setVerifyingGst(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
            setVerifyingGst(false);
            setGstVerified(true);
        }, 600);
    };

    const handleSave = (addAnother = false) => {
        if (!formData.organizationName.trim()) {
            setErrorMsg('Organization Name is required.');
            return;
        }

        const newOrg: ExtendedOrganization = {
            id: `org-${Date.now()}`,
            accountCode: `ORG-${Math.floor(10000 + Math.random() * 90000)}`,
            organizationName: formData.organizationName.trim(),
            mailingName: formData.organizationName.trim(),
            natureOfBusiness: formData.natureOfBusiness as ExtendedOrganization['natureOfBusiness'],
            customerType: formData.customerType as ExtendedOrganization['customerType'],
            accountStatus: formData.accountStatus as ExtendedOrganization['accountStatus'],
            typeOfEntity: 'Private Limited Company (Pvt. Ltd.)',
            sapCodeTallyId: `TALLY-${formData.organizationName.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase()}-${Math.floor(10 + Math.random() * 90)}`,
            showroomBranchCode: 'DEL-HQ',
            sourceOfLead: 'Direct Customer',
            memberOfParentCorp: '',
            numberOfEmployees: '11 – 50 Staff Members',
            annualTurnover: '₹5 Cr – ₹25 Cr',
            description: 'Quick created enterprise account.',
            accountVerified: true,
            provideSupport: 'Yes',
            corporateEmails: [],
            billingStreet: formData.billingStreet,
            billingCity: formData.billingCity,
            billingState: formData.billingState,
            billingPostalCode: '110001',
            billingCountry: 'India',
            registrationType: 'Registered',
            gstNumber: formData.gstNumber.toUpperCase(),
            panNumber: formData.gstNumber ? formData.gstNumber.substring(2, 12).toUpperCase() : '',
            assignedUser: formData.assignedUser,
            isRecentlyViewed: true,
            isMyAccount: true,
            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            createdBy: 'mittal.sharma',
        };

        onSave(newOrg, addAnother);

        if (addAnother) {
            setFormData(DEFAULT_QUICK_FORM);
            setGstVerified(false);
        } else {
            onClose();
        }
    };

    return (
        <Drawer
            anchor="right"
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            slotProps={{
                paper: {
                    sx: {
                        width: { xs: '100vw', sm: 540, md: 580 },
                        display: 'flex',
                        flexDirection: 'column',
                        boxShadow: '-4px 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)',
                    },
                },
            }}
        >
            {/* ── Dark Header matching screenshot ────────────────────────────── */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                    color: '#fff',
                    px: 3,
                    py: 2.2,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                }}
            >
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                    <Box
                        sx={{
                            width: 32,
                            height: 32,
                            borderRadius: '8px',
                            backgroundColor: '#1e3a8a',
                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'center',
                            color: '#60a5fa',
                        }}
                    >
                        <AddIcon fontSize="small" />
                    </Box>
                    <Box>
                        <Typography variant="subtitle1" sx={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.98rem', color: '#fff' }}>
                            Quick Create Organization
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '0.74rem' }}>
                            Add an account directly to the master directory
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                </Box>
                <IconButton
                    size="small"
                    onClick={onClose}
                    sx={{ color: '#94a3b8', '&:hover': { color: '#fff' } }}
                >
                    <CloseIcon fontSize="small" />
                </IconButton>
            </Box>

            {/* ── Drawer Body ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
            <Box sx={{ p: 3, flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
                {errorMsg && (
                    <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2.5, borderRadius: '8px', fontSize: '0.82rem' }}>
                        {errorMsg}
                    </Alert>
                )}

                {/* Organization Name * */}
                <Box sx={{ mb: 2.5 }}>
                    <Typography
                        variant="body2"
                        sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151', fontSize: '0.82rem', mb: 0.6 }}
                    >
                        Organization Name <span style={{ color: '#ef4444' }}>*</span>
                    </Typography>
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="e.g. Acme Technologies Pvt Ltd"
                        value={formData.organizationName}
                        onChange={(e) => handleChange('organizationName', e.target.value)}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        autoFocus
                    />
                </Box>

                {/* Nature of Business & Customer Type (2 columns) */}
                <Grid container spacing={2} sx={{ mb: 2.5 }}>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                        <Typography
                            variant="body2"
                            sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151', fontSize: '0.82rem', mb: 0.6 }}
                        >
                            Nature of Business
                        </Typography>
                        <StyledSelect
                            label="Nature of Business"
                            placeholder="Select Nature"
                            value={formData.natureOfBusiness}
                            onChange={(v) => handleChange('natureOfBusiness', v)}
                            options={NATURE_OF_BUSINESS}
                        />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, sm: 6 }}>
                        <Typography
                            variant="body2"
                            sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#374151', fontSize: '0.82rem', mb: 0.6 }}
                        >
                            Customer Type
                        </Typography>
                        <StyledSelect
                            label="Customer Type"
                            placeholder="Select Customer Type"
                            value={formData.customerType}
                            onChange={(v) => handleChange('customerType', v)}
                            options={CUSTOMER_TYPES}
                        />
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>

                {/* GST Number with Verify GST link/button */}
                <Box sx={{ mb: 2.5 }}>

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import {
    Box,
    Typography,
    TextField,
    Button,
    Chip,
    Switch,
    FormControl,
    Select,
    MenuItem,
    InputAdornment,
    IconButton,
    Avatar,
} from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import AddIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Add';
import EmailIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Email';
import VerifiedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Verified';
import SwapHorizIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SwapHoriz';
import MenuBookIcon from '@mui/icons-material/MenuBook';
import SearchIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Search';
import LinkOffIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LinkOff';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';
import ContactPageOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ContactPageOutlined';

import { useFormContext, useWatch, FormProvider, useForm } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
    FormField,
    SectionLabel,
    StyledSelect,
    EmailRow,
    fieldSx,
    RhfSelect,
} from '@/components/forms';
import {
    NATURE_OF_BUSINESS,
    ACCOUNT_STATUSES,
    ENTITY_TYPES,
    CUSTOMER_TYPES,
    ANNUAL_TURNOVERS,
    EMPLOYEE_COUNTS,
    LEAD_SOURCES,
} from '../constants';

import type {
    OrganizationFormData,
    CorporateEmail,
    NatureOfBusiness,
    AccountStatus,
    TypeOfEntity,
    CustomerType,
    AnnualTurnover,
    NumberOfEmployees,
    SourceOfLead,
} from '@/types/organization.types';

export interface OverviewTabProps {
    form: OrganizationFormData;
    set: <K extends keyof OrganizationFormData>(key: K, value: OrganizationFormData[K]) => void;
    addEmail?: () => void;
    updateEmail?: (id: string, updated: CorporateEmail) => void;
    removeEmail?: (id: string) => void;
}

function OverviewTabInner({
    form,
    set,
    addEmail,
    updateEmail,
    removeEmail,
}: OverviewTabProps) {
    const { control, setValue, getValues, formState } = useFormContext<OrganizationFormData>();

    const organizationName = useWatch({ control, name: 'organizationName' }) ?? form?.organizationName ?? '';
    const mailingName = useWatch({ control, name: 'mailingName' }) ?? form?.mailingName ?? '';
    const currentAccountStatus = (useWatch({ control, name: 'accountStatus' }) ?? form?.accountStatus ?? 'Active') as AccountStatus;
    const watchedNatureOfBusiness = useWatch({ control, name: 'natureOfBusiness' });
    const watchedTypeOfEntity = useWatch({ control, name: 'typeOfEntity' });
    const watchedCustomerType = useWatch({ control, name: 'customerType' });

    // Sync RHF values with external set callback if provided
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (set && watchedNatureOfBusiness !== undefined && watchedNatureOfBusiness !== form?.natureOfBusiness) {
            set('natureOfBusiness', watchedNatureOfBusiness as NatureOfBusiness);
        }
    }, [watchedNatureOfBusiness, set, form?.natureOfBusiness]);

    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (set && watchedTypeOfEntity !== undefined && watchedTypeOfEntity !== form?.typeOfEntity) {
            set('typeOfEntity', watchedTypeOfEntity as TypeOfEntity);
        }
    }, [watchedTypeOfEntity, set, form?.typeOfEntity]);

    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (set && watchedCustomerType !== undefined && watchedCustomerType !== form?.customerType) {
            set('customerType', watchedCustomerType as CustomerType);
        }
    }, [watchedCustomerType, set, form?.customerType]);

    // Auto-copy Mailing Name when organizationName changes and mailingName is untouched or empty
    const prevOrgNameRef = React.useRef(organizationName);

    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (organizationName === prevOrgNameRef.current) return;
        prevOrgNameRef.current = organizationName;

        const currentMailing = getValues('mailingName');
        const isTouched = formState.touchedFields?.mailingName;

        if (!isTouched || !currentMailing || currentMailing.trim() === '') {
            setValue('mailingName', organizationName || '', { shouldValidate: true });
            if (set) {
                set('mailingName', organizationName || '');
            }
        }
    }, [organizationName, getValues, setValue, formState.touchedFields?.mailingName, set]);

    const handleOrgNameChange = (val: string) => {
        setValue('organizationName', val, { shouldValidate: true, shouldDirty: true });
        if (set) set('organizationName', val);

        const currentMailing = getValues('mailingName');
        const isTouched = formState.touchedFields?.mailingName;
        if (!isTouched || !currentMailing || currentMailing.trim() === '') {
            setValue('mailingName', val, { shouldValidate: true });
            if (set) set('mailingName', val);
        }
    };
    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>
            {/* ── Two-column grid ───────────────────────────────── */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'grid',
                    gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' },
                    gap: 3.5,
                }}
            >
                {/* ── LEFT COLUMN ──────────────────────────────────── */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
                    {/* Organization Name */}
                    <FormField
                        label="Organization Name"
                        required
                        hint="As per official registration"
                        sx={{ mb: 0 }}
                    >
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. Mohit Traders Pvt Ltd"
                            value={organizationName}
                            onChange={(e) => handleOrgNameChange(e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                            slotProps={{
                                input: {
                                    endAdornment: organizationName ? (
                                        <InputAdornment position="end">
                                            <VerifiedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#16a34a' }} />
                                        </InputAdornment>
                                    ) : undefined,
                                },
                                htmlInput: { maxLength: 200 },
                            }}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Nature of Business */}
                    <RhfSelect<OrganizationFormData>
                        name="natureOfBusiness"
                        label="Nature of Business"
                        placeholder="Select Nature of Business"
                        options={NATURE_OF_BUSINESS}
                        required
                    />

                    {/* Account Status */}
                    <FormField
                        label="Account Status"
                        hint={
                            (currentAccountStatus || 'Active') === 'Active' ? (
                                <Chip
                                    label="● Active Commercial"
                                    size="small"
                                    sx={{
                                        fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                        height: 20,
                                        backgroundColor: '#dcfce7',
                                        color: '#16a34a',
                                        fontWeight: 700,
                                    }}
                                />
                            ) : undefined
                        }
                        sx={{ mb: 0 }}
                    >
                        <StyledSelect
                            label="Account Status"

                            value={currentAccountStatus || 'Active'}
                            onChange={(v) => {
                                const val = v as AccountStatus;
                                setValue('accountStatus', val, { shouldValidate: true, shouldDirty: true });
                                if (set) set('accountStatus', val);
                            }}
                            options={ACCOUNT_STATUSES}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* SAP Code / Tally ID */}
                    <FormField

                        <TextField

                            sx={fieldSx}
                            slotProps={{
                                input: {
                                    endAdornment: (
                                        <InputAdornment position="end">
                                            <SwapHorizIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#94a3b8' }} />

                    {/* Source of Lead */}
                    <FormField label="Source of Lead" sx={{ mb: 0 }}>
                        <StyledSelect

                    {/* Corporate Emails */}
                    <Box>

function FallbackOverviewProvider({
    children,
    defaultValues,
}: {
    children: React.ReactNode;
    defaultValues?: OrganizationFormData;
}) {
    const methods = useForm<OrganizationFormData>({
        defaultValues: {
            organizationName: defaultValues?.organizationName || '',
            mailingName: defaultValues?.mailingName || '',
            natureOfBusiness: defaultValues?.natureOfBusiness || '',
            accountStatus: defaultValues?.accountStatus || 'Active',
            typeOfEntity: defaultValues?.typeOfEntity || '',
            customerType: defaultValues?.customerType || '',
            sapCodeTallyId: defaultValues?.sapCodeTallyId || '',
            showroomBranchCode: defaultValues?.showroomBranchCode || '',
            sourceOfLead: defaultValues?.sourceOfLead || '',
            memberOfParentCorp: defaultValues?.memberOfParentCorp || '',
            numberOfEmployees: defaultValues?.numberOfEmployees || '',
            annualTurnover: defaultValues?.annualTurnover || '',
            description: defaultValues?.description || '',
            accountVerified: defaultValues?.accountVerified || false,
            provideSupport: defaultValues?.provideSupport || 'Yes',
            corporateEmails: defaultValues?.corporateEmails || [],
            registrationType: (defaultValues?.registrationType as 'Registered' | 'Unregistered') || 'Registered',
            gstNo: defaultValues?.gstNo || defaultValues?.gstNumber || '',
            ...defaultValues,
        },
    });
    return <FormProvider {...methods}>{children}</FormProvider>;
}

export function OverviewTab(props: OverviewTabProps) {
    const existing = useFormContext<OrganizationFormData>();
    if (existing) {
        return <OverviewTabInner {...props} />;
    }
    return (
        <FallbackOverviewProvider defaultValues={props.form}>
            <OverviewTabInner {...props} />
        </FallbackOverviewProvider>
    );
}

import type { OrganizationFormData } from '@/types/organization.types';
