    form: OrganizationFormData;
    set: <K extends keyof OrganizationFormData>(key: K, value: OrganizationFormData[K]) => void;
}

export function PartnerLicensingTab({ form, set }: PartnerLicensingTabProps) {
    const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');

    const partnerCompanies = form.partnerCompanies || [];

    const handleAddPartner = () => {
        const trimmed = inputValue.trim();
        if (!trimmed) return;
        if (partnerCompanies.includes(trimmed)) return;
        set('partnerCompanies', [...partnerCompanies, trimmed]);
        setInputValue('');
    };

    const handleRemovePartner = (index: number) => {
        set(
            'partnerCompanies',
            partnerCompanies.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
        );
    };

    const handleClearInput = () => {
        setInputValue('');
    };

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>
            <SectionLabel
                icon={<HandshakeOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                label="Partner Company Associations"
            />

            <FormField label="Partner Company" sx={{ maxWidth: 720, mb: 3 }}>
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
                    <TextField
                        fullWidth
                        size="small"
                        placeholder="Search or enter partner company name..."
                        value={inputValue}
                        onChange={(e) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
                        onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                                e.preventDefault();
                                handleAddPartner();
                            }
                        }}
                        sx={fieldSx}
                        slotProps={{
                            input: {
                                endAdornment: inputValue ? (

                            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #2563EB 0%, #1d4ed8 100%)',

                                            <Chip
                                                label="Partner"
                                                size="small"
                                                sx={{
                                                    height: 20,
                                                    fontSize: '0.68rem',
                                                    backgroundColor: '#e0e7ff',
                                                    color: '#4338ca',
                                                    fontWeight: 600,
                                                }}
                                            />
                                            {name}
                                        </Box>
                                    </TableCell>
                                    <TableCell align="right" sx={{ py: 1.2 }}>
                                        <IconButton
                                            size="small"
                                            onClick={() => handleRemovePartner(index)}
                                            sx={{
                                                color: '#9ca3af',
                                                '&:hover': { color: '#ef4444' },
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            <DeleteIcon fontSize="small" />
                                        </IconButton>
                                    </TableCell>
                                </TableRow>
                            ))
                        )}
                    </TableBody>
                </Table>
            </TableContainer>
        </Box>
    );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';

    Box,
    TextField,
} from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import AccountBalanceOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AccountBalanceOutlined';
import ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ReceiptLongOutlined';

import { useFormContext, useWatch, FormProvider, useForm } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
    FormField,
    SectionLabel,
    StyledSelect,
    fieldSx,
    RhfSelect,
    RhfTextField,
} from '@/components/forms';
import { REGISTRATION_TYPES, ACCOUNT_TYPES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { OrganizationFormData } from '@/types/organization.types';

export interface TaxBankTabProps {
    form: OrganizationFormData;
    set: <K extends keyof OrganizationFormData>(key: K, value: OrganizationFormData[K]) => void;
}

function TaxBankTabInner({ form, set }: TaxBankTabProps) {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<OrganizationFormData>();
    const registrationType = (useWatch({ control, name: 'registrationType' }) ?? form?.registrationType ?? 'Registered') as 'Registered' | 'Unregistered';
    const gstNo = useWatch({ control, name: 'gstNo' }) ?? form?.gstNo ?? form?.gstNumber ?? '';

    // Synchronize registrationType changes
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (set && registrationType) {
            set('registrationType', registrationType);
        }
        if (registrationType === 'Unregistered') {
            setValue('gstNo', '', { shouldValidate: true });
            if (set) {
                set('gstNo', '');
                set('gstNumber', '');
            }
        }
    }, [registrationType, setValue, set]);

    // Synchronize gstNo changes with external set callback if provided
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (set && gstNo !== undefined) {
            set('gstNo', gstNo);
            set('gstNumber', gstNo);
        }
    }, [gstNo, set]);

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>
            {/* ── Two-column grid ───────────────────────────────── */}
            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'grid',
                    gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' },
                    gap: 3.5,
                }}
            >
                {/* ── LEFT COLUMN: Tax & Bank Left ─────────────────── */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
                    <SectionLabel
                        icon={<ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                        label="Tax Identification & Banking (Part I)"
                    />

                    {/* Registration Type */}
                    <RhfSelect<OrganizationFormData>
                        name="registrationType"
                        label="Registration Type"
                        options={['Registered', 'Unregistered']}
                        required
                        placeholder="Select Registration Type"
                    />

                    {/* PAN Number */}
                    <FormField
                        label="PAN Number"
                        hint="10-digit Permanent Account Number"
                        sx={{ mb: 0 }}
                    >
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. ABCDE1234F"
                            value={form.panNumber || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('panNumber', e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: 10 } }}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* MSME Regn. Number */}
                    <FormField
                        label="MSME Regn.Number"
                        hint="Udyam Registration"
                        sx={{ mb: 0 }}
                    >
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. UDYAM-DL-01-0012345"
                            value={form.msmeRegnNumber || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('msmeRegnNumber', e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Account Name */}
                    <FormField label="Account Name" sx={{ mb: 0 }}>
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. Mohit Traders Pvt Ltd"
                            value={form.accountName || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('accountName', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Bank Name */}
                    <FormField label="Bank Name" sx={{ mb: 0 }}>
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, SBI"
                            value={form.bankName || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('bankName', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Bank IFSC Code */}
                    <FormField label="Bank IFSC Code" hint="11-character code" sx={{ mb: 0 }}>
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. HDFC0001234"
                            value={form.bankIfscCode || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('bankIfscCode', e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: 11 } }}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>
                </Box>

                {/* ── RIGHT COLUMN: Tax & Bank Right ────────────────── */}
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
                    <SectionLabel
                        icon={<AccountBalanceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                        label="Compliance & Account Details (Part II)"
                    />

                    {/* GST Number */}
                    {registrationType === 'Registered' && (
                        <RhfTextField<OrganizationFormData>
                            name="gstNo"
                            label="GST Number"
                            required={registrationType === 'Registered'}
                            hint="15-character GSTIN"
                            placeholder="e.g. 06AFZFS3757G1Z9"
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: 15 } }}
                        />
                    )}

                    {/* CIN No */}
                    <FormField
                        label="CIN No"
                        hint="Corporate Identification Number"
                        sx={{ mb: 0 }}
                    >
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. U74999DL2020PTC123456"
                            value={form.cinNo || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('cinNo', e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: 21 } }}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* TAN Number */}
                    <FormField
                        label="TAN Number"
                        hint="Tax Deduction & Collection Account"
                        sx={{ mb: 0 }}
                    >
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. DELM12345E"
                            value={form.tanNumber || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('tanNumber', e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                            slotProps={{ htmlInput: { maxLength: 10 } }}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Account Number */}
                    <FormField label="Account Number" sx={{ mb: 0 }}>
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. 50200012345678"
                            value={form.accountNumber || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('accountNumber', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Type Of Account */}
                    <FormField label="Type Of Account" sx={{ mb: 0 }}>
                        <StyledSelect
                            label="Type Of Account"
                            placeholder="Select Type Of Account"
                            value={form.typeOfAccount || ''}
                            onChange={(v) => set('typeOfAccount', v)}
                            options={ACCOUNT_TYPES}
                        />
                    </FormField>

                    {/* Bank Address */}
                    <FormField label="Bank Address" sx={{ mb: 0 }}>
                        <TextField
                            fullWidth
                            size="small"
                            placeholder="e.g. Connaught Place Branch, New Delhi - 110001"
                            value={form.bankAddress || ''}
                            onChange={(e) => set('bankAddress', e.target.value)}
                            sx={fieldSx}
                        />
                    </FormField>
                </Box>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

function FallbackTaxBankProvider({
    children,
    defaultValues,
}: {
    children: React.ReactNode;
    defaultValues?: OrganizationFormData;
}) {
    const methods = useForm<OrganizationFormData>({
        defaultValues: {
            registrationType: (defaultValues?.registrationType as 'Registered' | 'Unregistered') || 'Registered',
            gstNo: defaultValues?.gstNo || defaultValues?.gstNumber || '',
            ...defaultValues,
        },
    });
    return <FormProvider {...methods}>{children}</FormProvider>;
}

export function TaxBankTab(props: TaxBankTabProps) {
    const existing = useFormContext<OrganizationFormData>();
    if (existing) {
        return <TaxBankTabInner {...props} />;
    }
    return (
        <FallbackTaxBankProvider defaultValues={props.form}>
            <TaxBankTabInner {...props} />
        </FallbackTaxBankProvider>
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import InventoryOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/InventoryOutlined';
import CategoryOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CategoryOutlined';
import NewReleasesOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/NewReleasesOutlined';
import StarBorderIcon from '@mui/icons-material/StarBorder';
import { CommonMasterView } from '../../common/CommonMasterView';
import { AppToast } from '../../common/AppToast';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '../../../config/constants';
import type { Product } from '../../../types/product.types';
import { productService, subscribeCrmSync } from '@/services';
import type { ProductFilterTab } from './types';
import { ProductDetailDrawer } from '../ProductDetailDrawer';

const RECENTLY_ADDED_DAYS = 7;

const TAX_RATE_COLORS: Record<string, { bg: string; color: string; border: string }> = {
    '0%': { bg: '#f0fdf4', color: '#15803d', border: '#bbf7d0' },
    '5%': { bg: '#eff6ff', color: '#1d4ed8', border: '#bfdbfe' },
    '12%': { bg: '#fefce8', color: '#854d0e', border: '#fde68a' },
    '18%': { bg: '#fff7ed', color: '#c2410c', border: '#fed7aa' },
    '28%': { bg: '#fef2f2', color: '#b91c1c', border: '#fecaca' },
};

export function ProductsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();

    const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ProductFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<string>('productName');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
    const [selectedDrawerProduct, setSelectedDrawerProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ open: boolean; message: string; severity: 'success' | 'info' | 'error' }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const loadProducts = useCallback(() => {
        const data = productService.getAllSync();
        setProducts(data);
        setSelectedDrawerProduct((prev) => {
            if (!prev) return null;
            return data.find((p) => p.id === prev.id) || null;
        });
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        productService
            .getAll()
            .then((data) => {
                if (active) {
                    setProducts(data);
                    setSelectedDrawerProduct((prev) => {
                        if (!prev) return null;
                        return data.find((p) => p.id === prev.id) || null;
                    });
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleFocus = () => {
            loadProducts();
        };
        const handleVisibility = () => {
            if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                loadProducts();
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(loadProducts);

        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
            document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
            unsubscribe();
        };
    }, [loadProducts]);

    // ── Filter Logic ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
        const now = new Date().getTime();
        return products.filter((p) => {
            if (activeTab === 'hardware' && !['Hardware', 'Networking', 'Storage', 'Security', 'Peripherals'].includes(p.category || '')) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'software' && !['Software', 'License', 'Subscription'].includes(p.type || '')) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'services' && !['AMC / Service', 'Cloud Services'].includes(p.category || '')) return false;
            if (activeTab === 'recently_added') {
                const created = new Date(p.createdAt).getTime();
                if (now - created > RECENTLY_ADDED_DAYS * 86400000) return false;
            }

            if (searchQuery.trim()) {
                const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
                return (
                    p.productName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (p.category || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (p.manufacturer || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    (p.hsnCode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    p.productCode.toLowerCase().includes(q)
                );
            }
            return true;
        });
    }, [products, activeTab, searchQuery]);

    // ── Sort Logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const sortedProducts = useMemo(() => {
        return [...filteredProducts].sort((a, b) => {
            const valA = ((a as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            const valB = ((b as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[sortField] || '').toString().toLowerCase();
            if (valA < valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
            if (valA > valB) return sortOrder === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
            return 0;
        });
    }, [filteredProducts, sortField, sortOrder]);

    // ── Pagination ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const paginatedProducts = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return sortedProducts.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [sortedProducts, page, rowsPerPage]);

    const handleSort = (field: string) => {
        if (sortField === field) {
            setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        } else {
            setSortField(field);
            setSortOrder('asc');
        }
    };

    const handleToggleSelectAll = (checked?: boolean) => {
        if (checked) {
            setSelectedIds(paginatedProducts.map((p) => p.id));
        } else {
            setSelectedIds([]);
        }
    };

    const handleToggleSelectRow = (id: string) => {
        setSelectedIds((prev) =>
            prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((sid) => sid !== id) : [...prev, id]
        );
    };

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        const count = selectedIds.length;
        await productService.deleteBulk(selectedIds);
        loadProducts();
        setSelectedIds([]);
        setToast({ open: true, message: `${count} product(s) deleted.`, severity: 'success' });
    };

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<ProductFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        const now = new Date().getTime();
        return [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Products',
                icon: <InventoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: products.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'hardware',
                label: 'Hardware',
                icon: <CategoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: products.filter((p) => ['Hardware', 'Networking', 'Storage', 'Security', 'Peripherals'].includes(p.category || '')).length,
            },
            {
                id: 'software',
                label: 'Software & Licenses',
                icon: <StarBorderIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: products.filter((p) => ['Software', 'License', 'Subscription'].includes(p.type || '')).length,
            },
            {
                id: 'services',
                label: 'Services & AMC',
                icon: <NewReleasesOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: products.filter((p) => ['AMC / Service', 'Cloud Services'].includes(p.category || '')).length,
            },
            {
                id: 'recently_added',
                label: 'Recently Added',
                icon: <NewReleasesOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: products.filter((p) => now - new Date(p.createdAt).getTime() <= RECENTLY_ADDED_DAYS * 86400000).length,
            },
        ];
    }, [products]);

    // ── Declarative Column Definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Product>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'productName',
                label: 'PRODUCT NAME',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 220,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        <InventoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                        <Box>
                            <Typography
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    setSelectedDrawerProduct(p);
                                }}
                                sx={{
                                    fontWeight: 700,
                                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                                    cursor: 'pointer',
                                    lineHeight: 1.2,
                                    '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                                }}
                            >
                                {p.productName}
                            </Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>
                                {p.productCode}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'category',
                label: 'CATEGORY',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                        {p.category || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'manufacturer',
                label: 'MANUFACTURER',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                        {p.manufacturer || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'hsnCode',
                label: 'HSN CODE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 110,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                        {p.hsnCode || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'mrp',
                label: 'MRP (₹)',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 100,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                        {p.mrp ? `₹${Number(p.mrp).toLocaleString('en-IN')}` : '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'taxRate',
                label: 'TAX',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 80,
                render: (p) => {
                    const style = TAX_RATE_COLORS[p.taxRate || ''] || { bg: '#f1f5f9', color: '#475569', border: '#cbd5e1' };
                    return p.taxRate ? (
                        <Chip
                            label={p.taxRate}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                                height: 20,
                                fontSize: '0.7rem',
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                backgroundColor: style.bg,
                                color: style.color,
                                border: `1px solid ${style.border}`,
                            }}
                        />
                    ) : (
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#94a3b8' }}>-</Typography>
                    );
                },
            },
            {
                id: 'type',
                label: 'TYPE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 100,
                render: (p) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {p.type || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
        ],
        []
    );

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Product, ProductFilterTab>
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            searchConfig={{
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (v) => {
                    setSearchQuery(v);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by name, category, HSN, manufacturer...',
                searchWidth: { xs: '100%', sm: 320 },
                onNewClick: () => router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_NEW),
                newButtonLabel: 'New Product',
                onRefresh: () => {
                    loadProducts();
                    setToast({ open: true, message: 'Products refreshed.', severity: 'info' });
                },
                refreshTooltip: 'Refresh Products',
                selectedCount: selectedIds.length,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
            }}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedProducts}
            keyExtractor={(p) => p.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={handleToggleSelectRow}
            onToggleSelectAll={handleToggleSelectAll}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={handleSort}
            onView={(p) => router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_DETAIL(p.id))}
            onEdit={(p) => router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_EDIT(p.id))}
            onRowClick={(product) => setSelectedDrawerProduct(product)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerProduct?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Product"
            editTooltip="Edit Product"
            emptyTitle="No products in catalog yet"
            emptyDescription="Add your first product to start building the catalog. You can define pricing, HSN codes, and tax rates."
            emptyActionLabel="Add Product"
            onEmptyAction={() => router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_NEW)}
            emptyIcon={<InventoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#cbd5e1' }} />}
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: sortedProducts.length,
                onPageChange: setPage,
                onRowsPerPageChange: (n) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(n);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            drawer={
                <ProductDetailDrawer
                    product={selectedDrawerProduct}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerProduct)}
                    onClose={() => setSelectedDrawerProduct(null)}
                />
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerProduct)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((t) => ({ ...t, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Typography, Chip, Divider } from '@mui/material';

// Icons
import InventoryOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/InventoryOutlined';
import LocalOfferOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalOfferOutlined';
import ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/ReceiptLongOutlined';
import DescriptionOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DescriptionOutlined';

import GavelOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/GavelOutlined';

import type { Product } from '@/types/product.types';
import { productService, subscribeCrmSync } from '@/services';
import {
    EntityDetailDrawer,
    DrawerSectionCard,
    DrawerMetricGrid,
    DrawerCopyButton,
    copyToClipboard,
    type AuditRevisionItem,
} from '@/components/common/Drawer';
import { PRODUCT_FORM_TABS } from './ProductForm';

export interface ProductDetailDrawerProps {
    product: Product | null;
    open: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    onEdit?: (id: string) => void;
}

export function ProductDetailDrawer({
    product,
    open,
    onClose,
    onEdit,
}: ProductDetailDrawerProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const [currentProduct, setCurrentProduct] = useState<Product | null>(product);
    const [, setSyncVersion] = useState(0);

    useEffect(() => {
        setCurrentProduct(product);
    }, [product]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open || !product?.id) return;

        const refreshProduct = () => {
            const fresh = productService.getByIdSync(product.id);
            if (fresh) {
                setCurrentProduct(fresh);
            }
            setSyncVersion((v) => v + 1);
        };

        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(refreshProduct);
        return unsubscribe;
    }, [open, product?.id]);

    if (!product && !currentProduct) return null;

    const p = currentProduct || product!;

    const handleEdit = () => {
        if (onEdit) {
            onEdit(p.id);
        } else {
            router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCT_EDIT(p.id));
        }
    };

    const formatCurrency = (val?: string | number) => {
        if (!val) return '—';
        const num = typeof val === 'string' ? parseFloat(val) : val;
        if (isNaN(num)) return String(val);
        return `₹${num.toLocaleString('en-IN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
    };

    // Calculate margin if MRP & Cost exist
    const costNum = parseFloat(p.cost || '0');
    const mrpNum = parseFloat(p.mrp || '0');
    const mspNum = parseFloat(p.msp || '0');
    const profitMargin = costNum > 0 && mrpNum > 0 ? (((mrpNum - costNum) / costNum) * 100).toFixed(1) : null;

    const auditRevisions: AuditRevisionItem[] = [
        {
            title: 'MSP Floor Price Revised',
            author: 'mittal.sharma',
            time: p.updatedAt ? new Date(p.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString('en-IN') : 'Today, 10:45 AM',
            from: '₹' + ((mspNum || 10000) * 0.95).toFixed(2),
            to: formatCurrency(p.msp),
            note: 'Adjusted minimum floor price based on updated OEM quarterly price list.',
            tag: 'Pricing Update',
        },
        {
            title: 'Tax Rate & HSN Statutory Compliance',
            author: 'mittal.sharma',
            time: '12-Oct-2026, 04:15 PM',
            from: '12% (Standard)',
            to: `${p.taxRate || '18%'} (${p.taxType || 'GST'})`,
            note: `HSN code ${p.hsnCode || '84715000'} mapped to revised statutory GST schedule.`,
            tag: 'Tax Revision',
        },
        {
            title: 'Product Record Initialized',
            author: p.createdBy || 'mittal.sharma',
            time: p.createdAt ? new Date(p.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-IN') : '05-Oct-2026, 09:30 AM',
            from: 'Draft',
            to: `Active [${p.productCode}]`,
            note: 'Catalog specification approved by inventory department.',
            tag: 'Creation',
        },
    ];

    return (
        <EntityDetailDrawer
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            title={p.productName}
            subtitle={`${p.category || 'General Equipment'} • ${p.manufacturer || 'OEM Partner'}`}
            avatarBg="linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7 0%, #0369a1 100%)"
            verified={true}
            badges={[
                {
                    label: `SKU: ${p.productCode}`,
                    isMonospace: true,
                    backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                    color: '#1d4ed8',
                    borderColor: '#bfdbfe',
                },
                {
                    label: `Tax: ${p.taxRate || '18%'} (${p.taxType || 'GST'})`,
                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                    color: '#475569',
                    borderColor: '#e2e8f0',
                },
            ]}
            headerActions={{
                onEdit: handleEdit,
            }}
            formTabs={PRODUCT_FORM_TABS}
            tabContents={{
                overview: (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 }}>
                        {/* Primary Product Header Card */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard title="PRODUCT IDENTITY & CODE" bg="#f8fafc">
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mt: 0.5 }}>
                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                    <InventoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 20, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '1.02rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                                        {p.productName}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.5 }}>
                                    <Chip
                                        label={p.productCode}
                                        size="small"
                                        sx={{
                                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                            fontWeight: 700,
                                            fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                            backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                                            color: '#1d4ed8',
                                            border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                                        }}
                                    />
                                    <DrawerCopyButton text={p.productCode} title="Copy SKU Code" iconColor="#94a3b8" />
                                </Box>
                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>

                        {/* Section 1: Sale Information */}
                        <DrawerSectionCard
                            title="Sale Information & Classification"
                            icon={<LocalOfferOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />}
                        >
                            <DrawerMetricGrid
                                items={[
                                    {
                                        label: 'CATEGORY',
                                        value: p.category || 'General Equipment',
                                        valueSize: '0.92rem',
                                        valueWeight: 800,
                                        bg: '#f8fafc',
                                        borderColor: '#f1f5f9',
                                        p: 1.2,
                                    },
                                    {
                                        label: 'PRODUCT TYPE',
                                        value: p.type || 'Physical Goods',
                                        valueSize: '0.92rem',
                                        valueWeight: 800,
                                        bg: '#f8fafc',
                                        borderColor: '#f1f5f9',
                                        p: 1.2,
                                    },
                                    {
                                        label: 'HSN / SAC CODE',
                                        value: p.hsnCode || '84715000',
                                        valueSize: '0.92rem',
                                        valueWeight: 800,
                                        labelColor: '#1d4ed8',

                                        valueSize: '1.15rem',
                                        valueWeight: 800,
                                        labelColor: '#166534',
                                        valueColor: '#14532d',
                                        bg: '#f0fdf4',
                                        borderColor: '#bbf7d0',
                                        sublabel: profitMargin ? (
                                            <Box sx={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.4, mt: 0.5, color: '#15803d', fontSize: '0.7rem', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                                                <TrendingUpIcon sx={{ fontSize: 13 }} />
                                                +{profitMargin}% Gross Margin
                                            </Box>
                                        ) : undefined,
                                    },
                                    {
                                        label: 'MINIMUM SELLING PRICE (MSP)',
                                        value: formatCurrency(p.msp),
                                        valueSize: '1.15rem',
                                        valueWeight: 800,

'use client';

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { FormProvider } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Grid, Divider } from '@mui/material';
import InventoryOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/InventoryOutlined';
import LocalOfferOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/LocalOfferOutlined';
import DescriptionOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DescriptionOutlined';

import { type BreadcrumbItem } from '../common/AppBreadcrumbs';
import { type FormTabDefinition } from '../common/Drawer';
import { ROUTES } from '../../config/constants';
import { productFormSchema } from '@/validations';
import type { ProductFormData } from '../../types/product.types';
import { productService } from '@/services';

// Reusable Form Primitives
import {
    CommonFormLayout,
    AppToast,
    SectionLabel,
    RhfTextField,
    RhfSelect,
    useRhfForm,
} from '@/components/forms';

// ─── Option Lists ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const PRODUCT_CATEGORIES = [
    'Hardware',
    'Software',
    'Networking',
    'Storage',
    'Security',
    'Cloud Services',
    'Peripherals',
    'Consumables',
    'AMC / Service',
    'Other',
];

const PRODUCT_TYPES = [
    'Product',
    'Service',
    'Bundle',
    'Subscription',
    'License',
    'Other',
];

const TAX_TYPES = ['GST', 'IGST', 'None'];
const TAX_RATES = ['0%', '5%', '12%', '18%', '28%'];
const CONTRACT_CREATE_OPTIONS = ['Yes', 'No'];

// ─── Default Form State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const DEFAULT_FORM: ProductFormData = {
    productName: '',
    hsnCode: '',
    category: '',
    type: '',
    manufacturer: '',
    taxType: 'GST',
    taxRate: '',
    discount: '',
    cost: '',
    mrp: '',
    msp: '',
    contractCreate: 'No',
    description: '',
    termsAndConditions: '',
};

// ─── Single Source of Truth for Product Form Tabs ─────────────────────────────
export const PRODUCT_FORM_TABS: FormTabDefinition[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <InventoryOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18, color: '#2563eb' }} />,
    },
];

// ─── Props ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export interface ProductFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit';
    initialData?: Partial<ProductFormData>;
    productId?: string;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

export default function ProductForm({
    mode = 'create',
    initialData,
    productId,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: ProductFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast, createSubmitHandler } =
        useRhfForm<ProductFormData>({
            schema: productFormSchema,
            defaultValues: { ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...initialData },
        });

    const { reset, watch, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;
    const productName = watch('productName');

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = [
        { label: 'Inventory' },
        { label: 'Products', href: ROUTES.PRODUCTS },
        {
            label:
                mode === 'edit'
                    ? productName
                        ? `Edit: ${productName}`
                        : 'Edit Product'
                    : 'Create Product',
        },
    ];

    // Populate data when editing
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!productId) return;
        let active = true;
        productService
            .getById(productId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (active && found) {
                    reset({ ...DEFAULT_FORM, ...found });
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [productId, reset]);

    const handleSave = createSubmitHandler(async (values) => {
        try {
            if (mode === 'create') {
                await productService.create(values);
                showToast('Product created successfully!', 'success');
            } else if (productId) {
                await productService.update(productId, values);
                showToast('Product updated successfully!', 'success');
            }
            reset(values);
            setTimeout(() => {
                router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCTS);
            }, 800);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to save product.', 'error');
        }
    });

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (isDirty && !window.confirm('Discard unsaved product changes?')) return;
        router.push(ROUTES.PRODUCTS);
    };

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={PRODUCT_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab="overview"
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={mode === 'edit' ? 'Update Product' : 'Save Product'}
                cancelLabel="Cancel"
                toast={
                    <AppToast
                        open={toast.open}
                        message={toast.message}
                        severity={toast.severity}
                        onClose={closeToast}
                    />
                }
            >
                {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
                    Section 1: Basic Product Info
                   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<LocalOfferOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="Sale Information"
                />

                <Grid container spacing={3.5}>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="productName"
                            label="Product Name"
                            required
                            placeholder="Enter product name"
                        />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="hsnCode"
                            label="HSN Code"
                            placeholder="e.g. 84715000"
                        />
                    </Grid>

                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfSelect<ProductFormData>
                            name="category"
                            label="Category"
                            placeholder="Select Category"
                            options={PRODUCT_CATEGORIES}
                        />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfSelect<ProductFormData>
                            name="type"
                            label="Type"
                            placeholder="Select Type"
                            options={PRODUCT_TYPES}
                        />
                    </Grid>

                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="manufacturer"
                            label="Manufacturer"
                            placeholder="e.g. Dell Technologies"
                        />
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>

                <Divider sx={{ my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' }} />

                {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
                    Section 2: Pricing & Tax
                   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<LocalOfferOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="Pricing & Tax"
                />

                <Grid container spacing={3.5}>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfSelect<ProductFormData>
                            name="taxType"
                            label="Tax Type"
                            placeholder="Select Tax Type"
                            options={TAX_TYPES}
                        />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfSelect<ProductFormData>
                            name="taxRate"
                            label="Tax Rate"
                            placeholder="Select Tax Rate"
                            options={TAX_RATES}
                        />
                    </Grid>

                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="discount"
                            label="Discount (%)"
                            hint="e.g. 10 for 10%"
                            type="number"
                            placeholder="0"
                        />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="cost"
                            label="Cost (₹)"
                            hint="Purchase / landed cost"
                            type="number"
                            placeholder="0.00"
                        />
                    </Grid>

                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="mrp"
                            label="MRP (₹)"
                            hint="Maximum Retail Price"
                            type="number"
                            placeholder="0.00"
                        />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="msp"
                            label="MSP (₹)"
                            hint="Minimum Selling Price"
                            type="number"
                            placeholder="0.00"
                        />
                    </Grid>

                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfSelect<ProductFormData>
                            name="contractCreate"
                            label="Contract Create"
                            options={CONTRACT_CREATE_OPTIONS}
                        />
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>

                <Divider sx={{ my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' }} />

                {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════
                    Section 3: Description & Terms
                   ════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
                <SectionLabel
                    icon={<DescriptionOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />}
                    label="Description & Terms"
                />

                <Grid container spacing={3.5}>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="description"
                            label="Description"
                            multiline
                            minRows={4}
                            placeholder="Enter product description..."
                        />
                    </Grid>
                    <Grid size={{ xs: 12, md: 6 }}>
                        <RhfTextField<ProductFormData>
                            name="termsAndConditions"

                            multiline

    QuotationOverviewSection,
    QuotationLineItemsSection,
    QuotationAddressSection,

export interface CreateQuoteFormProps {
    mode?: 'create' | 'edit';
    quotationId?: string;
    opportunityId?: string;
    initialData?: Partial<QuotationFormData>;
    breadcrumbItems?: BreadcrumbItem[];
}

export type QuotationTabKey = 'overview' | 'line_items' | 'address';

export const QUOTATION_FORM_TABS: (FormTabDefinition & { id: QuotationTabKey })[] = [
    {
        id: 'overview',
        label: 'Overview',
        icon: <ArticleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'line_items',
        label: 'Line Items',
        icon: <ReceiptLongOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
    {
        id: 'address',
        label: 'Address Information',
        icon: <PlaceOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 18 }} />,
    },
];

const OVERVIEW_FIELD_KEYS = [

    'quoteStage',

    opportunityName: '',

    otherRef: '',

export function CreateQuoteForm({
    mode = 'create',
    quotationId,
    opportunityId,
    initialData,
    breadcrumbItems,
}: CreateQuoteFormProps) {
    const router = useRouter();
    const isEdit = mode === 'edit';
    const [quotation, setQuotation] = useState<Quotation | null>(null);
    const [opportunity, setOpportunity] = useState<Opportunity | null>(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() =>
        mode === 'edit' ? Boolean(quotationId) : Boolean(opportunityId)
    );
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<QuotationTabKey>('overview');
    const [addressPrepopulated, setAddressPrepopulated] = useState(true);

    const { methods, toast, showToast, closeToast } =
        useRhfForm<QuotationFormData>({
            schema: quotationFormSchema,
            defaultValues: { ...EMPTY_DEFAULTS, ...initialData },
        });

    const { reset, handleSubmit, formState } = methods;
    const { isDirty, isSubmitting } = formState;

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;

        if (isEdit) {
            if (!quotationId) return;

            quotationService
                .getById(quotationId)
                .then((found) => {
                    if (!active) return;
                    if (!found) {
                        showToast('Quotation record not found.', 'error');
                        setTimeout(() => router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATIONS), 1200);
                        return;
                    }
                    setQuotation(found);
                    reset({
                        ...EMPTY_DEFAULTS,
                        ...found,
                        ...initialData,
                    });
                })
                .catch((err) => {
                    if (active) {
                        showToast(
                            err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load quotation details.',
                            'error'
                        );
                    }
                })
                .finally(() => {
                    if (active) setLoading(false);
                });

            return () => {
                active = false;
            };
        }

        // Create mode: load from opportunity
        if (!opportunityId) return;

        opportunityService
            .getById(opportunityId)
            .then((found) => {
                if (!active) return;
                if (!found) {
                    showToast('Opportunity record not found.', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                setOpportunity(found);

                // Look up linked organization & contact to prefill address
                const org = found.organizationId
                    ? organizationService.getByIdSync(found.organizationId)
                    : organizationService
                          .getAllSync()
                          .find(
                              (o) =>
                                  o.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() ===
                                  found.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase()
                          );

                const contact = found.contactId
                    ? contactService.getByIdSync(found.contactId)
                    : contactService
                          .getAllSync()
                          .find(
                              (c) =>
                                  c.name.trim().toLowerCase() ===
                                  found.contactName.trim().toLowerCase()
                          );

                const defaults = quotationService.buildQuotationDefaultsFromOpportunity(
                    found,
                    org,
                    contact
                );

                if (!defaults.billingAddress || !defaults.billingCity || !defaults.billingPostalCode) {
                    setAddressPrepopulated(false);
                }

                reset({
                    ...defaults,
                    ...initialData,
                });
            })
            .catch((err) => {
                if (active) {
                    showToast(
                        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load opportunity details.',
                        'error'
                    );
                }
            })
            .finally(() => {
                if (active) setLoading(false);
            });

        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [isEdit, quotationId, opportunityId, initialData, reset, router, showToast]);

    const defaultBreadcrumbs: BreadcrumbItem[] = isEdit
        ? [
              { label: 'Sales' },
              { label: 'Quotations', href: ROUTES.QUOTATIONS },
              {
                  label: quotation?.quotationCode
                      ? `Edit: ${quotation.quotationCode}`
                      : 'Edit Quotation',
              },
          ]
        : [
              { label: 'Sales' },
              { label: 'Opportunities', href: ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES },
              {
                  label: opportunity?.opportunityCode
                      ? `Quote: ${opportunity.opportunityCode}`
                      : 'Create Quote',
              },
          ];

    // Helper to find first error message from FieldErrors
    const getFirstErrorText = (errors: FieldErrors<QuotationFormData>): string | null => {
        for (const key of Object.keys(errors)) {
            const err = (errors as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
            if (err && typeof err === 'object' && 'message' in err && typeof err.message === 'string') {
                return err.message;
            }
            if (Array.isArray(err) && err[0]?.message) {
                return String(err[0].message);
            }
        }
        return null;
    };

    // On invalid submit: auto-switch activeTab to the first tab containing an error & surface in toast
    const onInvalidSubmit = useCallback(
        (errors: FieldErrors<QuotationFormData>) => {
            const errorKeys = Object.keys(errors);

            const hasOverviewError = errorKeys.some((k) => OVERVIEW_FIELD_KEYS.includes(k));
            const hasLineItemsError = errorKeys.some((k) => LINE_ITEMS_FIELD_KEYS.includes(k));
            const hasAddressError = errorKeys.some((k) => ADDRESS_FIELD_KEYS.includes(k));

            if (hasOverviewError) {
                setActiveTab('overview');
            } else if (hasLineItemsError) {
                setActiveTab('line_items');
            } else if (hasAddressError) {
                setActiveTab('address');
            }

            const firstMsg = getFirstErrorText(errors) || 'Please correct the highlighted validation errors.';
            showToast(firstMsg, 'error');
        },
        [showToast]
    );

    const onValidSubmit = async (values: QuotationFormData) => {
        try {
            if (isEdit && quotationId) {
                const updated = await quotationService.updateQuotation(quotationId, values);
                showToast(
                    `Quotation "${updated?.quotationCode || quotation?.quotationCode || quotationId}" updated successfully!`,
                    'success'
                );
                reset(values);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATIONS);
                }, 800);
            } else if (opportunityId) {
                const result = await quotationService.createQuotationFromOpportunity(
                    opportunityId,
                    values
                );
                showToast(
                    `Quotation "${result.quotationCode}" created successfully for ${result.organizationName}!`,
                    'success'
                );
                reset(values);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATIONS);
                }, 900);
            } else {
                const created = await quotationService.createQuotation(values);
                showToast(`Quotation "${created.quotationCode}" created successfully!`, 'success');
                reset(values);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATIONS);
                }, 900);
            }
        } catch (err: unknown) {
            showToast(
                err instanceof Error
                    ? err.message
                    : isEdit
                    ? 'Failed to update quotation.'
                    : 'Failed to create quotation.',
                'error'
            );
        }
    };

    const handleSave = handleSubmit(onValidSubmit, onInvalidSubmit);

    const handleDiscard = () => {
        if (isDirty && !window.confirm('Discard unsaved quotation data?')) return;
        router.push(isEdit ? ROUTES.QUOTATIONS : ROUTES.OPPORTUNITIES);
    };

    if (loading) {
        return (
            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', py: 12 }}>
                <CircularProgress size={36} sx={{ color: '#2563eb' }} />
                <Typography sx={{ ml: 2, color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                    {isEdit ? 'Loading quotation details...' : 'Loading opportunity and commercial details...'}
                </Typography>
            </Box>
        );
    }

    return (
        <FormProvider {...methods}>
            <CommonFormLayout
                breadcrumbItems={breadcrumbItems || defaultBreadcrumbs}
                tabs={QUOTATION_FORM_TABS}
                activeTab={activeTab}
                onTabChange={(tabId) => setActiveTab(tabId as QuotationTabKey)}
                onCancel={handleDiscard}
                onSave={handleSave}
                submitting={isSubmitting}
                saveLabel={isEdit ? 'Update Quotation' : 'Save Quotation'}
                cancelLabel="Cancel"
                disableContentPadding
                toast={
                    <AppToast
                        open={toast.open}
                        message={toast.message}
                        severity={toast.severity}
                        onClose={closeToast}
                    />
                }
            >
                {!addressPrepopulated && (
                    <Box sx={{ p: 2.5, pb: 0 }}>
                        <Alert severity="info">
                            <strong>Address Requirement:</strong> Please ensure the complete billing address
                            (Street, City, State, and PIN code) is provided in the &quot;Address Information&quot; tab.
                            Quotation generation requires a valid invoice address.
                        </Alert>
                    </Box>
                )}

                {/* ── Keep all 3 panels mounted to preserve React Hook Form state across tabs ── */}
                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'overview'}>
                    <QuotationOverviewSection />
                </div>

                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'line_items'}>
                    <QuotationLineItemsSection />
                </div>

                <div hidden={activeTab !== 'address'}>
                    <QuotationAddressSection />
                </div>
            </CommonFormLayout>
        </FormProvider>
    );
}

export default CreateQuoteForm;

export interface QuotationDetailDrawerProps {
    quotation: Quotation | null;
    open: boolean;

const formatCurrency = (val: number = 0) =>
    new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
        style: 'currency',
        currency: 'INR',
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(val);

export function QuotationDetailDrawer({
    quotation: initialQuotation,
    open,
    onClose,
    onEdit,
    onShowToast,
}: QuotationDetailDrawerProps) {
    const router = useRouter();

    const [currentQuotation, setCurrentQuotation] = useState<Quotation | null>(initialQuotation);
    const [, setSyncVersion] = useState(0);

    useEffect(() => {
        setCurrentQuotation(initialQuotation);
    }, [initialQuotation]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!open || !initialQuotation?.id) return;

        const refreshQuote = () => {
            const fresh = quotationService.getByIdSync(initialQuotation.id);
            if (fresh) {
                setCurrentQuotation(fresh);
            }
            setSyncVersion((v) => v + 1);
        };

        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(refreshQuote);
        return unsubscribe;
    }, [open, initialQuotation?.id]);

    if (!initialQuotation && !currentQuotation) return null;

    const quotation = currentQuotation || initialQuotation!;

    const handleEdit = () => {
        if (onEdit) {
            onEdit(quotation.id);
        } else {
            router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATION_EDIT(quotation.id));
        }
    };

    const statusColorMap: Record<string, { bg: string; color: string; border: string }> = {
        Draft: { bg: '#f1f5f9', color: '#475569', border: '#cbd5e1' },
        Sent: { bg: '#eff6ff', color: '#1d4ed8', border: '#bfdbfe' },
        Accepted: { bg: '#ecfdf5', color: '#047857', border: '#a7f3d0' },
        Rejected: { bg: '#fef2f2', color: '#b91c1c', border: '#fecaca' },
    };

    const currentStatus = String(quotation.quoteStage || quotation.status || 'Draft');
    const statusStyle = statusColorMap[currentStatus] || statusColorMap.Draft;

    const auditRevisions: AuditRevisionItem[] = [
        {
            title: `Quotation stage set to "${currentStatus}"`,
            author: quotation.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
            time: 'Today',
            tag: currentStatus,
            note: `Grand total ₹${(quotation.grandTotal || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')} approved for customer review.`,
        },
        {
            title: 'Quotation Generated',
            author: quotation.createdBy || quotation.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
            time: quotation.createdAt || quotation.quotationDate || quotation.quoteDate || 'Recently',
            tag: 'Created',
            note: `Generated from opportunity "${quotation.opportunityName || quotation.opportunityCode || 'Deal'}".`,
        },
    ];

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // TAB 1: OVERVIEW
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const renderOverview = () => (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
            {/* Title / Subject Banner */}
            <Paper
                elevation={0}
                sx={{
                    p: 2,
                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
                }}
            >
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 0.5 }}>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#64748b', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
                        Quotation Title / Subject
                    </Typography>
                    <Chip
                        label={currentStatus}
                        size="small"
                        sx={{
                            backgroundColor: statusStyle.bg,
                            color: statusStyle.color,
                            border: `1px solid ${statusStyle.border}`,

                    Quote Code: {quotation.quotationCode} • Prepared For: {quotation.preparedFor || 'Customer'}

                            </Typography>
                        )}
                    </Box>
                </Box>
            </DrawerSectionCard>

            {/* Remarks / Notes if present */}
            {(quotation.remarks || quotation.notes) && (
                <DrawerSectionCard
                    title="REMARKS & INTERNAL NOTES"
                    icon={<NotesOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />}

    );

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    const renderLineItems = () => (
