                        {quotation.groupName || 'Software Licenses & Add-ons'}
                    </Typography>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        Currency: {quotation.currency || 'Indian Rupee: ₹'}
                    </Typography>
                </Box>
                <Chip
                    label={`${quotation.lineItems?.length || 0} Items`}
                    size="small"
                    sx={{
                        backgroundColor: '#eff6ff',
                        color: '#1d4ed8',
                        border: '1px solid #bfdbfe',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                        fontSize: '0.72rem',
                    }}
                />
            </Box>

            {/* Line Items Cards */}
            {!quotation.lineItems || quotation.lineItems.length === 0 ? (
                <Box sx={{ p: 4, textAlign: 'center', backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', borderRadius: '8px', border: '1px dashed #cbd5e1' }}>
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        No product line items attached to this quotation.
                    </Typography>
                </Box>
            ) : (
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.5 }}>
                    {quotation.lineItems.map((item, idx) => (
                        <DrawerSectionCard key={item.id || idx} p={1.8}>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'space-between', mb: 1 }}>
                                <Box sx={{ pr: 2 }}>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.86rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                                        {item.productName}
                                    </Typography>
                                    {item.description && (
                                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b', mt: 0.3, lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
                                            {item.description}
                                        </Typography>
                                    )}
                                </Box>
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.94rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#15803d', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
                                    ₹{(item.total || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>

                            <Box
                                sx={{
                                    display: 'grid',
                                    gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
                                    gap: 1,
                                    pt: 1,
                                    borderTop: '1px dashed #e2e8f0',
                                    fontSize: '0.75rem',
                                }}
                            >
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>Quantity:</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{item.quantity}</Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>Unit Price:</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>₹{(item.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>Discount:</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#dc2626' }}>
                                        {item.discount > 0 ? `${item.discount}${item.discountType === 'percentage' ? '%' : '₹'}` : '₹0'}
                                    </Typography>
                                </Box>
                                <Box>
                                    <Typography sx={{ color: '#64748b', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>Tax ({item.taxRate}):</Typography>
                                    <Typography sx={{ fontWeight: 600, color: '#2563eb' }}>₹{(item.taxAmount || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</Typography>
                                </Box>
                            </Box>
                        </DrawerSectionCard>
                    ))}
                </Box>
            )}

            {/* Financial Summary Breakdown Card */}
            <Paper
                elevation={0}
                sx={{
                    p: 2.2,
                    backgroundColor: '#f8fafc',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    border: '1.5px solid #bfdbfe',
                }}
            >
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e3a8a', mb: 1.5, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
                    Commercial Breakdown
                </Typography>

                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1 }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Total Gross Amount:</Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                            {formatCurrency(quotation.totalAmount)}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>

                    {quotation.totalDiscount > 0 && (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#dc2626' }}>Item Discounts:</Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#dc2626' }}>
                                - {formatCurrency(quotation.totalDiscount)}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    )}

                    {quotation.lumpSumDiscount > 0 && (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#dc2626' }}>Lump Sum Discount:</Typography>
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#dc2626' }}>
                                - {formatCurrency(quotation.lumpSumDiscount)}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                    )}

                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#475569' }}>Subtotal:</Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                            {formatCurrency(quotation.subtotal)}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>

                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Tax (GST):</Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#2563eb' }}>
                            + {formatCurrency(quotation.totalTax)}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>

                    <Divider sx={{ my: 0.5, borderColor: '#cbd5e1' }} />

                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.94rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                            Grand Total:
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '1.18rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#15803d' }}>
                            {formatCurrency(quotation.grandTotal)}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                </Box>
            </Paper>
        </Box>
    );

    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // TAB 3: ADDRESS INFORMATION
    // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const renderAddress = () => (
        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.5 }}>
            {/* Customer & Organization Header Card */}
            <DrawerSectionCard
                title="ORGANIZATION & CONTACT"
                icon={<ApartmentOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />}
                bg="#f8fafc"
            >
                <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1.2, mt: 1 }}>
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                            <BusinessOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />
                            <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.9rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#1e3a8a' }}>
                                {quotation.organizationName || 'Unspecified Organization'}
                            </Typography>
                        </Box>
                        {quotation.gstNo && (
                            <DrawerCopyButton text={quotation.gstNo} title="Copy GSTIN" iconColor="#94a3b8" />
                        )}
                    </Box>

                    {quotation.mailingName && quotation.mailingName !== quotation.organizationName && (
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                            Mailing Name: {quotation.mailingName}
                        </Typography>
                    )}

                    {quotation.gstNo && (
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: '#475569', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                            GSTIN: {quotation.gstNo}
                        </Typography>
                    )}

                    <Divider sx={{ my: 0.5 }} />

                    {/* Contact Person Details */}
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                        <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1e293b' }}>
                            {quotation.contactName}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>

                    {(quotation.contactMobile || quotation.contactNumber) && (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                <PhoneOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155' }}>
                                    {quotation.contactMobile || quotation.contactNumber}
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                            <DrawerCopyButton
                                text={quotation.contactMobile || quotation.contactNumber || ''}
                                title="Copy Phone Number"
                                iconColor="#94a3b8"
                            />
                        </Box>
                    )}

                    {(quotation.contactEmail || quotation.emailAddress) && (
                        <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
                            <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1 }}>
                                <EmailOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#64748b' }} />
                                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#334155' }}>
                                    {quotation.contactEmail || quotation.emailAddress}
                                </Typography>
                            </Box>
                            <DrawerCopyButton
                                text={quotation.contactEmail || quotation.emailAddress || ''}
                                title="Copy Email Address"
                                iconColor="#94a3b8"
                            />
                        </Box>
                    )}
                </Box>
            </DrawerSectionCard>

            {/* Billing Address Card */}
            <DrawerSectionCard
                title="BILLING ADDRESS"
                icon={<LocationOnOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />}
            >
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#1e293b', lineHeight: 1.6, mt: 0.5 }}>
                    {quotation.billingAddress || '-'}<br />
                    {quotation.billingCity ? `${quotation.billingCity}, ` : ''}
                    {quotation.billingState || ''}
                    {quotation.billingPostalCode ? ` - ${quotation.billingPostalCode}` : ''}<br />
                    {quotation.billingCountry || 'India'}
                </Typography>
            </DrawerSectionCard>

            {/* Shipping Address Card */}
            <DrawerSectionCard
                title="SHIPPING ADDRESS"
                icon={<LocationOnOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16, color: '#2563eb' }} />}
                action={
                    quotation.copyAddressFromBilling ? (
                        <Chip
                            label="Same as Billing"
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                                height: 20,
                                fontSize: '0.68rem',
                                fontWeight: 600,
                                backgroundColor: '#f0fdf4',
                                color: '#166534',
                                border: '1px solid #bbf7d0',
                            }}
                        />
                    ) : undefined
                }
            >
                <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.84rem', color: '#1e293b', lineHeight: 1.6, mt: 0.5 }}>
                    {(quotation.shippingAddress || quotation.billingAddress) || '-'}<br />
                    {(quotation.shippingCity || quotation.billingCity) ? `${quotation.shippingCity || quotation.billingCity}, ` : ''}
                    {quotation.shippingState || quotation.billingState || ''}
                    {(quotation.shippingPostalCode || quotation.billingPostalCode) ? ` - ${quotation.shippingPostalCode || quotation.billingPostalCode}` : ''}<br />
                    {quotation.shippingCountry || quotation.billingCountry || 'India'}
                </Typography>
            </DrawerSectionCard>
        </Box>
    );

    return (
        <EntityDetailDrawer
            open={open}
            onClose={onClose}
            title={quotation.quotationCode}
            subtitle={`${quotation.quotationTitle || quotation.quotationSubject || 'Quotation'} • ${quotation.organizationName}`}
            avatarText={quotation.quotationCode.replace(/^QT-0*/i, 'QT-')}
            avatarIcon={<RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 24, color: '#ffffff' }} />}
            avatarBg="linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 100%)"
            statusText={`Valid Until: ${quotation.validUntil || quotation.quoteDate || '-'}`}
            badges={[
                {
                    label: currentStatus,
                    backgroundColor: statusStyle.bg,
                    color: statusStyle.color,
                    borderColor: statusStyle.border,
                },
                {
                    label: `₹${(quotation.grandTotal || 0).toLocaleString('en-IN')}`,
                    backgroundColor: '#f0fdf4',
                    color: '#15803d',
                    borderColor: '#bbf7d0',
                },
                {
                    label: quotation.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
                    backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
                    color: '#475569',
                    borderColor: '#cbd5e1',
                },
            ]}
            headerActions={{
                onEdit: handleEdit,
                onPhone:
                    quotation.contactMobile || quotation.contactNumber
                        ? () => window.open(`tel:${quotation.contactMobile || quotation.contactNumber}`)
                        : undefined,
            }}
            primaryAction={{
                label: 'Edit Quotation',
                onClick: handleEdit,
                icon: <EditOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
            }}
            formTabs={QUOTATION_FORM_TABS}
            tabContents={{
                overview: renderOverview(),
                line_items: renderLineItems(),
                address: renderAddress(),
            }}
            auditRevisions={auditRevisions}
            includeChangesTab={true}
        />
    );
}

export default QuotationDetailDrawer;

File: src/components/quotations/QuotationsMasterView.tsx

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Box, Chip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/RequestQuoteOutlined';
import DraftsOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/DraftsOutlined';
import SendOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/SendOutlined';
import CheckCircleOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined';
import CancelOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/CancelOutlined';
import ApartmentIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Apartment';
import PersonOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/PersonOutlined';

import { CommonMasterView } from '../common/CommonMasterView';
import { AppToast } from '../common/AppToast';
import type { DataTableColumn, DataTableFilterItem } from '../common/DataTable';
import { ROUTES } from '@/config/constants';
import type { Quotation } from '@/types/quotation.types';
import { quotationService, subscribeCrmSync } from '@/services';
import { QuotationDetailDrawer } from './QuotationDetailDrawer';

export type QuotationFilterTab = 'all' | 'draft' | 'sent' | 'accepted' | 'rejected';
export type QuotationSortField = 'quotationCode' | 'organizationName' | 'grandTotal' | 'quoteDate' | 'validUntil' | 'status';

const formatCurrency = (val: number = 0) =>
    new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
        style: 'currency',
        currency: 'INR',
        maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    }).format(val);

export function QuotationsMasterView() {
    const router = useRouter();

    const [quotations, setQuotations] = useState<Quotation[]>([]);
    const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<QuotationFilterTab>('all');
    const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(10);
    const [sortField, setSortField] = useState<QuotationSortField>('quotationCode');
    const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');
    const [selectedDrawerQuotation, setSelectedDrawerQuotation] = useState<Quotation | null>(null);
    const [toast, setToast] = useState<{
        open: boolean;
        message: string;
        severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'info' | 'warning';
    }>({
        open: false,
        message: '',
        severity: 'success',
    });

    const loadQuotations = useCallback(() => {
        const data = quotationService.getAllSync();
        setQuotations(data);
        setSelectedDrawerQuotation((prev) => {
            if (!prev) return null;
            return data.find((q) => q.id === prev.id) || null;
        });
    }, []);

    const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
        const quote = quotations.find((q) => q.id === id);
        const label = quote?.quotationCode ? `"${quote.quotationCode}"` : 'this quotation';
        if (!window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${label}?`)) return;

        await quotationService.delete(id);
        loadQuotations();
        if (selectedDrawerQuotation?.id === id) {
            setSelectedDrawerQuotation(null);
        }
        setToast({
            open: true,
            message: 'Quotation deleted successfully.',
            severity: 'success',
        });
    };

    const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
        if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;
        if (!window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${selectedIds.length} selected quotation(s)?`)) return;

        await quotationService.deleteBulk(selectedIds);
        setSelectedIds([]);
        loadQuotations();
        if (selectedDrawerQuotation && selectedIds.includes(selectedDrawerQuotation.id)) {
            setSelectedDrawerQuotation(null);
        }
        setToast({
            open: true,
            message: `${selectedIds.length} quotation(s) deleted successfully.`,
            severity: 'success',
        });
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        quotationService
            .getAll()
            .then((data) => {
                if (active) {
                    setQuotations(data);
                    setSelectedDrawerQuotation((prev) => {
                        if (!prev) return null;
                        return data.find((q) => q.id === prev.id) || null;
                    });
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {
                loadQuotations();
            });
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, [loadQuotations]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleFocus = () => {
            loadQuotations();
        };
        const handleVisibility = () => {
            if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
                loadQuotations();
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(loadQuotations);

        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
            document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
            unsubscribe();
        };
    }, [loadQuotations]);

    // ── Filter Tabs Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filterItems: DataTableFilterItem<QuotationFilterTab>[] = useMemo(() => {
        return [
            {
                id: 'all',
                label: 'All Quotations',
                icon: <RequestQuoteOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: quotations.length,
            },
            {
                id: 'draft',
                label: 'Draft',
                icon: <DraftsOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: quotations.filter((q) => q.status === 'Draft').length,
                activeColor: '#64748b',
            },
            {
                id: 'sent',
                label: 'Sent',
                icon: <SendOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: quotations.filter((q) => q.status === 'Sent').length,
                activeColor: '#2563eb',
            },
            {
                id: 'accepted',
                label: 'Accepted',
                icon: <CheckCircleOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: quotations.filter((q) => q.status === 'Accepted').length,
                activeColor: '#059669',
            },
            {
                id: 'rejected',
                label: 'Rejected',
                icon: <CancelOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 16 }} />,
                count: quotations.filter((q) => q.status === 'Rejected').length,
                activeColor: '#dc2626',
            },
        ];
    }, [quotations]);

    // ── Filtering Logic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const filteredQuotations = useMemo(() => {
        let result = [...quotations];

        if (activeTab === 'draft') {
            result = result.filter((q) => q.status === 'Draft');
        } else if (activeTab === 'sent') {
            result = result.filter((q) => q.status === 'Sent');
        } else if (activeTab === 'accepted') {
            result = result.filter((q) => q.status === 'Accepted');
        } else if (activeTab === 'rejected') {
            result = result.filter((q) => q.status === 'Rejected');
        }

        if (searchQuery.trim()) {
            const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
            result = result.filter(
                (item) =>
                    (item.quotationCode && item.quotationCode.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
                    (item.organizationName && item.organizationName.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
                    (item.contactName && item.contactName.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
                    (item.quotationTitle && item.quotationTitle.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
                    (item.quotationSubject && item.quotationSubject.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
                    (item.opportunityCode && item.opportunityCode.toLowerCase().includes(q))
            );
        }

        // Sorting
        result.sort((a, b) => {
            let valA: string | number = '';
            let valB: string | number = '';

            switch (sortField) {
                case 'quotationCode':
                    valA = a.quotationCode || '';
                    valB = b.quotationCode || '';
                    break;
                case 'organizationName':
                    valA = a.organizationName || '';
                    valB = b.organizationName || '';
                    break;
                case 'grandTotal':
                    valA = a.grandTotal || 0;
                    valB = b.grandTotal || 0;
                    break;
                case 'quoteDate':
                    valA = a.quoteDate || '';
                    valB = b.quoteDate || '';
                    break;
                case 'validUntil':
                    valA = a.validUntil || '';
                    valB = b.validUntil || '';
                    break;
                case 'status':
                    valA = a.status || '';
                    valB = b.status || '';
                    break;
                default:
                    valA = a.quotationCode || '';
                    valB = b.quotationCode || '';
            }

            if (typeof valA === 'number' && typeof valB === 'number') {
                return sortOrder === 'asc' ? valA - valB : valB - valA;
            }
            return sortOrder === 'asc'
                ? String(valA).localeCompare(String(valB))
                : String(valB).localeCompare(String(valA));
        });

        return result;
    }, [quotations, activeTab, searchQuery, sortField, sortOrder]);

    const paginatedQuotations = useMemo(() => {
        const start = page * rowsPerPage;
        return filteredQuotations.slice(start, start + rowsPerPage);
    }, [filteredQuotations, page, rowsPerPage]);

    // ── Columns ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const columns: DataTableColumn<Quotation>[] = useMemo(
        () => [
            {
                id: 'quotationCode',
                label: 'QUOTE CODE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 150,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.82rem',
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            color: '#1d4ed8',
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            '&:hover': { textDecoration: 'underline' },
                        }}
                    >
                        {row.quotationCode}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'quotationSubject',
                label: 'SUBJECT',
                sortable: false,
                minWidth: 220,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography
                        noWrap
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.8rem',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            color: '#1e293b',
                            maxWidth: 240,
                        }}
                        title={row.quotationSubject}
                    >
                        {row.quotationSubject || 'Quotation'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'organizationName',
                label: 'ORGANIZATION',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 200,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                        <ApartmentIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: '#64748b' }} />
                        <Typography
                            noWrap
                            sx={{
                                fontSize: '0.8rem',
                                fontWeight: 500,
                                color: '#334155',
                                maxWidth: 180,
                            }}
                        >
                            {row.organizationName}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'contactName',
                label: 'CONTACT PERSON',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 160,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0.8 }}>
                        <PersonOutlinedIcon sx={{ fontSize: 15, color: '#94a3b8' }} />
                        <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#475569' }}>
                            {row.contactName}
                        </Typography>
                    </Box>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'opportunityCode',
                label: 'OPPORTUNITY',
                sortable: false,
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography
                        sx={{
                            fontSize: '0.8rem',
                            fontWeight: 600,
                            color: '#2563eb',
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        }}
                    >
                        {row.opportunityCode || row.opportunityId || '-'}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'grandTotal',
                label: 'TOTAL AMOUNT',
                sortable: true,
                align: 'right',
                minWidth: 140,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                        {formatCurrency(row.grandTotal)}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'quoteDate',
                label: 'DATE',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 120,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {row.quoteDate}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'validUntil',
                label: 'VALID UNTIL',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 120,
                render: (row) => (
                    <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                        {row.validUntil}
                    </Typography>
                ),
            },
            {
                id: 'status',
                label: 'STATUS',
                sortable: true,
                minWidth: 110,
                render: (row) => {
                    const statusMap: Record<string, { bg: string; color: string; border: string }> = {
                        Draft: { bg: '#f1f5f9', color: '#475569', border: '#cbd5e1' },
                        Sent: { bg: '#eff6ff', color: '#1d4ed8', border: '#bfdbfe' },
                        Accepted: { bg: '#ecfdf5', color: '#047857', border: '#a7f3d0' },
                        Rejected: { bg: '#fef2f2', color: '#b91c1c', border: '#fecaca' },
                    };
                    const currentStatus = String(row.quoteStage || row.status || 'Draft');
                    const st = statusMap[currentStatus] || statusMap.Draft;

                    return (
                        <Chip
                            label={currentStatus}
                            size="small"
                            sx={{
                                backgroundColor: st.bg,
                                color: st.color,
                                border: `1px solid ${st.border}`,
                                fontWeight: 700,
                                fontSize: '0.72rem',
                                height: 22,
                            }}
                        />
                    );
                },
            },
        ],
        []
    );

    const handleSort = (field: string) => {
        const isAsc = sortField === field && sortOrder === 'asc';
        setSortOrder(isAsc ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        setSortField(field as QuotationSortField);
    };

    return (
        <CommonMasterView<Quotation, QuotationFilterTab>
            breadcrumbItems={[
                { label: 'Sales' },
                { label: 'Quotations' },
            ]}
            filterConfig={{
                filters: filterItems,
                activeFilter: activeTab,
                onFilterChange: (tab) => {
                    setActiveTab(tab);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                variant: 'pill',
            }}
            searchConfig={{
                searchQuery,
                onSearchChange: (q) => {
                    setSearchQuery(q);
                    setPage(0);
                },
                searchPlaceholder: 'Search by quote code, customer, subject...',
                // Strictly omit onNewClick so no standalone "New Quotation" button appears
                onRefresh: () => {
                    loadQuotations();
                    setToast({ open: true, message: 'Quotations refreshed.', severity: 'info' });
                },
                refreshTooltip: 'Refresh Quotations',
                selectedCount: selectedIds.length,
                onBulkDelete: handleBulkDelete,
            }}
            columns={columns}
            data={paginatedQuotations}
            keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
            selectedIds={selectedIds}
            onToggleSelectRow={(id) => {
                setSelectedIds((prev) =>
                    prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
                );
            }}
            onToggleSelectAll={(checked) => {
                if (checked) {
                    setSelectedIds(paginatedQuotations.map((q) => q.id));
                } else {
                    setSelectedIds([]);
                }
            }}
            sortField={sortField}
            sortOrder={sortOrder}
            onSort={handleSort}
            onView={(quote) => setSelectedDrawerQuotation(quote)}
            onEdit={(quote) => router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATION_EDIT(quote.id))}
            onDelete={(quote) => handleDelete(quote.id)}
            onRowClick={(quote) => setSelectedDrawerQuotation(quote)}
            activeRowId={selectedDrawerQuotation?.id}
            viewTooltip="View Quotation Details"
            editTooltip="Edit Quotation"
            deleteTooltip="Delete Quotation"
            // Strictly omit onEmptyAction and emptyActionLabel so no "+ New Quotation" button appears
            emptyTitle="No quotations found"
            emptyDescription="Quotations can be created directly from an Opportunity via the 'Create Quote' action."
            pagination={{
                page,
                rowsPerPage,
                totalCount: filteredQuotations.length,
                entityLabel: 'Quotations',
                pageSizeOptions: [10, 25, 50],
                onPageChange: (newPage) => setPage(newPage),
                onRowsPerPageChange: (newRows) => {
                    setRowsPerPage(newRows);
                    setPage(0);
                },
            }}
            drawer={
                <QuotationDetailDrawer
                    quotation={selectedDrawerQuotation}
                    open={Boolean(selectedDrawerQuotation)}
                    onClose={() => setSelectedDrawerQuotation(null)}
                    onEdit={(id) => router.push(ROUTES.QUOTATION_EDIT(id))}
                    onShowToast={(message, severity = 'success') => {
                        setToast({ open: true, message, severity });
                    }}
                />
            }
            isDrawerOpen={Boolean(selectedDrawerQuotation)}
            toast={
                <AppToast
                    open={toast.open}
                    message={toast.message}
                    severity={toast.severity}
                    onClose={() => setToast((prev) => ({ ...prev, open: false }))}
                />
            }
        />
    );
}

'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Box, Divider } from '@mui/material';
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
    SectionLabel,
    RhfTextField,
    RhfLookup,
    RhfAddressSection,
} from '@/components/forms';
import type { QuotationFormData } from '@/types/quotation.types';
import { organizationService, contactService } from '@/services';

const columnSx = { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.2 } as const;

export function QuotationAddressSection() {
    const { control, setValue } = useFormContext<QuotationFormData>();

    const organizationName = useWatch({ control, name: 'organizationName' });
    const contactName = useWatch({ control, name: 'contactName' });

    const prevOrgRef = useRef(organizationName);
    const prevContactRef = useRef(contactName);

    // Organization and Contact options from CRM services
    const orgOptions = useMemo(() => {
        try {
            return organizationService.getAllSync().map((o) => o.organizationName);
        } catch {
            return [];
        }
    }, []);

    const contactOptions = useMemo(() => {
        try {
            return contactService.getAllSync().map((c) => c.name);
        } catch {
            return [];
        }
    }, []);

    // ── When Organization changes, auto-fill mailingName, gstNo & addresses ─────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!organizationName || organizationName === prevOrgRef.current) return;
        prevOrgRef.current = organizationName;

        try {
            const org = organizationService
                .getAllSync()
                .find(
                    (o) =>
                        o.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() ===
                        organizationName.trim().toLowerCase()
                );

            if (org) {
                const opts = { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true } as const;
                if (org.mailingName) setValue('mailingName', org.mailingName, opts);
                if (org.gstNumber) setValue('gstNo', org.gstNumber, opts);

                if (org.billingStreet) setValue('billingAddress', org.billingStreet, opts);
                if (org.billingCity) setValue('billingCity', org.billingCity, opts);
                if (org.billingState) setValue('billingState', org.billingState, opts);
                if (org.billingPostalCode) setValue('billingPostalCode', org.billingPostalCode, opts);
                if (org.billingCountry) setValue('billingCountry', org.billingCountry, opts);

                if (org.shippingStreet) setValue('shippingAddress', org.shippingStreet, opts);
                if (org.shippingCity) setValue('shippingCity', org.shippingCity, opts);
                if (org.shippingState) setValue('shippingState', org.shippingState, opts);
                if (org.shippingPostalCode) setValue('shippingPostalCode', org.shippingPostalCode, opts);
                if (org.shippingCountry) setValue('shippingCountry', org.shippingCountry, opts);
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore lookups if service throws
        }
    }, [organizationName, setValue]);

    // ── When Contact changes, auto-fill mobile & email ──────────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!contactName || contactName === prevContactRef.current) return;
        prevContactRef.current = contactName;

        try {
            const contact = contactService
                .getAllSync()
                .find(
                    (c) =>
                        c.name.trim().toLowerCase() === contactName.trim().toLowerCase()
                );

            if (contact) {
                const opts = { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true } as const;
                if (contact.mobile) setValue('contactMobile', contact.mobile, opts);
                const email = contact.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email;
                if (email) setValue('contactEmail', email, opts);
            }
        } catch {
            // Ignore lookup errors
        }
    }, [contactName, setValue]);

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>
            {/* ── Top Section: Organization & Contact Header Grid ── */}
            <SectionLabel label="ACCOUNT & CONTACT CONTEXT" sx={{ mb: 3 }} />

            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'grid',
                    gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' },
                    gap: { xs: 2.5, md: 4 },
                    mb: 4,
                }}
            >
                {/* Left Column */}
                <Box sx={columnSx}>
                    <RhfLookup<QuotationFormData>
                        name="organizationName"
                        label="Organization"
                        options={orgOptions}
                        placeholder="Search or enter Organization..."
                        hint="Linked client organization"
                    />

                    <RhfLookup<QuotationFormData>
                        name="contactName"
                        label="Contact"
                        required
                        options={contactOptions}
                        placeholder="Search or enter Contact person..."
                        hint="Primary signatory or quote recipient"
                    />

                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="contactMobile"
                        label="Contact Mobile No"
                        type="tel"
                        placeholder="+91 98000 00000"
                        hint="Recipient direct phone / WhatsApp"
                    />
                </Box>

                {/* Right Column */}
                <Box sx={columnSx}>
                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="mailingName"
                        label="Mailing Name"
                        placeholder="Official organization legal name"
                        hint="As displayed on billing documents"
                    />

                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="gstNo"
                        label="GST NO"
                        placeholder="e.g. 07AAAAA0000A1Z5"
                        hint="Client GST Identification Number"
                    />

                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="contactEmail"
                        label="Contact Email Address"
                        type="email"
                        placeholder="contact@company.com"
                        hint="Dispatch address for quotation PDF"
                    />
                </Box>
            </Box>

            <Divider sx={{ my: 3.5, borderColor: '#f1f5f9' }} />

            {/* ── Bottom Section: Reusable Billing & Shipping Address Grid ── */}
            <RhfAddressSection<QuotationFormData>
                required
                billingTitle="BILLING ADDRESS"
                shippingTitle="SHIPPING ADDRESS"
                streetLabel="Street"
                shippingStreetLabel="Street"
                copyLabel="Copy address from left"
            />
        </Box>
    );
}

export default QuotationAddressSection;

================
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Box } from '@mui/material';
import { useFormContext, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form';

import {
    SectionLabel,
    RhfTextField,
    RhfSelect,
    RhfLookup,
} from '@/components/forms';
import {
    QUOTE_STAGES,
    QUOTE_COMPANIES,
    QUOTE_VALIDATION_PERIODS,
    QUOTE_TERMS_TEMPLATES,
    QUOTE_PAYMENT_TERMS,
    QUOTE_PREPARED_FOR_OPTIONS,
    TERMS_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTIONS,
    PAYMENT_TERMS_DESCRIPTIONS,
    type QuotationFormData,
} from '@/types/quotation.types';
import { LEAD_ASSIGNED_USERS } from '@/types/lead.types';

const columnSx = { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.2 } as const;

export function QuotationOverviewSection() {
    const { control, setValue, getValues } = useFormContext<QuotationFormData>();

    const quotationDate = useWatch({ control, name: 'quotationDate' });
    const validationPeriod = useWatch({ control, name: 'validationPeriod' });
    const termsAndCondition = useWatch({ control, name: 'termsAndCondition' });
    const paymentTerms = useWatch({ control, name: 'paymentTerms' });
    const organizationName = useWatch({ control, name: 'organizationName' });
    const contactName = useWatch({ control, name: 'contactName' });

    // Track previous values so we only overwrite descriptions when user changes the dropdown selection
    const prevTermsRef = useRef(termsAndCondition);
    const prevPaymentTermsRef = useRef(paymentTerms);

    // ── Auto-calculate validUntil from quotationDate + validationPeriod ──────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!quotationDate) return;
        const days = parseInt(validationPeriod || '30', 10) || 30;
        const baseDate = new Date(quotationDate);
        if (isNaN(baseDate.getTime())) return;

        baseDate.setDate(baseDate.getDate() + days);
        const yyyy = baseDate.getFullYear();
        const mm = String(baseDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        const dd = String(baseDate.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        const computedDate = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;

        if (getValues('validUntil') !== computedDate) {
            setValue('validUntil', computedDate, {
                shouldDirty: true,
                shouldValidate: true,
            });
        }
    }, [quotationDate, validationPeriod, getValues, setValue]);

    // ── Auto-populate Terms & Conditions Description template ────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (termsAndCondition && termsAndCondition !== prevTermsRef.current) {
            const template = TERMS_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTIONS[termsAndCondition];
            if (template) {
                setValue('termsAndConditionDescription', template, {
                    shouldDirty: true,
                    shouldValidate: true,
                });
            }
            prevTermsRef.current = termsAndCondition;
        }
    }, [termsAndCondition, setValue]);

    // ── Auto-populate Payment Terms Description template ─────────────────────────
    useEffect(() => {
        if (paymentTerms && paymentTerms !== prevPaymentTermsRef.current) {
            const template = PAYMENT_TERMS_DESCRIPTIONS[paymentTerms];
            if (template) {
                setValue('paymentTermsDescription', template, {
                    shouldDirty: true,
                    shouldValidate: true,
                });
            }
            prevPaymentTermsRef.current = paymentTerms;
        }
    }, [paymentTerms, setValue]);

    // ── Dynamic Prepared For Options ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    const preparedForOptions = useMemo(() => {
        const set = new Set<string>(QUOTE_PREPARED_FOR_OPTIONS);
        if (contactName) set.add(contactName);
        if (organizationName) set.add(organizationName);
        return Array.from(set);
    }, [contactName, organizationName]);

    return (
        <Box sx={{ p: { xs: 2.5, md: 3.5 } }}>
            <SectionLabel label="OVERVIEW" sx={{ mb: 3 }} />

            <Box
                sx={{
                    display: 'grid',
                    gridTemplateColumns: { xs: '1fr', md: '1fr 1fr' },
                    gap: { xs: 2.5, md: 4 },
                }}
            >
                {/* ── Left Column ── */}
                <Box sx={columnSx}>
                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="quotationTitle"
                        label="Quotation Title"
                        required
                        placeholder="e.g. B-Softwares Enterprise Deal"
                        hint="Primary quote identifier"
                    />

                    <RhfSelect<QuotationFormData>
                        name="quoteStage"
                        label="Quote Stage"
                        required
                        options={QUOTE_STAGES}
                        placeholder="Select Quote Stage"
                        hint="Default: Draft"
                    />

                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="quotationDate"
                        label="Quotation Date"
                        type="date"
                        required
                        slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }}
                    />

                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="validUntil"
                        label="Valid Until"
                        type="date"
                        required
                        slotProps={{ inputLabel: { shrink: true } }}
                        hint="Automatically computed from Quotation Date + Validation Period"
                    />

                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="remarks"
                        label="Remarks"
                        multiline
                        minRows={3}
                        maxRows={5}
                        placeholder="Internal or customer-facing quotation remarks..."
                    />

                    <RhfSelect<QuotationFormData>
                        name="termsAndCondition"
                        label="Terms & Condition"
                        required
                        options={QUOTE_TERMS_TEMPLATES}
                        placeholder="Select Terms Template"
                        hint="Auto-populates description template"
                    />

                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="termsAndConditionDescription"
                        label="Terms & Condition Description"
                        multiline
                        minRows={3}
                        maxRows={6}
                        placeholder="Detailed terms, commercial conditions, and delivery clauses..."
                    />

                    <RhfLookup<QuotationFormData>
                        name="assignedTo"
                        label="Assigned to"
                        required
                        options={LEAD_ASSIGNED_USERS}
                        placeholder="Select Assigned Representative"
                        hint="Representative managing this quotation"
                    />
                </Box>

                {/* ── Right Column ── */}
                <Box sx={columnSx}>
                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="opportunityName"
                        label="Opportunity"
                        required
                        disabled
                        hint="Parent Opportunity context"
                    />

                    <RhfSelect<QuotationFormData>
                        name="company"
                        label="Company"
                        required
                        options={QUOTE_COMPANIES}
                        placeholder="Select Issuing Company"
                        hint="Default: Nandini Infosystems"
                    />

                    <RhfSelect<QuotationFormData>
                        name="validationPeriod"
                        label="Validation Period"
                        required
                        options={QUOTE_VALIDATION_PERIODS}
                        placeholder="Select Period"
                        hint="Default: 30 Days"
                    />

                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="otherRef"
                        label="Other Ref."
                        placeholder="External PO, tender, or inquiry reference..."
                    />

                    {/* Spacer box to visually align Payment Terms with Terms & Condition in Left Column */}
                    <Box sx={{ minHeight: { xs: 0, md: 80 } }} />

                    <RhfSelect<QuotationFormData>
                        name="paymentTerms"
                        label="Payment Terms"
                        required
                        options={QUOTE_PAYMENT_TERMS}
                        placeholder="Select Payment Terms"
                        hint="Auto-populates payment description"
                    />

                    <RhfTextField<QuotationFormData>
                        name="paymentTermsDescription"
                        label="Payment Terms Description"
                        multiline
                        minRows={3}
                        maxRows={6}
                        placeholder="Milestone schedule, advance % and delivery breakdown..."
                    />

                    <RhfSelect<QuotationFormData>
                        name="preparedFor"
                        label="Prepared For"
                        required
                        options={preparedForOptions}
                        placeholder="Select Target Entity"
                        hint="Recipient role or linked contact/organization"
                    />
                </Box>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}

export default QuotationOverviewSection;

export const APP_CONFIG = {
    appName: 'Nandini Infosys CRM',

    ORGANIZATION_NEW: '/organizations/new',
    ORGANIZATION_DETAIL: (id: string | number) => `/organizations/${id}`,

================
File: src/context/AuthContext.tsx
================
"use client";

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { authService } from '../services/auth.service';
import type { User, LoginPayload } from '../types/auth.types';

interface AuthContextType {
    user: User | null;
    loading: boolean;
    error: string | null;
    isAuthenticated: boolean;
    login: (credentials: LoginPayload) => Promise<void>;
    logout: () => Promise<void>;
    refreshUser: () => Promise<void>;
    clearError: () => void;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

    const clearError = useCallback(() => {
        setError(null);
    }, []);

    const refreshUser = useCallback(async () => {
        try {
            const res = await authService.getMe();
            setUser(res.user);
            setError(null);
        } catch {
            setUser(null);
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        authService
            .getMe()
            .then((res) => {
                if (active) {
                    setUser(res.user);
                    setError(null);
                }
            })
            .catch(() => {
                if (active) {
                    setUser(null);
                }
            })
            .finally(() => {
                if (active) {
                    setLoading(false);
                }
            });
        return () => {
            active = false;
        };
    }, []);

    const login = async (credentials: LoginPayload) => {
        const res = await authService.login(credentials);
        setUser(res.user);
        setError(null);
    };

    const logout = async () => {
        try {
            await authService.logout();
        } finally {
            setUser(null);
            setError(null);
        }
    };

    return (
        <AuthContext.Provider
            value={{
                user,
                loading,
                error,
                isAuthenticated: !!user,
                login,
                logout,
                refreshUser,
                clearError,
            }}
        >
            {children}
        </AuthContext.Provider>
    );
}

export function useAuth(): AuthContextType {
    const context = useContext(AuthContext);
    if (!context) {
        throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
    }
    return context;
}

export function getStoredContacts(): Contact[] {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_MOCK_CONTACTS;
    try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(CONTACTS_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (raw) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
                return parsed.map((contact: Contact) => ({
                    ...contact,
                    mobile: contact.mobile ? contact.mobile.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10) : contact.mobile,
                    officePhone: contact.officePhone ? contact.officePhone.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10) : contact.officePhone,
                    phone3: contact.phone3 ? contact.phone3.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10) : contact.phone3,
                    phone4: contact.phone4 ? contact.phone4.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10) : contact.phone4,
                    phone5: contact.phone5 ? contact.phone5.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10) : contact.phone5,
                }));
            }
        }
        localStorage.setItem(CONTACTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_MOCK_CONTACTS));
        return INITIAL_MOCK_CONTACTS;
    } catch {
        return INITIAL_MOCK_CONTACTS;
    }
}

export function saveStoredContacts(contacts: Contact[]): void {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(CONTACTS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(contacts));
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to save contacts to localStorage', e);
    }
}

export function getStoredContactById(id: string): Contact | undefined {
    const list = getStoredContacts();
    return list.find((contact) => contact.id === id);
}

export function addStoredContact(data: ContactFormData): Contact {
    const list = getStoredContacts();
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const newContact: Contact = {
        ...data,
        id: `contact-${Date.now()}`,
        contactCode: `CON-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`,
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
        createdBy: data.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
    };
    const updatedList = [newContact, ...list];
    saveStoredContacts(updatedList);
    return newContact;
}

export function updateStoredContact(id: string, updates: Partial<ContactFormData>): Contact | null {
    const list = getStoredContacts();
    const idx = list.findIndex((contact) => contact.id === id);
    if (idx === -1) return null;
    const updated: Contact = {
        ...list[idx],
        ...updates,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    list[idx] = updated;
    saveStoredContacts(list);
    return updated;
}

export function deleteStoredContact(id: string): boolean {
    const list = getStoredContacts();
    const filtered = list.filter((contact) => contact.id !== id);
    if (filtered.length !== list.length) {
        saveStoredContacts(filtered);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

export function deleteMultipleStoredContacts(ids: string[]): boolean {
    const idSet = new Set(ids);
    const list = getStoredContacts();
    const filtered = list.filter((contact) => !idSet.has(contact.id));
    saveStoredContacts(filtered);
    return true;
}

const LEADS_STORAGE_KEY = 'nandini_crm_leads_data_v1';

export function getStoredLeads(): Lead[] {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_MOCK_LEADS;
    try {
        const item = localStorage.getItem(LEADS_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (!item) {
            localStorage.setItem(LEADS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_MOCK_LEADS));
            return INITIAL_MOCK_LEADS;
        }
        const parsed = JSON.parse(item);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
            const sanitized = parsed.map((lead: Lead) => ({
                ...lead,
                mobile: lead.mobile ? lead.mobile.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10) : lead.mobile,
                otherPhone: lead.otherPhone ? lead.otherPhone.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-10) : lead.otherPhone,
            }));
            const hasLea1009 = sanitized.some((l: Lead) => l.id === 'lea-1009');
            if (!hasLea1009) {
                const leadWithoutOrg = INITIAL_MOCK_LEADS.find((l) => l.id === 'lea-1009');
                if (leadWithoutOrg) {
                    const updated = [...sanitized, leadWithoutOrg];
                    localStorage.setItem(LEADS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
                    return updated;
                }
            }
            return sanitized;
        }
    } catch {
        // Fallback to initial seeds
    }
    return INITIAL_MOCK_LEADS;
}

export function saveStoredLeads(leads: Lead[]) {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(LEADS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(leads));
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to save leads to localStorage', e);
    }
}

export function getStoredLeadById(id: string): Lead | undefined {
    const list = getStoredLeads();
    return list.find((lead) => lead.id === id);
}

export function addStoredLead(data: LeadFormData): Lead {
    const list = getStoredLeads();
    const nextSeq = list.length + 1001;
    const newLead: Lead = {
        ...data,
        id: `lea-${nextSeq}`,
        leadCode: `LEA-${nextSeq}`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        createdBy: data.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
    };
    const updatedList = [newLead, ...list];
    saveStoredLeads(updatedList);
    return newLead;
}

export function updateStoredLead(id: string, updates: Partial<LeadFormData>): Lead | null {
    const list = getStoredLeads();
    const idx = list.findIndex((lead) => lead.id === id);
    if (idx === -1) return null;
    const updated: Lead = {
        ...list[idx],
        ...updates,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    list[idx] = updated;
    saveStoredLeads(list);
    return updated;
}

export function deleteStoredLead(id: string): boolean {
    const list = getStoredLeads();
    const filtered = list.filter((lead) => lead.id !== id);
    if (filtered.length !== list.length) {
        saveStoredLeads(filtered);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

export function deleteMultipleStoredLeads(ids: string[]): boolean {
    const idSet = new Set(ids);
    const list = getStoredLeads();
    const filtered = list.filter((lead) => !idSet.has(lead.id));
    saveStoredLeads(filtered);
    return true;
}

const OPPORTUNITIES_STORAGE_KEY = 'nandini_crm_opportunities_data_v1';

export function getStoredOpportunities(): Opportunity[] {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_MOCK_OPPORTUNITIES;
    try {
        const item = localStorage.getItem(OPPORTUNITIES_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (!item) {
            localStorage.setItem(OPPORTUNITIES_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_MOCK_OPPORTUNITIES));
            return INITIAL_MOCK_OPPORTUNITIES;
        }
        const parsed = JSON.parse(item);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
            return parsed;
        }
    } catch {
        // Fallback
    }
    return INITIAL_MOCK_OPPORTUNITIES;
}

export function saveStoredOpportunities(opps: Opportunity[]) {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(OPPORTUNITIES_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(opps));
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to save opportunities to localStorage', e);
    }
}

export function getStoredOpportunityById(id: string): Opportunity | undefined {
    const list = getStoredOpportunities();
    return list.find((opp) => opp.id === id);
}

export function addStoredOpportunity(data: OpportunityFormData): Opportunity {
    const list = getStoredOpportunities();
    const nextSeq = list.length + 1001;
    const newOpp: Opportunity = {
        ...data,
        id: `opp-${nextSeq}`,
        opportunityCode: `OPP-${nextSeq}`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        createdBy: data.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',
    };
    const updatedList = [newOpp, ...list];
    saveStoredOpportunities(updatedList);
    return newOpp;
}

export function updateStoredOpportunity(id: string, updates: Partial<OpportunityFormData>): Opportunity | null {
    const list = getStoredOpportunities();
    const idx = list.findIndex((opp) => opp.id === id);
    if (idx === -1) return null;
    const updated: Opportunity = {
        ...list[idx],
        ...updates,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    list[idx] = updated;
    saveStoredOpportunities(list);
    return updated;
}

export function deleteStoredOpportunity(id: string): boolean {
    const list = getStoredOpportunities();
    const filtered = list.filter((opp) => opp.id !== id);
    if (filtered.length !== list.length) {
        saveStoredOpportunities(filtered);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

export function deleteMultipleStoredOpportunities(ids: string[]): boolean {
    const idSet = new Set(ids);
    const list = getStoredOpportunities();
    const filtered = list.filter((opp) => !idSet.has(opp.id));
    saveStoredOpportunities(filtered);
    return true;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'nandini_crm_organizations_data_v1';

export function getStoredOrganizations(): ExtendedOrganization[] {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_MOCK_ORGANIZATIONS;
    try {
        const item = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (!item) {
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_MOCK_ORGANIZATIONS));
            return INITIAL_MOCK_ORGANIZATIONS;
        }
        const parsed = JSON.parse(item);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
            return parsed;
        }
    } catch {
        // Fallback
    }
    return INITIAL_MOCK_ORGANIZATIONS;
}

export function saveStoredOrganizations(orgs: ExtendedOrganization[]) {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(orgs));
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Failed to save organizations to localStorage', e);
    }
}

================
File: src/services/apiClient.ts
================
import { ENV } from '../config/env';
import type { ApiError, PaginationParams } from '../types/api.types';

export interface RequestOptions extends RequestInit {
    params?: PaginationParams;
}

export type RequestInterceptor = (
    url: string,
    options: RequestInit
) => Promise<{ url: string; options: RequestInit }> | { url: string; options: RequestInit };

export type ResponseInterceptor = (response: Response) => Promise<Response> | Response;

export type ErrorInterceptor = (error: ApiClientError) => Promise<never> | never;

export class ApiClientError extends Error {
    public readonly status?: number;
    public readonly details?: ApiError;

    constructor(message: string, status?: number, details?: ApiError) {
        super(message);
        this.name = 'ApiClientError';
        this.status = status;
        this.details = details;
    }
}

export function normalizeApiError(error: unknown, fallbackStatus?: number): ApiClientError {
    if (error instanceof ApiClientError) {
        return error;
    }
    if (error instanceof Error) {
        return new ApiClientError(error.message || 'Network or client error occurred.', fallbackStatus, {
            message: error.message || 'Network or client error occurred.',
            status: fallbackStatus,
        });
    }
    return new ApiClientError('An unexpected error occurred.', fallbackStatus, {
        message: 'An unexpected error occurred.',
        status: fallbackStatus,
    });
}

const requestInterceptors: RequestInterceptor[] = [
    (url, options) => {
        const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
        if (!headers.has('Accept')) {
            headers.set('Accept', 'application/json');
        }
        if (!headers.has('Content-Type') && options.body && !(options.body instanceof FormData)) {
            headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        }
        return {
            url,
            options: {
                ...options,
                headers,
                credentials: options.credentials ?? 'include',
            },
        };
    },
];

const responseInterceptors: ResponseInterceptor[] = [];
const errorInterceptors: ErrorInterceptor[] = [];

function buildUrl(endpoint: string, params?: PaginationParams): string {
    const cleanEndpoint = endpoint.startsWith('/') ? endpoint : `/${endpoint}`;
    const base = `${ENV.API_URL}${cleanEndpoint}`;
    if (!params) return base;

    const qs = new URLSearchParams();
    Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
        if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') {
            qs.set(key, String(value));
        }
    });
    const queryString = qs.toString();
    if (!queryString) return base;
    return base.includes('?') ? `${base}&${queryString}` : `${base}?${queryString}`;
}

async function request<T>(endpoint: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
    const { params, ...fetchInit } = options;
    let currentUrl = buildUrl(endpoint, params);
    let currentOptions: RequestInit = fetchInit;

    try {
        for (const interceptor of requestInterceptors) {
            const next = await interceptor(currentUrl, currentOptions);
            currentUrl = next.url;
            currentOptions = next.options;
        }

        let response = await fetch(currentUrl, currentOptions);

        for (const interceptor of responseInterceptors) {
            response = await interceptor(response);
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
            let errorData: ApiError;
            try {
                errorData = await response.json();
            } catch {
                errorData = {
                    message: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`,
                    status: response.status,
                };
            }
            throw new ApiClientError(
                errorData.message || 'An unexpected error occurred.',
                response.status,
                { ...errorData, status: response.status }
            );
        }

        if (response.status === 204) {
            return undefined as T;
        }

        return (await response.json()) as T;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
        const normalized = normalizeApiError(err);
        for (const onError of errorInterceptors) {
            await onError(normalized);
        }
        throw normalized;
    }
}

export const apiClient = {
    interceptors: {
        request: {
            use: (fn: RequestInterceptor) => {
                requestInterceptors.push(fn);
            },
        },
        response: {
            use: (onFulfilled: ResponseInterceptor, onRejected?: ErrorInterceptor) => {
                responseInterceptors.push(onFulfilled);
                if (onRejected) {
                    errorInterceptors.push(onRejected);
                }
            },
        },
    },

    get: <T>(endpoint: string, options?: RequestOptions) =>
        request<T>(endpoint, { ...options, method: 'GET' }),

    post: <T>(endpoint: string, body?: unknown, options?: RequestOptions) =>
        request<T>(endpoint, {
            ...options,
            method: 'POST',
            body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
        }),

    put: <T>(endpoint: string, body?: unknown, options?: RequestOptions) =>
        request<T>(endpoint, {
            ...options,
            method: 'PUT',
            body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
        }),

    patch: <T>(endpoint: string, body?: unknown, options?: RequestOptions) =>
        request<T>(endpoint, {
            ...options,
            method: 'PATCH',
            body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
        }),

    delete: <T>(endpoint: string, options?: RequestOptions) =>
        request<T>(endpoint, { ...options, method: 'DELETE' }),
};

import { apiClient } from './apiClient';
import type { LoginPayload } from '../types/auth.types';
import type { AuthResponse, LogoutResponse } from '../types/api.types';

export const authService = {
    login: (payload: LoginPayload): Promise<AuthResponse> => {
        return apiClient.post<AuthResponse>('/api/auth/login', payload);
    },

    getMe: (): Promise<AuthResponse> => {
        return apiClient.get<AuthResponse>('/api/auth/me');
    },

    logout: (): Promise<LogoutResponse> => {
        return apiClient.post<LogoutResponse>('/api/auth/logout');
    },
};

File: src/services/base.service.ts
