import { ENV } from '../config/env';
import type { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse, PaginationParams } from '../types/api.types';
import { apiClient } from './apiClient';
import { notifyCrmUpdate } from './crmSync';

export interface CrudMockAdapter<T, CreateDto, UpdateDto> {
    getAll: () => T[];
    getById: (id: string) => T | undefined;
    create: (data: CreateDto) => T;
    update: (id: string, data: UpdateDto) => T | null;
    delete: (id: string) => boolean;
    deleteBulk: (ids: string[]) => boolean;
    saveAll?: (items: T[]) => void;
}

export interface CrudService<T, CreateDto = Partial<T>, UpdateDto = Partial<CreateDto>> {
    readonly endpoint: string;
    list: (params?: PaginationParams) => Promise<PaginatedResponse<T>>;
    getAll: (params?: PaginationParams) => Promise<T[]>;
    getById: (id: string) => Promise<T | undefined>;
    create: (data: CreateDto) => Promise<T>;
    update: (id: string, data: UpdateDto) => Promise<T | null>;
    delete: (id: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    deleteBulk: (ids: string[]) => Promise<boolean>;
    getAllSync: () => T[];
    getByIdSync: (id: string) => T | undefined;
    saveAllSync: (items: T[]) => void;
}

export function createCrudService<T, CreateDto = Partial<T>, UpdateDto = Partial<CreateDto>>(
    endpoint: string,
    mockAdapter?: CrudMockAdapter<T, CreateDto, UpdateDto>
): CrudService<T, CreateDto, UpdateDto> {
    const cleanEndpoint = endpoint.startsWith('/') ? endpoint : `/${endpoint}`;

    return {
        endpoint: cleanEndpoint,

        list: async (params?: PaginationParams): Promise<PaginatedResponse<T>> => {
            if (ENV.USE_MOCK && mockAdapter) {
                const all = mockAdapter.getAll();
                const page = Number(params?.page ?? 1);
                const limit = Number(params?.limit ?? (all.length || 25));
                const start = (page - 1) * limit;
                const data = all.slice(start, start + limit);
                return {
                    success: true,
                    data,
                    total: all.length,
                    page,
                    limit,
                };
            }

            try {
                return await apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<T>>(cleanEndpoint, { params });
            } catch (err) {
                if (mockAdapter) {
                    const all = mockAdapter.getAll();
                    return {
                        success: true,
                        data: all,
                        total: all.length,
                        page: Number(params?.page ?? 1),
                        limit: Number(params?.limit ?? (all.length || 25)),
                    };
                }
                throw err;
            }
        },

        getAll: async (params?: PaginationParams): Promise<T[]> => {
            if (ENV.USE_MOCK && mockAdapter) {
                return mockAdapter.getAll();
            }

            try {
                const res = await apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<T> | ApiResponse<T[]> | T[]>(
                    cleanEndpoint,
                    { params }
                );
                if (Array.isArray(res)) return res;
                return res.data;
            } catch (err) {
                if (mockAdapter) return mockAdapter.getAll();
                throw err;
            }
        },

        getById: async (id: string): Promise<T | undefined> => {
            if (ENV.USE_MOCK && mockAdapter) {
                return mockAdapter.getById(id);
            }

            try {
                const res = await apiClient.get<ApiResponse<T> | T>(`${cleanEndpoint}/${id}`);
                if (res && typeof res === 'object' && 'data' in res) {
                    return (res as ApiResponse<T>).data;
                }
                return res as T;
            } catch (err) {
                if (mockAdapter) return mockAdapter.getById(id);
                throw err;
            }
        },

        create: async (data: CreateDto): Promise<T> => {
            if (ENV.USE_MOCK && mockAdapter) {
                const res = mockAdapter.create(data);
                notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint);
                return res;
            }

            try {
                const res = await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<T> | T>(cleanEndpoint, data);
                const created =
                    res && typeof res === 'object' && 'data' in res
                        ? (res as ApiResponse<T>).data
                        : (res as T);
                if (mockAdapter?.saveAll) {
                    const existing = mockAdapter.getAll();
                    mockAdapter.saveAll([created, ...existing]);
                }
                notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint);
                return created;
            } catch (err) {
                if (mockAdapter) {
                    const res = mockAdapter.create(data);
                    notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint);
                    return res;
                }
                throw err;
            }
        },

        update: async (id: string, data: UpdateDto): Promise<T | null> => {
            if (ENV.USE_MOCK && mockAdapter) {
                const res = mockAdapter.update(id, data);
                notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint, id);
                return res;
            }

            try {
                const res = await apiClient.put<ApiResponse<T> | T>(`${cleanEndpoint}/${id}`, data);
                const updated =
                    res && typeof res === 'object' && 'data' in res
                        ? (res as ApiResponse<T>).data
                        : (res as T);
                if (mockAdapter) {
                    mockAdapter.update(id, data);
                }
                notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint, id);
                return updated;
            } catch (err) {
                if (mockAdapter) {
                    const res = mockAdapter.update(id, data);
                    notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint, id);
                    return res;
                }
                throw err;
            }
        },

        delete: async (id: string): Promise<boolean> => {
            if (ENV.USE_MOCK && mockAdapter) {
                const res = mockAdapter.delete(id);
                notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint, id);
                return res;
            }

            try {
                await apiClient.delete<ApiResponse<unknown>>(`${cleanEndpoint}/${id}`);
                if (mockAdapter) {
                    mockAdapter.delete(id);
                }
                notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint, id);
                return true;
            } catch (err) {
                if (mockAdapter) {
                    const res = mockAdapter.delete(id);
                    notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint, id);
                    return res;
                }
                throw err;
            }
        },

        deleteBulk: async (ids: string[]): Promise<boolean> => {
            if (ENV.USE_MOCK && mockAdapter) {
                const res = mockAdapter.deleteBulk(ids);
                notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint);
                return res;
            }

            try {
                await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<unknown>>(`${cleanEndpoint}/bulk-delete`, { ids });
                if (mockAdapter) {
                    mockAdapter.deleteBulk(ids);
                }
                notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint);
                return true;
            } catch (err) {
                if (mockAdapter) {
                    const res = mockAdapter.deleteBulk(ids);
                    notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint);
                    return res;
                }
                throw err;
            }
        },

        getAllSync: (): T[] => {
            return mockAdapter ? mockAdapter.getAll() : [];
        },

        getByIdSync: (id: string): T | undefined => {
            return mockAdapter ? mockAdapter.getById(id) : undefined;
        },

        saveAllSync: (items: T[]): void => {
            mockAdapter?.saveAll?.(items);
            notifyCrmUpdate(cleanEndpoint);
        },
    };
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

/**
 * Global CRM Synchronization Service & Hooks
 *
 * Provides reactive event broadcasting and window/tab focus synchronization
 * across all master views, side drawers, and detail pages in the CRM.
 */

export const CRM_SYNC_EVENT = 'crm:data-updated';
export const CRM_SYNC_CHANNEL_NAME = 'crm_sync_channel';

export interface CrmSyncEventDetail {
    entity?: string;
    id?: string;
    timestamp: number;
}

// Global broadcast channel for immediate multi-tab synchronization
let syncChannel: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'BroadcastChannel' in window) {
    try {
        syncChannel = new BroadcastChannel(CRM_SYNC_CHANNEL_NAME);
    } catch {
        syncChannel = null;
    }
}

/**
 * Dispatches a global notification indicating that a CRM record was created,
 * updated, or deleted. Automatically alerts all open drawers, master views,
 * and background tabs.
 */
export function notifyCrmUpdate(entity?: string, id?: string): void {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    const detail: CrmSyncEventDetail = {
        entity,
        id,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
    };

    try {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(CRM_SYNC_EVENT, { detail }));
    } catch {
        // Fallback for environments where CustomEvent might fail
    }

    try {
        syncChannel?.postMessage(detail);
    } catch {
        // Fallback if BroadcastChannel was closed or failed
    }
}

/**
 * Subscribes to window focus, document visibility change, cross-tab storage updates,
 * local CRM sync events, and BroadcastChannel messages.
 * Debounces calls to prevent rapid duplicate re-renders.
 */
export function subscribeCrmSync(onSync: () => void, debounceMs = 50): () => void {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
        return () => {};
    }

    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

    const triggerSync = () => {
        if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = setTimeout(() => {
            onSync();
        }, debounceMs);
    };

    const handleFocus = () => {
        triggerSync();
    };

    const handleVisibility = () => {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
            triggerSync();
        }
    };

    const handleStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
        // Check for any CRM-related key changes
        if (
            !e.key ||
            e.key.includes('crm') ||
            e.key.includes('org') ||
            e.key.includes('lead') ||
            e.key.includes('opp') ||
            e.key.includes('quote') ||
            e.key.includes('contact') ||
            e.key.includes('product')
        ) {
            triggerSync();
        }
    };

    const handleCustomEvent = () => {
        triggerSync();
    };

    window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    window.addEventListener(CRM_SYNC_EVENT, handleCustomEvent);

    let channelListener: ((ev: MessageEvent) => void) | null = null;
    if (syncChannel) {
        channelListener = () => triggerSync();
        syncChannel.addEventListener('message', channelListener);
    }

    return () => {
        if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
        document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility);
        window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
        window.removeEventListener(CRM_SYNC_EVENT, handleCustomEvent);
        if (syncChannel && channelListener) {
            syncChannel.removeEventListener('message', channelListener);
        }
    };
}

/**
 * React hook that triggers a re-fetch or re-evaluation whenever the browser
 * gains focus, the tab becomes visible, or any CRM entity is updated.
 */
export function useCrmSync(callback: () => void, deps: React.DependencyList = []): void {
    const callbackRef = useRef(callback);
    callbackRef.current = callback;

    useEffect(() => {
        const unsubscribe = subscribeCrmSync(() => {
            callbackRef.current();
        });
        return unsubscribe;
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, deps);
}

import type { Lead } from '../types/lead.types';

    CustomerType,
    SourceOfLead,
} from '../types/organization.types';

export interface LeadConversionResult {
    organization: ExtendedOrganization;
    contact: Contact;
    opportunity: Opportunity;
    organizationCreated: boolean;
    contactCreated: boolean;
}

const normalize = (value?: string) => (value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
const digits = (value?: string) => (value ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '');

/** Finds an existing organization by explicit id or case-insensitive name. */
export function findExistingOrganization(name: string, id?: string): ExtendedOrganization | undefined {
    const all = organizationService.getAllSync();
    if (id) {
        const byId = all.find((o) => o.id === id);
        if (byId) return byId;
    }
    const target = normalize(name);
    return target ? all.find((o) => normalize(o.organizationName) === target) : undefined;
}

/** Finds an existing contact by explicit id or by matching mobile number. */
export function findExistingContact(mobile: string, id?: string): Contact | undefined {
    const all = contactService.getAllSync();
    if (id) {
        const byId = all.find((c) => c.id === id);
        if (byId) return byId;
    }
    const target = digits(mobile);
    return target ? all.find((c) => digits(c.mobile) === target) : undefined;
}

/** Maps a lead onto the initial values of the Convert Lead form. */
export function buildConvertLeadDefaults(lead: Lead): ConvertLeadFormValues {
    return {
        existingOrganizationId: '',
        organizationName: lead.organizationName ?? '',
        mailingName: lead.mailingName ?? '',
        natureOfBusiness: '',
        typeOfEntity: '',
        customerType: '',
        sourceOfLead: lead.leadSource ?? '',
        memberOf: '',
        organizationDescription: '',
        organizationAssignedTo: lead.assignedTo,

        existingContactId: '',
        contactName: lead.name,
        contactMobile: lead.mobile,
        contactPhone3: lead.otherPhone ?? '',
        contactEmails: lead.emailAddresses?.length
            ? lead.emailAddresses
            : [{ id: 'eml-1', email: '', isPrimary: true, isOptedOut: false, isInvalidBounce: false }],
        isPrimaryContact: true,
        designation: lead.designation ?? '',
        department: lead.department ?? '',
        location: lead.primaryCity ?? '',
        communicationType: ['Call', 'Email'],
        doNotCall: false,
        contactDescription: '',
        contactAssignedTo: lead.assignedTo,

        productCategory: lead.productCategory ?? [],
        principalCompany: '',
        referredBy: lead.referredBy ?? '',
        opportunityType: 'New Business',
        nextFollowupDate: lead.nextFollowupDate,
        nextFollowupTime: lead.nextFollowupTime ?? '',
        followupType: lead.followupType ?? '',
        opportunityDescription: lead.addDescription ?? '',
        opportunityLeadSource: lead.leadSource ?? '',
        opportunityAssignedTo: lead.assignedTo,
        copyActivitiesTo: [],
    };
}

function toOrganizationPayload(v: ConvertLeadFormValues, lead: Lead): OrganizationFormData {
    return {
        organizationName: v.organizationName,
        mailingName: v.mailingName ?? '',
        natureOfBusiness: v.natureOfBusiness as NatureOfBusiness,
        accountStatus: 'Active',
        typeOfEntity: v.typeOfEntity as TypeOfEntity,
        customerType: v.customerType as CustomerType,
        sapCodeTallyId: '',
        showroomBranchCode: '',
        sourceOfLead: (v.sourceOfLead ?? '') as SourceOfLead | '',
        memberOfParentCorp: v.memberOf ?? '',
        numberOfEmployees: '',
        annualTurnover: '',
        description: v.organizationDescription ?? '',
        accountVerified: false,
        provideSupport: 'No',
        corporateEmails: [],
        billingStreet: lead.primaryAddress,
        billingCity: lead.primaryCity,
        billingState: lead.primaryState,
        billingPostalCode: lead.primaryPostalCode,
        billingCountry: lead.primaryCountry,
        registrationType: lead.registrationType,
        partnerCompanies: [],
    };
}

function toContactPayload(
    v: ConvertLeadFormValues,
    organization: ExtendedOrganization
): ContactFormData {
    return {
        name: v.contactName,
        organizationName: organization.organizationName,
        organizationId: organization.id,
        mobile: v.contactMobile,
        officePhone: '',
        phone3: v.contactPhone3 ?? '',
        phone4: '',
        phone5: '',
        emailAddresses: v.contactEmails,
        assignedTo: v.contactAssignedTo,
        isPrimaryContact: v.isPrimaryContact,
        designation: v.designation ?? '',
        department: v.department ?? '',
        location: v.location ?? '',
        leftJob: 'No',
        communicationType: v.communicationType,
        doNotCall: v.doNotCall,
        description: v.contactDescription ?? '',
    };
}

function toOpportunityPayload(
    v: ConvertLeadFormValues,
    organization: ExtendedOrganization,
    contact: Contact
): OpportunityFormData {
    const primaryEmail = v.contactEmails.find((e) => e.isPrimary && e.email) ?? v.contactEmails.find((e) => e.email);
    return {
        productCategory: v.productCategory,
        contactName: contact.name,
        contactId: contact.id,
        organizationName: organization.organizationName,
        organizationId: organization.id,
        contactNumber: contact.mobile,
        emailAddress: primaryEmail?.email,
        referredBy: v.referredBy,
        type: v.opportunityType,
        salesStage: 'Qualification',
        leadSource: v.opportunityLeadSource,
        leadGivenBy: v.principalCompany || v.referredBy || '',
        nextFollowupDate: v.nextFollowupDate,
        nextFollowupTime: v.nextFollowupTime,
        followupType: v.followupType ?? '',
        addDescription: v.opportunityDescription ?? '',
        description: v.opportunityDescription,
        assignedTo: v.opportunityAssignedTo,
        commission: 'Nil / Direct (0%)',
        currency: 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
        groupName: '',
        lineItems: [],
        lumpSumDiscount: 0,
        totalAmount: 0,
        totalDiscount: 0,
        subtotal: 0,
        totalTax: 0,
        grandTotal: 0,
    };
}

/**
 * Orchestrates a lead conversion: reuses or creates the Organization and Contact, creates the
 * Opportunity linked to both, and finally marks the lead as `Converted`.
 */
export async function convertLead(
    leadId: string,
    values: ConvertLeadFormValues
): Promise<LeadConversionResult> {
    const lead = await leadService.getById(leadId);
    if (!lead) throw new Error('Lead not found.');
    if (lead.status === 'Converted') throw new Error('This lead has already been converted.');

    let organization = findExistingOrganization(values.organizationName, values.existingOrganizationId);
    const organizationCreated = !organization;
    if (!organization) {
        organization = (await organizationService.create(toOrganizationPayload(values, lead))) as ExtendedOrganization;
    }

    let contact = findExistingContact(values.contactMobile, values.existingContactId);
    const contactCreated = !contact;
    if (!contact) {
        contact = await contactService.create(toContactPayload(values, organization));
    }

    const opportunity = await opportunityService.create(toOpportunityPayload(values, organization, contact));
    await leadService.update(leadId, { status: 'Converted' });
    notifyCrmUpdate('leadConversion', leadId);

    return { organization, contact, opportunity, organizationCreated, contactCreated };
}

    ...baseOrganizationService,
    updateStatusBulk: (
        ids: Iterable<string>,
        status: ExtendedOrganization['accountStatus']
    ): ExtendedOrganization[] => {
        const idSet = new Set(ids);
        const nextOrgs = baseOrganizationService.getAllSync().map((org) =>
            idSet.has(org.id) ? { ...org, accountStatus: status } : org
        );
        baseOrganizationService.saveAllSync(nextOrgs);
        return nextOrgs;
    },
};

/**
 * Resolves an address for an opportunity either directly or via its linked organization.
 */
export function resolveOpportunityAddress(
    opportunity: Opportunity,
    organization?: ExtendedOrganization
): {
    hasCompleteAddress: boolean;
    billingStreet: string;
    billingCity: string;
    billingState: string;
    billingPostalCode: string;
    billingCountry: string;
    shippingStreet: string;
    shippingCity: string;
    shippingState: string;
    shippingPostalCode: string;
    shippingCountry: string;
} {
    const org =
        organization ||
        (opportunity.organizationId
            ? organizationService.getByIdSync(opportunity.organizationId)
            : organizationService
                  .getAllSync()
                  .find(
                      (o) =>
                          o.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase() ===
                          opportunity.organizationName.trim().toLowerCase()
                  ));

    const billingStreet = (org?.billingStreet || '').trim();
    const billingCity = (org?.billingCity || '').trim();
    const billingState = (org?.billingState || '').trim();
    const billingPostalCode = (org?.billingPostalCode || '').trim();
    const billingCountry = (org?.billingCountry || 'India').trim();

    const shippingStreet = (org?.shippingStreet || billingStreet).trim();
    const shippingCity = (org?.shippingCity || billingCity).trim();
    const shippingState = (org?.shippingState || billingState).trim();
    const shippingPostalCode = (org?.shippingPostalCode || billingPostalCode).trim();
    const shippingCountry = (org?.shippingCountry || billingCountry || 'India').trim();

    const hasCompleteAddress = Boolean(
        billingStreet && billingCity && billingState && billingPostalCode
    );

    return {
        hasCompleteAddress,
        billingStreet,
        billingCity,
        billingState,
        billingPostalCode,
        billingCountry,
        shippingStreet,
        shippingCity,
        shippingState,
        shippingPostalCode,
        shippingCountry,
    };
}

/**
 * Pre-populates Quotation form defaults from a source Opportunity and its linked Account/Contact.
 */
export function buildQuotationDefaultsFromOpportunity(
    opportunity: Opportunity,
    organization?: ExtendedOrganization,
    contact?: Contact
): QuotationFormData {
    const addr = resolveOpportunityAddress(opportunity, organization);
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const validityDate = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];

    const mappedLineItems: QuotationLineItem[] =
        opportunity.lineItems && opportunity.lineItems.length > 0
            ? opportunity.lineItems.map((item) => ({
                  id: item.id || `line-${Date.now()}`,
                  productId: item.productId || '',
                  productName: item.productName || '',
                  quantity: item.quantity || 1,
                  amount: item.amount || 0,
                  discount: item.discount || 0,
                  discountType: item.discountType || 'percentage',
                  salePrice: item.salePrice || item.amount || 0,
                  taxRate: item.taxRate || 'GST 18%',
                  taxAmount: item.taxAmount || 0,
                  total: item.total || 0,
                  description: item.description || '',
                  note: item.note || '',
              }))
            : [
                  {
                      id: `item-${Date.now()}`,
                      productId: '',
                      productName: 'TallyPrime Gold (Multi-User Enterprise)',
                      quantity: 1,
                      amount: 54000,
                      discount: 0,
                      discountType: 'percentage',
                      salePrice: 54000,
                      taxRate: 'GST 18%',
                      taxAmount: 9720,
                      total: 63720,
                      description: 'Standard enterprise package license',
                      note: '',
                  },
              ];

    const quoteTitle = opportunity.opportunityName || opportunity.organizationName || 'B-Softwares';

    return {
        // Tab 1: Overview
        quotationTitle: quoteTitle,
        quoteStage: 'Draft',
        quotationDate: today,
        validUntil: validityDate,
        remarks: opportunity.addDescription || '',
        termsAndCondition: 'Standard Terms & Conditions',
        termsAndConditionDescription: TERMS_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTIONS['Standard Terms & Conditions'],
        assignedTo: opportunity.assignedTo || 'mittal.sharma',

        opportunityName: quoteTitle,
        company: 'Nandini Infosystems',
        validationPeriod: '30 Days',
        otherRef: '',
        paymentTerms: '50% Advance & 50% on Delivery',
        paymentTermsDescription: PAYMENT_TERMS_DESCRIPTIONS['50% Advance & 50% on Delivery'],
        preparedFor: 'Customer',

        // Tab 2: Line Items
        currency: opportunity.currency || 'Indian Rupee: ₹',
        groupName: opportunity.groupName || 'Software Licenses & Add-ons',
        lineItems: mappedLineItems,
        lumpSumDiscount: opportunity.lumpSumDiscount || 0,
        totalAmount: opportunity.totalAmount || 0,
        totalDiscount: opportunity.totalDiscount || 0,
        subtotal: opportunity.subtotal || 0,
        totalTax: opportunity.totalTax || 0,
        grandTotal: opportunity.grandTotal || 0,

        // Tab 3: Address Information
        organizationName: opportunity.organizationName,
        organizationId: opportunity.organizationId || organization?.id,
        contactName: opportunity.contactName,
        contactId: opportunity.contactId || contact?.id,
        contactMobile: opportunity.contactNumber || contact?.mobile || '',
        mailingName: organization?.mailingName || opportunity.organizationName,
        gstNo: organization?.gstNumber || '',
        contactEmail: opportunity.emailAddress || contact?.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email || '',

        billingAddress: addr.billingStreet,
        billingCity: addr.billingCity,
        billingState: addr.billingState || 'Delhi',
        billingPostalCode: addr.billingPostalCode,
        billingCountry: addr.billingCountry || 'India',

        shippingAddress: addr.shippingStreet,
        shippingCity: addr.shippingCity,
        shippingState: addr.shippingState || 'Delhi',
        shippingPostalCode: addr.shippingPostalCode,
        shippingCountry: addr.shippingCountry || 'India',
        copyAddressFromBilling: true,

        // Aliases / Context
        opportunityId: opportunity.id,
        opportunityCode: opportunity.opportunityCode,
        status: 'Draft',
        quoteDate: today,
        quotationSubject: quoteTitle,
        contactNumber: opportunity.contactNumber || contact?.mobile || '',
        emailAddress: opportunity.emailAddress || contact?.emailAddresses?.[0]?.email || '',
        notes: opportunity.addDescription || '',
        termsAndConditions: TERMS_TEMPLATE_DESCRIPTIONS['Standard Terms & Conditions'],
    };
}

/**
 * Creates a quotation record from an opportunity and progresses the opportunity's sales stage.
 */
export async function createQuotationFromOpportunity(
    opportunityId: string,
    values: QuotationFormData
): Promise<Quotation> {
    const newQuote = await baseQuotationService.create(values);

    // Update opportunity stage to "Proposal/Price Quote" if not already closed
    try {
        const opp = await opportunityService.getById(opportunityId);
        if (
            opp &&
            opp.salesStage !== 'Closed Won' &&
            opp.salesStage !== 'Closed Lost' &&
            opp.salesStage !== 'Proposal/Price Quote'
        ) {
            await opportunityService.update(opportunityId, {
                salesStage: 'Proposal/Price Quote',
            });
        }
    } catch {
        // Non-blocking stage update
    }

    return newQuote;
}

export const quotationService = {
    ...baseQuotationService,
    getAllQuotations: baseQuotationService.getAllSync,
    getQuotationById: baseQuotationService.getByIdSync,
    createQuotation: baseQuotationService.create,
    updateQuotation: baseQuotationService.update,
    deleteQuotation: baseQuotationService.delete,
    bulkDeleteQuotations: baseQuotationService.deleteBulk,
    buildQuotationDefaultsFromOpportunity,
    createQuotationFromOpportunity,
    resolveOpportunityAddress,
};

import { z } from 'zod';

/**
 * Extracts the first human-readable validation error message from a ZodError
 * to display cleanly inside toast notifications.
 */
export function getZodErrorMessage(error: z.ZodError): string {
    if (error.issues && error.issues.length > 0) {
        return error.issues[0].message;
    }
    return 'Invalid form data. Please check required fields.';
}

/**
 * Walks a React Hook Form `FieldErrors` tree (including nested objects/arrays) and returns
 * the first human-readable message, for display in toast notifications.
 */
export function getFirstErrorMessage(errors: unknown): string | undefined {
    if (!errors || typeof errors !== 'object') return undefined;
    const node = errors as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof node.message === 'string' && node.message) return node.message;
    for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
        if (key === 'ref' || key === 'type') continue;
        const found = getFirstErrorMessage(node[key]);
        if (found) return found;
    }
    return undefined;
}

export type ValidationResult<T> =
    | { success: true; data: T }
    | { success: false; error: string };

/**
 * Safely validates form data using a Zod schema and extracts a single friendly
 * toast message if validation fails.
 */
export function validateWithToast<T>(
    schema: z.ZodType<T>,
    data: unknown
): ValidationResult<T> {
    const result = schema.safeParse(data);
    if (!result.success) {
        return {
            success: false,
            error: getZodErrorMessage(result.error),
        };
    }
    return {
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
    };
}

// ── Reusable Regex Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const PHONE_REGEX = /^\d{10}$/;
export const PIN_CODE_REGEX = /^\d{6}$/;
export const PAN_REGEX = /^[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{1}$/;
export const GST_REGEX = /^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{1}[1-9A-Z]{1}Z[0-9A-Z]{1}$/;
export const IFSC_REGEX = /^[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}$/;

// ── Reusable String Primitives ────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Non-empty trimmed string
export const requiredString = (fieldName: string) =>
    z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(1, { message: `${fieldName} is required.` });

// Optional trimmed string
export const optionalString = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

// ── Central DRY Zod Validation Dictionary ─────────────────────────────────────

/** Exactly 10 digits numeric phone */
export const zodPhone = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .regex(PHONE_REGEX, { message: 'Must be exactly 10 digits.' });

export const zodPhoneOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .refine((val) => !val || PHONE_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be exactly 10 digits.',
    })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

/** Exactly 6 digits Indian postal PIN code */
export const zodPinCode = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .regex(PIN_CODE_REGEX, { message: 'Must be exactly 6 digits.' });

export const zodPinCodeOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .refine((val) => !val || PIN_CODE_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be exactly 6 digits.',
    })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

/** 10-character Indian PAN format with auto toUpperCase */
export const zodPan = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => val.toUpperCase())
    .refine((val) => PAN_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 10-character Indian PAN (e.g. ABCDE1234F).',
    });

export const zodPanOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => (val ? val.toUpperCase() : ''))
    .refine((val) => !val || PAN_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 10-character Indian PAN (e.g. ABCDE1234F).',
    })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

/** 15-character GST format with auto toUpperCase */
export const zodGst = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => val.toUpperCase())
    .refine((val) => GST_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 15-character GSTIN (e.g. 07AAAAA0000A1Z5).',
    });

export const zodGstOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => (val ? val.toUpperCase() : ''))
    .refine((val) => !val || GST_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 15-character GSTIN (e.g. 07AAAAA0000A1Z5).',
    })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

/** 11-character Indian IFSC code with auto toUpperCase */
export const zodIfsc = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => val.toUpperCase())
    .refine((val) => IFSC_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 11-character IFSC code (e.g. SBIN0001234).',
    });

export const zodIfscOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .transform((val) => (val ? val.toUpperCase() : ''))
    .refine((val) => !val || IFSC_REGEX.test(val), {
        message: 'Must be a valid 11-character IFSC code (e.g. SBIN0001234).',
    })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

/** Standard email validation, trimmed, lowercased */
export const zodEmail = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .email({ message: 'Invalid email format.' })
    .toLowerCase();

export const zodEmailOptional = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .refine((val) => !val || z.string().email().safeParse(val).success, {
        message: 'Invalid email format.',
    })
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal(''));

/** Non-negative number coercion */
export const zodAmount = z.coerce
    .number({ invalid_type_error: 'Amount must be a number.' })
    .min(0, { message: 'Amount cannot be negative.' });

/** Number coercion between 0 and 100 */
export const zodPercentage = z.coerce
    .number({ invalid_type_error: 'Percentage must be a number.' })
    .min(0, { message: 'Percentage cannot be less than 0.' })
    .max(100, { message: 'Percentage cannot exceed 100.' });

// ── Aliases & Parameterized Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────

export const phoneSchema = (fieldName: string = 'Phone Number') =>
    z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .refine(
            (val) => !val || PHONE_REGEX.test(val),
            { message: `${fieldName} must be exactly 10 digits.` }
        );

export const requiredPhoneSchema = (fieldName: string = 'Phone Number') =>
    z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(1, { message: `${fieldName} is required.` })
        .regex(PHONE_REGEX, { message: `${fieldName} must be exactly 10 digits.` });

export const pinCodeSchema = zodPinCodeOptional;
export const requiredPinCodeSchema = (fieldName: string = 'Postal / PIN code') =>
    z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(1, { message: `${fieldName} is required.` })
        .regex(PIN_CODE_REGEX, { message: `${fieldName} must be exactly 6 digits.` });

export const emailPrimitive = zodEmail;
export const emailSchema = zodEmailOptional;
export const requiredEmailSchema = (fieldName: string = 'Email Address') =>
    z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(1, { message: `${fieldName} is required.` })
        .email({ message: 'Invalid email format.' })
        .toLowerCase();

export const panSchema = zodPanOptional;
export const requiredPanSchema = (fieldName: string = 'PAN Number') =>
    z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(1, { message: `${fieldName} is required.` })
        .transform((val) => val.toUpperCase())
        .refine((val) => PAN_REGEX.test(val), {
            message: `${fieldName} must be a valid 10-character Indian PAN (e.g. ABCDE1234F).`,
        });

export const gstSchema = zodGstOptional;
export const requiredGstSchema = (fieldName: string = 'GST Number') =>
    z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(1, { message: `${fieldName} is required.` })
        .transform((val) => val.toUpperCase())
        .refine((val) => GST_REGEX.test(val), {
            message: `${fieldName} must be a valid 15-character GSTIN (e.g. 07AAAAA0000A1Z5).`,
        });

export const urlSchema = z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .refine((val) => !val || z.string().url().safeParse(val).success, {
        message: 'Please enter a valid URL (e.g. https://example.com).',
    });

export const requiredUrlSchema = (fieldName: string = 'Website URL') =>
    z
        .string()
        .trim()
        .min(1, { message: `${fieldName} is required.` })
        .url({ message: 'Please enter a valid URL (e.g. https://example.com).' });

export const nonNegativeNumber = (fieldName: string = 'Amount') =>
    z.coerce.number().min(0, {
        message: `${fieldName} cannot be negative.`,
    });

export const amountSchema = zodAmount;

export const quantitySchema = z.coerce
    .number()
    .min(1, { message: 'Quantity must be at least 1.' });

import { z } from 'zod';
import {
    requiredString,
    optionalString,
    zodPhone,
    zodPhoneOptional,
    zodEmailOptional,
} from './common';

export const corporateEmailSchema = z.object({
    id: z.string(),
    email: zodEmailOptional,
    isPrimary: z.boolean().default(false),
    isOptedOut: z.boolean().default(false),
    isInvalidBounce: z.boolean().default(false),
});

export const contactFormSchema = z.object({
    name: requiredString('Contact Name')
        .max(100, { message: 'Contact Name cannot exceed 100 characters.' }),
    organizationName: requiredString('Organization Name'),
    mobile: zodPhone,
    officePhone: zodPhoneOptional,
    phone3: zodPhoneOptional,
    phone4: zodPhoneOptional,
    phone5: zodPhoneOptional,
    emailAddresses: z.array(corporateEmailSchema).superRefine((emails, ctx) => {
        // If emails are present, ensure at least one has a non-empty address
        if (emails.length > 0) {
            const hasValidEmail = emails.some((e) => e.email.trim().length > 0);
            if (!hasValidEmail) {
                ctx.addIssue({
                    code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                    message: 'Please provide at least one valid email address.',
                });
            }
        }
    }),
    assignedTo: requiredString('Assigned Representative'),
    isPrimaryContact: z.boolean().default(false),
    designation: optionalString,
    department: optionalString,
    location: optionalString,
    leftJob: z.enum(['No', 'Yes']).default('No'),
    communicationType: z.array(z.string()).default(['Call', 'Email']),
    doNotCall: z.boolean().default(false),
    description: optionalString,
});

export type ContactFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof contactFormSchema>;

import { z } from 'zod';
import {
    requiredString,
    optionalString,
    zodPinCode,
    zodPinCodeOptional,
    zodPanOptional,
    zodGstOptional,
    zodIfscOptional,
    zodPhoneOptional,
    zodEmailOptional,
    GST_REGEX,
} from './common';
import { corporateEmailSchema } from './contact.schema';

export const partnerCompanySchema = z.object({
    id: z.string(),
    partnerCompanyName: requiredString('Partner Company Name'),
    relationshipType: optionalString,
    contactPerson: optionalString,
    contactEmail: zodEmailOptional,
    contactPhone: zodPhoneOptional,
    status: z.enum(['Active', 'Inactive']).default('Active'),
});

export const organizationFormSchema = z
    .object({
        // Basic Details
        organizationName: requiredString('Organization Name')
            .max(150, { message: 'Organization Name cannot exceed 150 characters.' }),
        mailingName: optionalString,
        natureOfBusiness: requiredString('Nature of Business'),
        accountStatus: z.enum(['Active', 'Inactive']).default('Active'),
        typeOfEntity: requiredString('Type of Entity'),
        customerType: requiredString('Customer Type'),
        sapCodeTallyId: optionalString,
        showroomBranchCode: optionalString,
        sourceOfLead: optionalString,
        memberOfParentCorp: optionalString,
        numberOfEmployees: optionalString,
        annualTurnover: optionalString,
        description: optionalString,
        accountVerified: z.boolean().default(false),
        provideSupport: z.enum(['Yes', 'No']).default('Yes'),
        corporateEmails: z.array(corporateEmailSchema).default([]),

        // Billing Address
        billingAddress: requiredString('Billing Address'),
        billingStreet: optionalString,
        billingCity: requiredString('Billing City'),
        billingState: requiredString('Billing State'),
        billingPostalCode: zodPinCode,
        billingCountry: optionalString.default('India'),
        billingLatitude: optionalString,

        // Shipping Address
        shippingAddress: optionalString,
        shippingStreet: optionalString,
        shippingCity: optionalString,
        shippingState: optionalString,
        shippingPostalCode: zodPinCodeOptional,
        shippingCountry: optionalString.default('India'),
        shippingLongitude: optionalString,
        copyAddressFromBilling: z.boolean().default(false),

        // Tax & Bank Details
        registrationType: z.enum(['Registered', 'Unregistered']).default('Registered'),
        panNumber: zodPanOptional,
        msmeRegnNumber: optionalString,
        accountName: optionalString,
        bankName: optionalString,
        bankIfscCode: zodIfscOptional,
        gstNo: zodGstOptional,
        gstNumber: optionalString,
        cinNo: optionalString,
        tanNumber: optionalString,
        accountNumber: optionalString,
        typeOfAccount: optionalString,
        bankAddress: optionalString,

        // Partner Company
        partnerCompanies: z.array(z.union([z.string(), partnerCompanySchema])).default([]),
    })
    .superRefine((data, ctx) => {
        if (data.registrationType === 'Registered') {
            const gst = (data.gstNo || data.gstNumber)?.trim();
            if (!gst || gst.length < 1) {
                ctx.addIssue({
                    code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                    message: 'GST Number is required for registered organizations.',
                    path: ['gstNo'],
                });
            } else if (!GST_REGEX.test(gst.toUpperCase())) {
                ctx.addIssue({
                    code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
                    message: 'Please enter a valid 15-character GSTIN (e.g. 07AAAAA0000A1Z5).',
                    path: ['gstNo'],
                });
            }
        }
    });

export type OrganizationFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof organizationFormSchema>;

import { z } from 'zod';

    requiredString,

export const productFormSchema = z.object({

        .min(2, { message: 'Product Name must be at least 2 characters.' }),
    hsnCode: optionalString,
    category: optionalString,
    type: optionalString,
    manufacturer: optionalString,
    taxType: optionalString.default('GST'),
    taxRate: optionalString,
    discount: optionalString,
    cost: optionalString,
    mrp: optionalString,
    msp: optionalString,
    contractCreate: optionalString.default('No'),
    description: optionalString,
    termsAndConditions: optionalString,
});

import { z } from 'zod';
import {
    requiredString,
    optionalString,
    zodPhoneOptional,
    zodPinCode,
    zodPinCodeOptional,
    zodEmailOptional,
    zodGstOptional,
    zodAmount,
    quantitySchema,
} from './common';
import { QUOTE_STAGES } from '../types/quotation.types';

export const quotationLineItemSchema = z.object({
    id: z.string(),
    productId: optionalString,
    productName: requiredString('Product Name'),
    quantity: quantitySchema,
    amount: zodAmount,
    discount: zodAmount.default(0),
    discountType: z.enum(['percentage', 'direct']).default('percentage'),
    salePrice: zodAmount.default(0),
    taxRate: z.string().default('GST 18%'),
    taxAmount: zodAmount.default(0),
    total: zodAmount.default(0),
    description: optionalString,
    note: optionalString,
});

export const quotationFormSchema = z.object({
    // ── Tab 1: Overview ───────────────────────────────────────────
    quotationTitle: requiredString('Quotation Title'),
    quoteStage: z.enum(QUOTE_STAGES as [string, ...string[]]).default('Draft'),
    quotationDate: requiredString('Quotation Date'),
    validUntil: requiredString('Valid Until Date'),
    remarks: optionalString,
    termsAndCondition: requiredString('Terms & Condition'),
    termsAndConditionDescription: optionalString,
    assignedTo: requiredString('Assigned Representative'),

    opportunityName: requiredString('Opportunity Name'),
    company: requiredString('Company'),
    validationPeriod: requiredString('Validation Period'),
    otherRef: optionalString,
    paymentTerms: requiredString('Payment Terms'),
    paymentTermsDescription: optionalString,
    preparedFor: requiredString('Prepared For'),

    // ── Tab 2: Line Items ─────────────────────────────────────────
    currency: optionalString.default('Indian Rupee: ₹'),
    groupName: optionalString.default('Software Licenses & Add-ons'),
    lineItems: z
        .array(quotationLineItemSchema)
        .min(1, { message: 'At least one line item is required to create a quotation.' }),
    lumpSumDiscount: zodAmount.default(0),
    totalAmount: zodAmount.default(0),
    totalDiscount: zodAmount.default(0),
    subtotal: zodAmount.default(0),
    totalTax: zodAmount.default(0),
    grandTotal: zodAmount.default(0),

    // ── Tab 3: Address Information ────────────────────────────────
    organizationName: optionalString,
    organizationId: optionalString,
    contactName: requiredString('Contact Name'),
    contactId: optionalString,
    contactMobile: zodPhoneOptional,
    mailingName: optionalString,
    gstNo: zodGstOptional,
    contactEmail: zodEmailOptional,

    billingAddress: requiredString('Street / Billing Address'),
    billingCity: requiredString('City'),
    billingState: requiredString('State / Region'),
    billingPostalCode: zodPinCode,
    billingCountry: requiredString('Country').default('India'),

    shippingAddress: optionalString,
    shippingCity: optionalString,
    shippingState: optionalString,
    shippingPostalCode: zodPinCodeOptional,
    shippingCountry: optionalString,
    copyAddressFromBilling: z.boolean().default(true),

    // ── Context & Compatibility Aliases ───────────────────────────
    opportunityId: optionalString,
    opportunityCode: optionalString,
    status: optionalString,
    quoteDate: optionalString,
    quotationSubject: optionalString,
    contactNumber: optionalString,
    emailAddress: optionalString,
    notes: optionalString,
    termsAndConditions: optionalString,
});

export type QuotationFormSchemaType = z.infer<typeof quotationFormSchema>;
